They seem to work pretty well are cute designs and have held up through multiple washings on the gentle cycle and air fluff or lay flat to dry. They still look brand new to me! They are a little stiff at first ( and sometimes after washing) but with use they do become softer and the inside is plenty soft for sleeping- my kiddos have not complaints!

I was on the fence for a while with these loved the prints ( LOVED) but was unsure how well they might actually be "working"  well that is until my daughter pooped at the pool and I had no idea because of these magic things- held it all in! super easy to wash out and hold up well! Still look great and we've been hard on them-lol. Yes they are tight on the legs but they are also adjustable... and its important to have them snug as that's how they work!

I like that they are individual and don't connect to others, cuz when your in a jam, you can pull one out and open it with one hand! works wonderful!

She looked so adorable and warm. The matching wash cloths are great and work well for a little scrub down. After washing the towel in the laundry the top frog on the hood got a little stiff, but it is still fine and is perfect for bath time. I love the towel set.

I'm not sure how waterproof it is, it seems okay for small spills but I wouldn't use this if you are expecting a lot of spills, etc. I really just wanted to protect my mattress from general wear and tear.

title: good product!

title: Too short. What to use it for?
text: This is a cute design. I love Skip Hop designs. But, it's too short. I really wish it were taller especially with the 2nd step. My almost 3 year old uses the white one in the picture to reach the sink and wash her hands. She still jumps up to turn on the faucet and lean on the counter. It's also too short to use for potty training on the big toilet. Not sure what I can use it for.

title: Good space saver!
text: I like this boon product alot because it fits more in such a small space! I use it for different items than the grass product. I can essentially fit all of my pump parts and a few bottles on it all at the same time. My only gripe is that I wish the "leaves" were skinnier to fit my 21mm pump flanges better. I've dropped them often. There's really no reason to have them be so wide, although I will say that the leaves are all a little different in length and width, which helps some. I put this in the dishwasher top racks and it has held up well.

title: Great Coverage to Keep My Kid Germ Free
text: I like the size of these covers as it covers the top of the toilet seat AND sides of a toilet. It helps keep my 2.5 year old kid's bum and hands clean. The stickers underneath the cover that are meant to keep the cover in place, which are a great idea, have not lined up on any toilets we've used. They are too far inside and dont reach the sides of the seat. It makes it hard for the cover to stay in place while picking up my kid and trying to sit her down. The cover has always moved for us. That's the only downside. The quality is great. Nice and thick. Not flushable. And the print is cute.

title: Awesome little bed for my 2.5yr old
text: I bought this for my tall 2.5 year old who outgrew the pack and play for sleep when traveling. It's excellent. Easy to inflate. I like that it has the 2 pieces which gives you options to use the bumpers or not. My picky kiddo loved it and slept well on it for several days. The top bumper was super important so her little pillow and head wouldn't push up and slide off. She likes being up against the sides of the bed and this helped her keep that comfort. I definitely recommend it!

title: Good product for the price
text: This is the 2nd pack and play mattress I've purchased from Dream on Me. They've both been the 3in thick kind. It's a solid good product. They fit snug in my two different Graco pack and plays. As an attestment to durability, the first matress I used for my kid's naps and traveling until my kid was about 2yrs old and outgrew it. My 3 month old child now uses the matress for sleeping in our room overnight until he transitions into his own room. It has held up well and it's still firm. I purchased a 2nd matress for naps at his Nancy's house in a pack and play. They're easy to wipe down. In regards to it being noisy, I would say it's mildly crinkly. I use a matress cover and sheet over it and I think it's fine. It hasn't affected either of my kids sleep which is most important. For that reason, I gave it 4 stats because I'm sure there's better out there that are super quiet and more bed like, but obviously for a premium price.

title: Doesn't glow in dark, but still cute!

Had to get another, that is how well it has performed.  Attractive, takes up little floor space.  I use it everyday, storing craft and art supplies.  Very well please with this purchase.

title: Great product!
text: My babies were all breast fed so I am kind of late finding this product compared to most parents I think. My daughter is 10 and eats by feeding tube and uses a powered formula. This mixing pitcher is awesome! We have had no issues with clumps, and it eliminates the bubbles that shaking a formula tends to give. I can't believe I didn't discover this earlier. I will be making it my go to gift for friends who have babies. It so easy to use and also very easy to clean. The only complaint is that it needs to have the ounce markings on both sides of the pitcher, its kind of hard to read it while filling without turning your arm all funky.

title: Love these spoons!
text: My 6 month old grandson handles this spoon pretty well!  Perfect size and great for teething babies too.  Ordering more; I recommend.

First, I had a real hard time putting this together. As a single 60 something year old woman, I had to painstakingly, reading instructions, try to put this together by myself. I guess I was hoping I could just open the box and 'pop' open the playpen. Instead, I had to put a load of pipe like pieces together and then string the netting and pace over it. After finally getting it together, I was ready to try the new puppy in there. The puppy was not happy (of course, probably to be expected) and I found her almost able to rip the netting apart. It also did not form the strongest of a surround set up (it was kind of flimsy). My puppy had more fun trying to hide under it when she was outside of it. So, this all being said, I am not sure how it would work with a child. But, to be honest, I probably wouldn't buy it. I am sure a child of anything more than baby size could probably work their way out of it. I

title: Great playpen for babies and toddlers!
text: My son and his wife have a 13 month old toddler who I occasionally have the privilege of watching overnight. I love that this super well made playpen was easy to assemble and set up. I can keep my grandson safely in my site while I am cooking or cleaning without worrying about him going off and getting into mischief. It holds him well, for at least another couple of months (after that I am sure he will be climbing out of it so I will need an alternate means). Highly recommend for all babies and children!

title: Wonderful gate for multiple uses!
text: In full disclosure, I did not use this for a child gate. Instead, I have a 4 month old puppy that I got about a month ago and I have been searching for a way to keep her contained when I am busy and cannot devote attention to her. This was easy to set up and super easy to use. It fit my door opening perfectly and my puppy has grown used to it. She can keep an eye on me while I am busy and I can keep an eye on her while I get to do things around the house. This is nice and strong, too, she cannot push or knock it over. It's a great gate whether using it for a child or a pet!

title: The best gate I have ever used!
text: This is a great safety gate. I have a new puppy that I like to keep in my kitchen area when I am trying to get stuff down around the house and this is perfect. Easy to set up, fits my doorway perfectly and is strong enough when he pushes against it and jumping it stays totally in place. Super attractive, too. Highly recommend if you are looking for a gate for puppies or babies!

title: Great for toddlers, high in sugar and calories
text: Not sure I really should rate these as 3 or 4 stars. First, my two year old grandson really liked these (but then again, he loves all sweets). Second, I do like the size of these, they are easy for young children to pick up and eat. I don't, however, like the higher caloric and sugar contents (not something I would typically keep in the house for him when he visits). These might be good for a special treat, but not something I would normally give him.

title: Not just for babies and toddlers!
text: I am writing this review a little differently. I did want this for when my grandchildren (youngest of which is 3 months old) visit. However, shortly after receiving it, i ended up adopting a stray puppy. This was a perfect way for me to keep him contained while allowing him lots of room. This is a large size, quality made playpen which gives children (and pets) safety when you can't always be with them. I found this to be a great item to keep around and highly recommend.

title: A quality, super cute, crib set!
text: This is an absolutely adorable crib set. Great for both boys and girls, so it would make a wonderful shower gift for someone who does not yet know the sex of their baby to be. This goes great with my grandson's room decor filled with giraffes and animals. The quality of this set is terrific, too. Soft and washes easily and colors still look vibrant after washing this set at least a half a dozen times by now. Highly recommend this set for the little one in your life!

title: Great SPF protection in a spray can
text: I have two grandsons (ages 3 and 7) who come to visit me regularly in Florida. I wanted a great sunscreen that would be easy to apply and would last a long time (particularly around the water). This Coppertone Pure and Simple is just what I was looking for. It sprays on easily (great for squirming impatient kids) and it stays on even if they are in the pool. It is also SPF 50 which makes it truly protect their sensitive skin. Highly recommend!

title: Great multi use baby wipes!
text: This a great size pack of baby wipes/tissues. Easy to carry in your purse (or pocket) and nice to have with me on a day out with my 2 year old grandson. Great for simple meal or just standard cleanups or for diaper changes. Light fragrance and non-irritating to baby's delicate skin, I think every parent should not leave home without these. Highly recommend.

title: Economical and non-irritating to baby
text: My new 3 month old grandbaby has super sensitive skin so I was anxious to try these. These wipes are a super nice size (which makes me have to use only one or two during a standard diaper change). They are moist and clean well, and do not have a scent. After using them exclusively for a week straight, I can report that baby's skin was soft and smooth and blotch free (something she has had problems with since birth). I just ordered another package and will be continuing to use them (this brand is far more economical than Pampers brand that I had been using). Highly recommend.

title: Every parent and grandparent should have one of these!
text: This is perfect for when my 3 year old grandson comes to visit. I alternate it between my kitchen and bath and allows him easy access to sink and countertop. Washing hands becomes a breeze and helping Meemaw make cookies becomes one of his favorite pasttimes when he can stand next to me to help. Highly recommend this step stool!

title: Reasonably priced, great stroller!
text: This is a great stroller to use. I had been looking for a stroller to keep at my house for when my grandson (age 2) visits. This is lightweight, super easy to put together (comes almost 100% assembled) and my grandson fits perfectly in it. It has a great hood which helps block the Florida sun and it maneuvers perfectly. Highly recommend this stroller, it worked great in the stores and also in a park setting (dirt paths).

title: Great safety gate for pets or children
text: This is a high quality safety gate. It was easy to set up and use and it works great. I have a cat and a dog and i love the little door which allows my cat to get through (without trying to jump over it). My 80 lb. Irish setter mix stays carefully contained in the kitchen area while my cat can come and go as she pleases. This gate is relatively heavy, too, and cannot be knocked down easily. I used to have a gate years ago when my children were small but it was nothing of the quality of this gate. I highly recommend.

title: Great diaper in a large economical size!
text: Huggies have been my go-to diaper when my own children were small and now for my grandchildren. They are soft, non-irritating, very absorbent and do what their name says: hug your baby to minimize leakage. I particularly like this new box of a one month supply. I always have a supply in my home and it takes several week visits before I get even close to running out. The larger 200 count size saves me money as well. Definitely recommend Huggies to all moms and households.

title: Great way to measure the growth of your children
text: This is super cute. Well made, colorful and easy to hang, this is a great way to measure your child (or children's growth). I think this is one of the best gift items for a baby shower. Regardless of whether it is your first child or not, this chart can measure all your children. It is also easy to write on to measure the life/growth of all your children and would make a lifelong keepsake for any family. Highly recommend!

title: Nice functional monitor
text: Nice baby monitor for the money. My new grandbaby was visiting this past weekend and I set it up in my spare bedroom. When baby was napping, my son and daughter in law and I were able to sit out on the patio and still be able to monitor sound and movement in the room. Wish the sound was a little louder and the display was a little larger, but, this would make a great baby shower present or just a gift for a new parent.

title: You get what you pay for
text: These are just ok diapers. I usually use Pampers (or in a pinch Huggies) so I wasn't sure what to expect from this brand. I didn't find these as of the quality of the more expensive named brands. They are definitely less absorbent, the last time my grandson wore these it wasn't long before I found he was wet and his pajamas needed to be changed. Although they are soft and look good, they just aren't as great as the better brands. Maybe if you changed them more frequently they would be better, but then you might as well spend more and get Pampers. These are good in a pinch, but I wouldn't buy them on a regular basis.

title: Another great Pampers product!
text: I love using Pampers on my two grandsons and have been using Pampers almost exclusively since they were born. This baby-dry variety is wonderful and in a size 5 fits my almost 3 year old grandson perfectly. They hug his legs with no leaks or irritations and they keep up with his active lifestyle. Highly recommend these for the baby you love!

title: Best diaper on the market today in a larger economical package!
text: First, I have to tell you that I used Pampers only exclusively for my children and now my grandchildren. I love the way the fit and keep babies dry. Second, they are easy to put on and remove and they are just perfect for your babies in all sizes and shapes. What I really love about these Pampers is the new size pack. With 150 count, they are more economical and will last me for quite a long while. I have already ordered another pack for my grandson out in California so my son's family can also benefit from the larger size box. Highly recommend for your babies and grandbabies!

title: Super great diaper in a larger convenient package!
text: Love this large economical size of Pampers Swaddlers. Same great quality but in a 70 pack which allows for less purchases throughout the month and costs you less in the long run. I almost exclusively use Pampers on my grandchildren, you can always depend on them for hugging their skin, preventing leaks and one of the highest absorption diapers in the market today. I am thrilled that Pampers finally started producing some of the largest sizes and also provides them in a larger package!

title: Best diaper on the market today!
text: Pampers have been my go-to diapers for both of my grandchildren. I feel they fit my grandsons better and keep them drier than any other disposable diaper on the market. These Swaddlers are a great diaper for my oldest grandson. He is at a toilet training age, yet still has accidents. So, we use these diapers when we are out of the house on him to help in case he does have an accident. They fit him perfectly with no leg gaps and the diapers definitely prevent leakage. I highly recommend Pampers Swaddlers for the child in your life!

title: Works well as a teething product, don't like that it's vegetable flavored
text: When it comes to teething aids, these are a good biscuit. My grandbaby did use it for a while and eventually bored of it. To be honest, I don't like that it is vegetable flavored and that it is made in China. Probably won't be purchasing them again (unless they produce a higher quality product). Rating it 4 stars as my grandson did chew on it for a while and it seemed to help with the urge to chew on his newly sprouting teeth. Just think I can do better elsewhere.

title: Nice training pants at a reasonable price for the growing toddler in your life!
text: These are a really cute alternative to Pull-Ups. Work well, absorbs a lot and my granddaughter loves the pattern. Easy to pull up, my granddaughter is going through potty training with a breeze. She feels like such a big girl now that she is no longer in diapers. These are great and are less expensive than the named brands. Highly recommend!

title: Super great diaper for active toddlers!
text: It's hard to find a larger size diaper which works for my grandson. He is 2 1/2 years old and starting potty training. He loves to wear pull ups, but still has accidents. At night, I use these size 6 Little Movers for him and they work great. Super absorbent, soft, non-irritating and fit him great, these are a great transitional diaper to help him make the move to being fully independent. I have loved Huggies diapers for all my grandchildren and these are great for the older child who isn't quite yet ready to be on his own.

title: Great absorbent diaper for the toddler in your life (size 3)
text: These are just perfect for my very active 2nd grandson. They are extremely absorbent and hug his body perfectly so there are never any leaks. Huggies to me are as good, if not better, than Pampers and usually cost us less. These Little Snugglers are definitely our favorite variety and we love this larger pack as well (more economical). He will definitely be using these until he's old enough for the pull up variety. Kudos to Huggies for another great diaper!

title: My granson's favorite pullups!
text: My 2 1/2 year old grandson (and I) love these Huggies pull up potty training pants. First, the colors and Disney design are great and he loves wearing them. Second, they are made very well and look regular underwear. He loves to be praised when he successfully stays dry during the night but these training pants are great for the times when he 'forgets' . We have used Huggies on and off for diapers when he was an infant, but now that he is older and training, Huggies are the way to go. Super absorbent, don't leak, and for overnight use they are great. We highly recommend!

title: Great overnight training pants for your child who is potty training!
text: My 2 1/2 year old grandson (and I) love these Huggies pull up potty training pants. First, the colors and Buzz Light Year design are great and he loves wearing them. Second, they are made very well and look regular underwear. He loves to be praised when he successfully stays dry during the night but these training pants are great for the times when he 'forgets' . We have used Huggies on and off for diapers when he was an infant, but now that he is older and training, Huggies are the way to go. Super absorbent, don't leak, and for overnight use they are great. We highly recommend!

title: Great training pants that kids (and adults) just love!
text: My 2 1/2 year old grandson (and I) love these Huggies potty training pants. First, the colors and Disney design are great and he loves wearing them. Second, they are made very well and look regular underwear. He loves to be praised when he successfully uses the bathroom, but these training pants are great for the times when he 'forgets' . We have used Huggies on and off for diapers when he was an infant, but now that he is older and training, Huggies are the way to go. Super absorbent, don't leak, they are great. We highly recommend!

title: Great all purpose backpack! Lots of storage!
text: This is a great back pack, good for multiple users. I had my daughter-in-law (who has a 4 year old and a 9 month old) use this so I could get her feedback. Bottom line, she absolutely loved this back. Not overly big, but packs a punch when it comes to roominess and versatility. Quality made and stylish, she can use this when bringing both children out with plenty of room for diapers and wipes for the infant and room for snacks and juices for the older child. She also said she is able to pack some clothing and toys for use when needed. She told me she can also see using this when the kids are older just for overnight use or just for using around town. I highly recommend!!

title: Another great Pampers diaper!
text: These are great diapers for my very active two and a half years old grandson. You can always trust the Pampers name for quality and fit. Sure, they may cost more than generic diapers, but in the case of disposable diapers you truly get what you pay for. These pull ons are great transitional diapers being used while he is toilet training (especially overnight) and the pull on feature prepares him for traditional underwear. Soft, very absorbent and conforms well to his legs, Pampers pullons are perfect for the toddler in your life. Kudos to Pampers for another great product!!

title: Wonderful baby wipes, perfect for my new grandbaby!
text: These are really nice, lightly scented, full size baby wipes. One sheet should be able to cover an entire diaper change. My new grandbaby has such delicate skin and these are wonderful on his sensitive skin, cleaning him and leaving his bottom clean and smelling great. I love Huggies products (diapers and wipes) and use them almost exclusively when he is visiting. I highly recommend them for the child that you love!

title: Great alternative to the more expensive baby shampoos
text: Another amazing Amazon brand product. This is comparable to named brands (think J&J) but at a lesser cost. I always keep a bottle of this in my master and guest bathrooms for when my two grandsons visit. They have both been bathed with this wash since they were infants and they have never had a tear shed during the use. Their skin smells fresh and clean and their hair is soft and shiny after use. I highly recommend for anyone who has children (or likes to  use a mild shampoo/wash for sensitive adult skin).

title: Great lotion for baby's tender skin (and my own as well)!
text: I have never tried Grab Green products before. I really like this Natural Baby Lotion in a chamomile fragrance. First, it smells great. Second, it goes on my grandson's skin smoothly and is absorbed quickly. I love after applying it to him rubbing my hands together and allowing my own skin to absorb it as well. His skin feels great after use and despite he tends to have sensitive skin, there are no adverse side effects from using this lotion. I highly recommend.

title: Like anything else, you get what you pay for
text: Funny, I liked the Honest Company diapers I reviewed earlier this month, but these training pants are terrible. First, they are huge on my grandson. Second, there are noticeable gaps around the legs which really don't help to retain moisture at all. I think they feel cheap, too, in using them as a pull up. I am afraid if I pulled them too hard they would rip. I am not sure if it's just the one package I got or if they are all like this. I see a bunch of other negative reviews too, so I think you might want to steer away from these and spend a few extra dollars for a named brand product.

title: Great alternative to the expensive big name diaper brands!
text: These diapers work really well. No leaks, grip my grandson in all the right places (with no irritation) and they are super absorbent. I love the fact that these are a cheaper alternative to the 'name' brands (Pampers/Huggies) without losing any of the quality or functionality. And my grandson absolutely loves the T-Rex print on the diapers (and actually looks forward to getting a diaper change, lol).

title: The best disposable diaper on the market today!
text: I am a grandmother with three grandchildren, 2 of whom are still in diapers. For all three, Pampers Swaddlers have been a staple in my household (when they visit) and my son's household for over 6 years now. Pampers knows babies. This Swaddlers variety is great. It hugs the baby and is very absorbent. They have and do fit my grandbabies perfectly and I never worry about leakage or rashes from poor fitting diapers. We are for sure a Pampers family, wouldn't use any other variety in our households.

title: Nice diaper training pants, but not as good as Pampers
text: These training pants are an alternative to Pampers and Huggies. Unfortunately, they run a little higher in price and are not of the same quality. I used these on my 2.5 year old grandson when my son's family was visiting for the past 10 days. I had no trouble with fit (they seemed fine). I didn't think they were as absorbent as other diapers and I found myself reverting back to Pampers on the overnight. I am rating them at 4 stars, but could have just as easily done these as a 3 star, but they are cute with the animal print and my grandbaby loved them. Not sure I will by them again unless there is a discounted product I just can't resist.

title: Great diaper, comparable to Pampers and less the cost
text: These diapers are great. I got them to have here in the house when my 2 year old grandson was visiting. My daughter-in-law has been a Pampers user for all of her children, so I was afraid when she saw these she would not want to use them. However, surprisingly she did try them and to my surprise actually liked them. Given that she now has three children, all different ages and at different stages of their training, these Amazon Brand are a great way for her to still 'pamper' her baby while saving much needed cash. After using them exclusively for the weekend, she asked me for the link of where to get these (so she could use them when she got home). I ended up buying her a pack and shipping it to her so it was there when she got home. But I know she is sold on these now and will most likely change to the Amazon brand when she goes for her next order.

title: All natural, great snack for the toddler in your life!!
text: I have two grandchildren (ages 4 and 1 1./2) and I thought I would give them a go while they were visiting over the Christmas holidays. The older child didn't really care for them, the younger one did. I tried a piece myself and found it a little dry and not very flavorful (maybe it's the lack of sugar in it). Anyway, these are all organic and are made for healthy snacking. For that, I will give these 4 stars. I believe that they are made for the youngest of toddlers, whose tastebuds are still maturing and are more into the texture and the fact that they are able to feed themselves.I am going to try another one of their varieties for the next time as I like the way these are made and I am hoping I will make a hit with both grandchildren next time.

title: Great product to use for babies with sensitive skin. Works quickly and fully heals fast!
text: This was my first time using Mountain Falls products, so to be honest, I was slightly skeptical. My 7 month old grandbaby was here for the weekend and typically he has problems with rashes (sensitive skin). I ended up putting this side by side with his typical ointment and figured I would try the Mountain Falls first. I loved the light fragrance on this product and it goes on easily and totally protected his skin and private part areas. My daughter in law, when picking him up Sunday night, asked me what I had been using and I shared this with her. She asked if she could take it with her for the rest of the week and I happily obliged. Getting it back more than half empty, I readily ordered another to have it here for Labor Day weekend when they are returning again. I can highly recommend this for babies with sensitive skin for full protection and helps to let skin heal quickly and rashes to almost vanish within a few days.

title: Great pull-ups for the toddler in your life!
text: My grandson loves these. He is three years old and is at the stage where he is almost toilet trained, but needs to wear these occasionally (like when we are out and about and we can't count on him holding it). These easy ups look like underwear and pull up like regular underwear. He likes feeling like a 'big boy' and actually loves wearing them. We occasionally use these overnight as well and they are super absorbent with no leakage through the night.he loves the colorful characters as well. We have been a Pampers family since my son was born and now we are using them for my grandson. Pampers have always been high quality and designed to please kids and parents! We would not use any other brand!

title: Great looking, fully functional gate. Easy to set up and super secure!

Perfect height and fits perfectly in my kitchen entrance. Securely fits in the doorway and even with my pup jumping and pushing on it holds him in securely. I love the mesh screening as it allows total visibility both ways Easy to open and close (even for someone like me with slightly arthritic hands. No complaints just compliments at what a great gate this is for the money.

title: Dove hits another home run with skin care products!
text: I typically use a lot of Dove products in my home, mostly for my own use. But, now that I have my two grandsons visiting more frequently (3 and 1 years old), I had been looking for something for their sensitive skin. This Baby Dove product hits the mark easily. First, it has a very light fragrance and it is light and easy to apply (a little goes a long way). It perfectly cleans and moisturizes their skin and they feel wonderful after their baths. My one year old grandson is having some problems with diaper rash and I will say that I was initially wondering if this might burn or irritate him, but it didn't. I highly recommend this tip to toe wash for all mothers to use during baby's bath time. Just perfect!

title: Great absorbent diapers for a peaceful overnight sleep!

My grandbaby is a big boy who loves his bottle. No leaks on the overnight and he slept most nights straight through (even with a wet diaper). I highly recommend these to anyone who has been looking for an absorbent overnight diaper for the child (or grandchild). Kudos to Huggies for giving me a great alternative!

title: Wonderful organizer that every mom, and grandmom, needs!

I also like the detachable bag which is great to carry some change/money and any other small items you might want (so you don't need to carry a handbag with you when you are walking. Fits great on the City Mini GT stroller I keep at my house for visits and looks great too. Great item to give as a shower or baby present for the mom who has everything.

title: Great training pant for your growing baby!

My grandbaby loves them because they are colorful, have cartoon characters which he loves and the style (getting him out of the old diapers) makes him feel like a 'big boy', These are great for that transition stage between diapers and regular underwear, and my grandson loves to wear these (and show off the cartoons, lol). Can't get a better training pant out there anywhere!!!

This took me about 15 minutes to assemble out in the yard. I love the fact that I can actually put the canopy on it to keep the sun of my grandson when he is playing in it. I do agree with others, I don't see this too much as a portable device unless you are relatively strong. I believe parents would capable of carrying this around (my daughter-in-law amazes me sometimes at the things she can cart). I, on the other hand, struggled with the 20+ lbs and had some difficulty trying to get it in to the carry on bag (my son had to help me. Outside of the weight, I love this playard. You can use it for naptime inside, bring it outside to keep baby safely occupied while you do chores. Would make a great baby shower present for the mom to be.

title: Great car seat!

I am rating this as only 4 stars as it was extremely difficult for me to get hooked into the car and I had to wait for my son to do it. I thought at first it might be me, or the car, but my son also had difficulty with the plastic clasping device. However, once he was able to hook it in, it worked great. My grandson fit in it comfortably and I love the fact that this will grow with him for years to come (and I won't need to purchase any others). As I mentioned, it was difficult to install (hence the rating) but overall, it's a great car seat, very attractive and versatile (for ages).

title: What a great Trainer Cup for the toddler in your house!

This would make a great baby shower gift since often times we only think only of the newborn when it comes to gift planning (no one thinks of what will be coming).

title: Perfect for travel and visits for Grandma!
text: I specifically ordered this stroller at the advent of my grandson coming down to visit me in Florida for two weeks. And it couldn't have arrived at a better time. First, let me tell you I am a very technically challenged 50 something year old woman. This Graco Breaze is a breeze to put together! I love the maneuverability of it, especially considering getting around tight places. I took him to Disneyland and used this exclusively. The rotating wheels handled the ins and outs of crowds like a charm. This unit is lightweight (in other words, easy for me to carry) and folding it up with one hand makes it extra easy when you have a child in tow. I also love the features of the cup holders and the pockets for storage. The seats are cushioned and the canope top kept my little grandson out of the harmful Florida UV rays. I always have loved Graco products (in fact, I purchased one of the Play yards for him to sleep in when he visits. They are made to be durable, long lasting and hold up to a lot of abuse. This stroller will probably work well for him for the next couple of years being that it can hold up to a 50 pound toddler. And the cushioning and the adjustability of the seating is a great feature to grow with. I love this Graco Breaze!

title: So-so monitor

title: ATTRACTIVE, STRONG, QUALITY CAR SEAT
text: As several reviewers have mentioned, this is very well padded and soft, so should be comfortable for your infant.  The color is very pleasing, so it is an attractive car seat.  You can find seats that are half the price of this one, but you get what you pay for.  I am as cheap as they come, but this is one item that you probably don't want to skimp on, as it is important for the safety of your baby.  This claims to be rollover tested.  Not sure what that means unless it means that if your car has a rollover accident, the baby won't fall out of the car seat.  That could avoid serious injury or death.  This seat seems to be very strong and substantial.  It is seems a little heavy, but that's to be expected with the strong construction.  I don't know that much about baby car seats, but this one appears to be a very good one.  One reviewer mentioned that the inside is removable for washing.  That in itself seems like it is worth a little extra price.  In time, the insides of baby car seats can get pretty dirty, especially as the baby drools or spits up.  Like so many things these days, this is made in China, which may or may not be a concern to you.

title: GREAT GIFT SET FOR A GOOD PRICE
text: I am reviewing this from a little different perspective than most people.  This is advertisted as a gift set for parents with newborns.  I used it that way and the receipient was very greatful and was sure they could put the bottles to good use for their newborn.  I think it is one of the most practical gift sets you could give new parents.  Not only that, but it seems like a good value for what is included.  It is under $25 and it is a 12 piece set with 2 each of 2 different sized bottles, two cleaning brushes (bottle and valve), a pacifer, 2 pump adapters (fitting most common breast pumps) and 4 sealing discs (for storing and saving expressed breast milk).  The bottles include anti-colic valves, which is something I hadn't seen before; maybe it is common now, but bottles I am familiar with never had that.  Comes in an attractive box, so doesn't really need to be gift-wrapped.  BPA free.  Made in China, which is a slight concern, but it is a USA company.

A very unusual thing for a baby toy...The sound is NOT loud enough. Usually sounds on baby toys are too loud and irritating. These sounds can hardly be heard.

text:
Easy to put together and easy to use. I think it could be made with thicker plastic for a sturdier feel.

The buckle is the same style as newer baby products. You have to bring the buckle to the side of the other buckle and push the 3rd piece through the hole of the first and snap into the other. Not sure how to explain it.

If it was thicker plastic, I would give it 4 stars.

title: The swing was easy to assemble although the top seems backwards because the ...
text:
The swing was easy to assemble although the top seems backwards because the animals face away from the baby instead of towards the baby.

The sound quality isn't very good and the music choices aren't great.

It swings well.

The price is high for the quality of this item. It should be closer to the $50 price range.

title: Easy to install and work
text:
Easy to install and work. Not sure on how durable this is.

It's easy to work for an adult. I've had a wide variety of items tossed into our toilet by little ones. This will not only keep your baby safe but also your plumbing.

title: First thing I don't like about this is the fact that you have to ...
text:
First thing I don't like about this is the fact that you have to remove the door knob. It's not a good idea to unscrew and re-do door knobs.

Is there a secret to getting back in? I might be doing something wrong.

Just very inconvenient on both counts.

title: Nice and soft
text: Nice and soft.  Pretty pastel color.  It comes with 2 sheets and 2 blankets.  The changing pad is great and easy to wash.  The mattress pad fits well.

title: Seat has an easily adjustable 5 point harness and added cushion
text: Seat has an easily adjustable 5 point harness and added cushion.  They have included 3 attached anchor straps to anchor to your car for extra security.  I don't think those are meant to be the only anchor in the car.  You still need to include your seat belt to anchor it down.  They bottom flips forward to make it recline for rear facing.  The seat is fairly lightweight but well made.  The color is a pretty dark teal.

title: Lots of pieces, cheaply made.
text: Cheaply made. It comes in a lot of pieces.  Nothing is put together.  It took about four hours to put together.  The back is a very thin piece cardboard. It's very heavy piece of particle  board furniture.  I don't think it will last long.

title: Well built stroller, a bit on the heavy and bulky side.
text:
The stroller is easy to assemble as it only requires the cover and the wheels to be snapped into place. It rolls very smoothly. I love the way it is extremely easy to switch from forward to backwards riding. You do not have to remove the straps, there is just a little handle within the top of the seat that you squeeze and push or pull the back of the seat in the direction you want. I couldn't find a convenient way into the basket at the bottom. Apparently, the only way in is through the velcro in the front. At least your stuff won't fall out, just a bit inconvenient.

The stroller isn't nearly as small and lightweight as other umbrella type of strollers but it is well made and I believe it will last long due to the quality workmanship.

title: Works great!  Love the shower
text: This item is working great so far.  I love that it grows with the baby.  Nice and spacious for a toddler but the added insert makes it possible to bath new borns too!  The pink is a vibrant color. Love it!

title: Doesn't burn the skin and stop sunburn
text: Try it on my girl with eczema.  No problems there.  It didn't burn her like a lot of other sunscreens do.  She didn't get sunburn either. She wasn't out there very long though.  I will have to give an update when winter stops coming during the spring.  The pool will soon be warm enough to give this better feedback.

Its not just an alcohol smell its really bad,  to where I couldn't even pair it with anything to make it better.  What a waste of money...no wonder its not returnable it stinks! title: Reads temp in Celsius, not Fahrenheit
text:
This water heater really is nice. It warms the water quickly and can keep it warm for a long time throughout the night.

An added benefit that I found is that it is PERFECT for warming water to make bread. We have a bread recipe that requires the water to be at 114 degrees prior to adding to the mix, and instead of using a thermometer, this worked perfectly.

That Being said, I do wish that there was an option to switch from Celsius to Fahrenheit for us users who don’t use Celsius as often.

Overall, we have been very satisfied with it for sure.

title: Great for travel
text:
My wife and I got this aspirator about a week ago, and it has been an awesome addition to our diaper bag.

It is small enough to fit into some of the smaller pockets, and the power button actually doesn’t turn it on unless it is held for about 3 seconds. We have really appreciated the nuance of the delayed turn on switch because it doesn’t turn on by accident when we are moving about.

It also has a button to be able to suck boogies when you press it (not fully turning the machine on). It’s definitely a good feature too. We highly recommend it.

title: Sucks all the Boogies
text:
We have a newborn, and she recently has her first cold.

We have a bulb aspirator, but the bulb fails in comparison to this nasal aspirator. The gourd shaped nozzle is not terribly intrusive, and the cone shaped nozzle is great for getting deep into her sinuses.

Our baby surprisingly really enjoys having her boogery nose sucked out.

When using the aspirator I would suggest putting it on the lowest suction, and then turning it higher when actually in the nose so that it doesn’t get suctioned to the outside of the baby’s nose when using it.

It has honestly brought our baby a lot of relief and definitely less choking while feeding.

title: Perfect sleep sack!
text: Nice, long sleep sack with the perfect weight. Adorable design too! Perfect for my 18-24 month old.

title: Worth it!
text: We travel often and this mattress has been a game changer!! Our toddler sleeps great in it! It’s easy to pack, clean and we have a well rested kid to boot! We got a strap with a buckle so we can tighten it really tight.

title: Not bad
text: I just got these yesterday but so far so good. They have a pattern on them which grips to whatever your trying to wipe away and makes wiping stuff off of things easy. I have used it on my face and 2 #2 diapers and it hasn't irritated me or my baby. I'll update when I've used them more. Update: they in the 2 months I've been using them have not broke my daughter out. I use them everywhere on her and myself. Pretty good product. I give them 3 stars because they are more expensive than some of the name brands.

text: This is a really good deal if you bought these a pack at a time in the store it would cost you around 23$. Plus gas going back and forth to the store not to mention maybe getting the Corona by just going to the store so I'll be ordering these until my baby is potty trained. Thanks Amazon.

text: This is the same price if not cheaper than I would if paid I'm the stores. Its very functional. I'm extremely happy with it..

title: A Disney Princess for Grown Ups!
text: The Corkcicle Disney Princess line is basically a Disney Princess for Grown Ups! The elegant design is beautiful. The stainless steel wing glass keeps beverages chilled a little longer. Plus it comes with a travel lid! I love it!

title: Gorgeous Travel Tumbler!
text: I am a longtime Disney fan, so when I saw this, I had to order it. My favorite thing about it is the subtle nod to Disney. It's not the cartoon drawings. It's more serious and elegant looking. This tumbler works with both hot drinks and cold ones. The lid stays in place well. I used it for my coffee this morning and it kept my coffee very warm until the last drop. This is a grownup princess cup!

title: Beautiful!
text: This is a beautiful coffee cup. I love the non-cartoon Beauty and the Beast illustrations. The cup retains the heat of my morning coffee much longer than my usual mugs. The lid fits well on it. The only issue that I have with it is the uncertainty that I have with the care instructions. It had a sticker on it that said Dishwasher Safe. The actual product description didn't say anything about the care, however on the part where the product information is near the bottom of that page it says "machine wash, hand wash only". I went to the brand website under the care instructions for the actual Beauty and the Beast mug, it says "hand wash only". Then under the FAQ for general care, it says that in 2020 many of their products are now "dishwasher top rack safe". I hand wash my stainless steel cups because the couple of times I did use the dishwasher, water got inside and it became super annoying to use. I just am confused with the contradictory instructions. I want my mug to last a long time!

title: Awesome Color Changing Tumbler!
text: This is an awesome color changing tumbler. It has exceeded my expectations!  A lot of times, the color changing feature is just darkening the shade or something like that. This one creates a bright rainbow effect! I love it! I am very happy with it!

title: Nice!
text: I ordered this for our 18 year old cat. He's mostly blind but he makes his way up the cat stairs to our bed on most days/nights. We are using this during the day when we're not around to keep him from falling. The opposite of the bed where the stairs usually has extra pillows surrounding the stairs just in case. This comes compressed but it expanded fully within a few hours. It's not a complete deterrent, but it does help. Our bed is a sleigh bed so we only have to worry about the sides. If he's walking around trying to find his way to the stairs, he will notice that there's something in his way and turn. At night when we don't need this, we just put it out of the way at the foot of the bed.

title: Cute & Durable!
text: This toddler meal set is not only cute, but it's durable, too. The set includes a plate, bowl, cup and cutlery. The jungle design is colorful and engaging. It's dishwasher safe, which is pretty important in my opinion. I love the whole eco-friendly angle is has going for it. This set would make a very nice gift.

title: Softest Crib Sheets Ever!
text: These are the softest crib sheets ever! And the floral prints are just darling. They are easy care - machine wash & dry. I'm not kidding when I say these are the softest sheets ever! I wonder if they make king size sheets?!?

title: Sweet Nursery Set
text: This is a sweet set of nursery items. It comes with a quilt, blanket, sheets, crib skirt, changing pad cover, and a diaper stacker. The items are soft to the touch. The color is a dusty rose. The items are a mix of polka dots, chevrons, stripes, and solid rose. The set did not have any strong chemical odors when opened. The sheets fit the crib mattress fine. It's definitely convenient to have everything in a set!

title: Cute Fall Decor
text: I have seen pictures of decorating with felt ball garlands and have wanted to try them. The felt balls are pretty small. The fall color assortment is nice. There are 2 strands in this set. I have one draped across a book shelf and the other on a wall shelf. The balls are strung on yarn. You can adjust the position of the felt balls to meet your needs. One of my cats has discovered the end of one of the strands. She hasn't pulled it down yet, but I'm sure she will one of these days.

title: Nice Gate
text: We're fostering a dog right now and we set up a few gates in the house to restrict him from parts of the house. We have this gate at the top of the stairs. We like that it has an option for no-screw attachment since the dog situation is just temporary. Installation was fairly straight forward. My husband did not run into any obstacles putting it up. There are straps/buckles to keep the gate in place rather than screws. It doesn't look as nice as a permanent attachment would be, but for our purposes, we're pleased. One of the first times my daughter opened it, she pulled the whole gate out of hinges by lifting it too high. We have other gates by the same brand and for those we have to pull up slightly to open them, so that's what she was doing with this one. This one does not require that at all and she hasn't had any problems since that one time now that she knows it's not necessary. The gate is pretty sturdy. Our staircase goes up straight and then it turns for four more steps. So even if the gate fell and someone fell down the stairs, it's only a short drop. I would be more wary of it if we had a straight staircase AND a little child. Since we have neither, it doesn't worry me. Overall, it's a nice gate and is allowing doggo a little more freedom in the house.

title: Nice Gate!
text: We are fostering a large, young, dog right now. We own 3 cats and they do not like the dog. We thought putting a gate up might help make the cats feel a little safer. The gate was really easy to set up. We have it in the doorway between the kitchen and the foyer. This fit fine without having to use the included extension piece. My husband was able to install it in a relatively short amount of time. It opens and latches easily. Technically, we think the dog could jump the gate, but fortunately, he hasn't tried.

title: Nice Looking Gate!
text: We have been using a baby gate to keep one of the cats out of the carpeted dining room. One day, we plan to get rid of the carpet in there, but until then, we have to keep kitty out because she likes to use the corner as her litter box. We've been using a cheap gate, but I have gotten so tired of having to step over it to get into the room. One time I got my foot caught on it when stepping over it and fell. Needless to say, I am very happy to have a walk through gate! Installation wasn't too difficult. My husband set it up in less than ten minutes. We didn't want to permanently attach it to the door frame, so I was pleased that it didn't require that for installation. However, it did have the supplies to do so, if necessary. If you were putting this at the top of the stairs, I would highly recommend using that option for extra security and safety. Once installed, it's much easier to use and get into the dining room. Plus, it's a nice looking gate!

title: Much Easier to Use than Our Old Gate
text: This baby/pet gate is much easier to use than our old one. We set this up to keep a certain cat out of the dining room where she likes to urinate on the carpet. It's a tall enough that 2 out of 3 cats can't jump over it. The one that can jump over it, isn't a problem. Set up was okay. The instructions could have been written a little better, but my husband was able to figure out it.

title: Great Absorbency!
text: This is a case of 92 diapers. They have great absorbency with minimal leaks. These are decorated with cute Sesame Street characters. The adhesion of these is average and comparable to other brands. It's nice that these can go up to twelve hours without changing, but I personally would be hesitant to do that! Overall, I am pleased.

title: Cute Stroller Toy!
text: This is a cute stroller toy that can be clipped to a stroller or car seat. It's larger than I expected, but not too big that it can't be handled by a little one. It's really soft. There are several different sensory features to engage babies. I love that it's a sloth! This would make a great shower or baby gift!

title: Huge!
text: This is a huge hook/clip. I have been using it to clip my purse to the shopping cart. I don't always hang my purse. I tend to put it in the seat, but this makes me feel better because it can't just be grabbed. My stroller days are long gone, but I do see how this would have been very useful when my kids were little.

title: Neutral Design
text: My daughter is heading off to college next month. She and her roommate have chosen a gray and white theme for their dorm room. I thought this would be a good for storage in her room and keep with their theme. The box is a good size and larger than some other ones that I've seen. It arrived flat, but sets up in no time. It's pretty sturdy when set up. Overall, it's pretty nice.

title: Cute Baby Toy!
text: This is a cute and unique baby toy. The colors are gender neutral. It's very soft. You can clip it on to the stroller or car seat if desired. All pieces are securely sewn.  It's a high quality baby toy as one might expect from the Manhattan Toy Company. You don't often see Narwhal baby toys!

title: As Expected
text: My kids are grown, but I still find that I use baby wipes. I like to keep a package in the car to use. I work in a special needs classroom. We don't have a sink in our classroom, so we use baby wipes for various situations. Plus, we let the students use them to wipe the tables because we want them to be involved with cleaning our room, but we don't want them to be handling chemicals. Then if the clean up requires something stronger, than one of the adults will take care of that. These baby wipes are as expected. The case comes with 6 packages, each has a resealable lid. The wipes are gentle and non-irritating. There great to have on hand!

title: Cute & Absorbent!
text: These diapers are not only cute, but absorbent, too! I love the little otter designs! The wetness indicator works well. There's a yellow stripe in the center of the diaper and when wet, it changes to blue. The stripe is along most of the length so it doesn't matter if it's worn by a boy or girl. The Velcro tabs are strong and stay in place well. The legs are gathered to help prevent leakage. I'm glad to see the that no chlorine bleach was used in the manufacturing process.

title: Great Baby Gift!
text: I really like this baby play mat! It can be used with the spinner feature or without. The spinner feature is great for baby tummy time. Of course, that feature will be limited due to baby's growth, but since you can still use the activity mat without it, it would make a great baby gift! It's well made. It has a lot of the features that other activity mats have such as the crinkly sounds. The colors are vibrant and appealing.

title: Great Results on My Neck Area!
text: This skin cream is not very appealing when you first see it. It's a thick, light beige colored cream. It has a slight, mild scent, but there's no fragrance. I haven't really noticed any difference in my skin tone in the past few weeks of using this on my face. However, I've also been using this on my neck and decolletage area with success. When I put it on my neck, I immediately notice a temporary smoothness. I'm almost fifty and my neck looks it. I am amazed at how smooth my neck looks after applying it. As I said, it's temporary, but I have not found anything that even does that, so I am impressed. The cream absorbs into the skin rather quickly and doesn't leave behind any stickiness or greasiness.

title: Basic, No Frills
text: This is a basic, no frills insulated cooler/lunch bag. The size can easily fit most lunch items plus an ice bag. It will not accommodate a large salad, but most lunch bags I have seen have the same issue. The strap is adjustable. The zipper works well. There are no interior or exterior pockets. I usually keep my napkin and utensils in the side pockets. Other than that, it's a decent little cooler.

title: Great for Pink Out Game!
text: Perfect for my daughter and her friends for the Pink Out football game this weekend. They are large sized bows and great for high school girls. The pony tail band is secured with glue and a layer of ribbon to hold it in place. They are sturdy and well made. I would definitely consider ordering more hair bows from this seller in the future.

title: Comes with a Storage Bag!
text: We have a concrete patio down under our second floor deck. Because it's shaded, we like to hang out down there when the weather is nice. It's mid-May right now, and we're already dealing with mosquitoes, so we tend to not go out there as much as we would like. My husband plans to install a few hooks under the deck so we can move this net around depending on what we're doing. We have a hanging hammock chair that our teenage daughter loves lounging in, so that is one area we plan to use this. We also want to hang it over our round patio dining set. Not only will this keep the mosquitoes out, but it will keep the flies and other bugs away, too. The net folds up into a storage bag. When you take it out of the bag, the top ring expands. It's like the car shades or pop up kids tents that you have to twist a certain way to fold it back up. There's a small metal ring in the center of the top for you to hang on to a hook. Overall, the quality seems decent, but  I do wonder how sturdy it is when hanging up. I am also interested to see how well it holds up after frequent use. I will update my review after we have started using it outside. The plan is to take it down when not in use to preserve it from the weather.

title: Great for Baby!
text:
This is a very handy item to have! It's smaller than a regular sized umbrella, so it is geared more for babies and little children. It can shade/cover an adult, but it won't provide as much coverage as a larger one. I usually carry a purse or bag on my shoulder and it would not cover that and my head/body. It comes in two parts. You screw the umbrella portion into the clip part. The umbrella does not have a one push button to open/close the umbrella, but it is easier to open than the older umbrellas where your finger can get pinched under the metal opener. The clip can be attached to the stroller or chair easily. Then the umbrella can be added and removed without unclipping the whole thing which is nice. The clip is sturdy and holds the umbrella well without slipping.

*I received this for free directly from the seller in exchange for my honest & unbiased review. My thoughts & opinions are my own.

title: Cute!
text: My teenage daughter loves wearing rabbit ear hair ties. Prior to ordering these, she had about 3 or 4 of these type pony tail bands. She was thrilled when I gave her these. There are 20 different ones. We received no duplicates. There are two that are very similar, but they are actually in her school colors so that worked out well. They have a little bit of padding in the rabbit ears to make them a little stiffer. They seem to be well made. My daughter loves having a large variety of these hair ties!

title: Keeps Our Dog Out of the Dining Room!
text: We recently purchased this to help keep our senior dog out the dining room. We used an identical baby gate many years ago when our children were little and had no problems with it, so for the price we decided this was a good purchase. It took a few tries at adjusting it so it fit snuggly in our doorway, but once it was in there, it hasn't loosened or slipped out of place. I would hesitate to use it to block the top of a staircase for small children, because if enough pressure is applied, it may buckle and fall, but for just keeping a child out of another room, it would be great. It's not too high that we can't step over it as needed, but high enough to keep the dog out. The cats have been able to jump over it easily, though we have considered cutting a hole for them in the white plastic barrier.

title: My Teenage Daughter LOVES her New Travel Pillowcase!!!
text:
This is an adorable pillow case! I purchased this for my teenage daughter. She is in the marching band and she likes to sleep on the way home from the football games. This size is perfect for her! And although she's a teen, she is an animal lover & simply adores the design of this pillow case. The pillowcase is open in the middle to slip the pillow inside - kind of like pillow sham covers. It has a soft, cotton feel to it. The colors are vibrant and the animals are cute. I can't say enough nice things about this pillowcase!

*I purchased this pillowcase at a reduced price for the purpose of trying it out & reviewing it. My thoughts & opinions are my own.

title: Great for Toddlers & Teenagers!
text: My teenage daughter wanted a travel pillow to take with her on marching band bus trips. I looked at several different toddler sized pillows before settling on this one. This one was priced reasonably and had lots of good reviews. It's soft & fluffy without being too flat or too firm. She LOVES it & can't wait for her next band trip! So even though it's considered a toddler pillow, it makes a great travel pillow!

title: Best Baby Mirror!!
text: I purchased this back seat mirror as a baby gift & I am super excited to give it to my friend! It's amazing! My own kids are teenagers, so it's been a long time since I purchased anything like this. I had a very small back seat mirror with my younger child and it had to stay put with a suction cup on the back windshield. It was a pain & had to be positioned every so often. And one time it fell and hit my sleeping baby!  This mirror is nice & big so you can get a great view of baby. I took it out of the box to examine it.  It securely attaches to the rear headrests and can easily be adjusted to get the best view. It also comes with a handy cleaning cloth. This is one of those gifts you feel very confident giving to the recipient!

title: Definitely a premium quality organizer!
text: I am a mother to 2 teens & even though my kids are older, this is a much needed item for our family. My 13 year old daughter is always bringing a bunch of stuff with her in the car, even for short rides. Now she has a place to keep her hair brush, hair accessories, iPad, lip balm, craft items, notebooks, novels, and much more. Prior to this organizer, I was in a constant battle with her to keep her part of the van nice & neat. The organizer is made of a heavy, sturdy fabric. It is simple to install & remove. There are plenty of pockets to store items. When the kids were younger, I purchased a different car organizer, but it was flimsy & not well made. The only place it attached to the car was at the top, so it ended up getting in the way a lot. This one is so much better! I love how it attaches to the seat at the top & the bottom to keep it in place. This one is definitely a premium quality organizer. It would make an excellent gift.

text:
I GAVE THIS FIVE STARS WHEN NEW BUT, IT IS NOT HOLDING UP AND THAT'S CRAZY FOR SUCH AN EXPENSIVE STROLLER. Here's what I wrote when I was in love
After much research, my daughter requested this stroller for her first child. It seemed way overpriced when I thought of everything else that money could buy and also what I spent on her stroller 28 years ago. But it is so well designed with the option to use a car seat as the seat, the well thought out storage, the ability to turn the seat to face you, the "moon roof" and more. It moves and turns well and for such a "loaded up" model, it is surprisingly light. My sone in law is over six feet tall and my daughter 5'10. The adjustable handle extends enough for them. A great and attractive stroller. I'd say well worth the money but that will only happen if it lasts through more than one child and possibly for others as it is lent out in later years. I expect a lot for nearly $500.
HERE'S JUST PART OF WHAT WENT WRONG:
WELL, we did not use this stroller super had but it is a real disappointment! The brake stopped working and we use it in a town with a lot of hills. Not to mention, that's a pretty important feature! Other pieces seem worn as well. I expected a stroller that would live for generations, not one that has a serious safety problem in less than a year.

title: Powder 5, Lid 0
text:
I purchased this powder because it is free of talc, cornstarch, and medicines. I like that idea very much. The powder is completely unscented, to my nose at least. I expect that it will deliver as promised. However I want to comment on the problems I have experienced with the container itself. To be sure, it is an attractive package. But I had trouble opening it and there is no instruction on the bottle as to how to do that. I assumed it would work like all other powder bottles: twist to open, twist to close. NOT so. I turned and turned this way and that -- no powder would discharge. I finally used my trusty Swiss Army knife ti puncture holes in the white piece of material I could see through the holes in the metal top. Now the powder comes out, but there is no way to close the bottle completely -- because of the holes I was forced to make. Nothing I do will now cover those holes completely. Perhaps I missed something but it is too late for me.

The metal top has a very rough, serrated edge that is tough on my fingers. I want to caution anyone with arthritis in the hands or minimal hand strength that you will need to look elsewhere to find a lid that will not outsmart you as it did me.

title: Attractive, Easy to Assemble, But With Drawbacks as Toy Organizer
text:
This AMAZONBASICS KIDS’ TOY STORAGE ORGANIZER (Natural, Primary Colors) is fairly easy to assemble, as the holes for the metal support rods (for the colorful plastic baskets) are pre-drilled in the wooden side supports. You will need a Phillips screwdriver (not included). My organizer arrived in perfect condition, with all the parts and baskets intact.

The organizer is highly attractive, with all the bright-colored baskets, but it isn’t a great toy organizer. The storage capacity is substantially reduced by the angled placement of the baskets. The angled placement displays the contents of each basket, but stuff spills out of the lower end of the basket if you try to fill the basket full of loose toys and then replace it on the rack.

The other problem with the angled baskets is that they’re terrible dust collectors. The open tops don’t provide any protection for items that remain in them for a long time, and dust collects in the bottoms even if the items placed in them are in regular use.

In my opinion, when it comes to storage, nothing beats a set of bookshelves with labeled boxes or baskets placed on the shelves. Labels take only a few minutes to make, and they save you hours of hunting if they accurately describe what’s inside.

IMPORTANT NOTE: For children’s safety, this toy organizer should be fastened to a wall, using the included hardware. (You will need a drill for this.) The organizer is fairly heavy, and shelves of any kind are easily tipped over when children climb on them.

title: Strong, Artificial “Fruit” Flavor Fails to Hide Medicinal Purpose
text:
I ordered PEDIALYTE ADVANCEDCARE PLUS ELECTROLYTE POWDER (with 33% More Electrolytes and PreActiv Prebiotics) with the intention of using it as an electrolyte-replacement drink that is “ healthier” than sugary sports drinks (e.g., Gatorade). Unfortunately, I really dislike the taste of “Berry Frost” Pedialyte powder (dissolved in water). It has a strong, very artificial “fruit” flavor that fails to hide the medicinal purpose of the powder.

Each packet of Pedialyte “Berry Frost” powder has about 3-1/2 teaspoons of powder, to be dissolved in 16 oz. of water. One packet has 50 calories (12g total sugars).

Pedialyte Advanced Care is intended to rapidly replenish fluids and electrolytes that may be lost from dehydration due to vomiting and diarrhea, heat exhaustion, intense exercise, or travel. I will continue to use the product, but I’ll also be holding my breath when I drink it, so as to taste it as little as possible.

title: Poorly Thought Out Activity Book With Farmer’s Market Theme
text:
This MANHATTAN TOY FARMER’S MARKET SOFT ACTIVITY BOOK is kind of strange. It has pages made of silky fabric, with crinkle paper inside that only makes the pages feel odd (thick and clumsy). A few pages have different textures (e.g., a felt pea pod, nappy chickens), but the texture is almost entirely silk.

The cartoonish drawings of fruits and vegetables are cute, but the apples look like radishes, and the mushrooms are almost unrecognizable. The mushroom rattle barely makes a sound. There aren't very many pages, and the “story” isn't well thought out. The choice of things to count is random (stall, apples, chickens, etc.).

The lift-up variety features are illogical (an umbrella, a pea pod, a pocket for a mushroom rattle, an awning for a booth). It took me a while to figure out that the striped “1,2,3” flap on the front cover was an awning.

I question the educational value of an activity book with such hard-to-recognize elements (the awning, the vegetable drawings). This is supposed to be a travel toy, but I think an adult needs to explain it to a small child. I can't think of any reason for choosing this activity book out of the many that are available on the market.

title: Charmingly-Packaged Gift of Baby Skin Care Essentials

This set includes: (1) baby healing ointment, 3 oz.; (2) baby wash & shampoo (tear free), 16.9 fl. oz.; and (3) baby 3-in-1 diaper rash cream (prevents, soothes, and treats diaper rash), 3.5 oz. The generously-sized products are charmingly presented in a little cloth tote bag with stars on the outside and stripes on the inside.

Aquaphor is a brand that I trust for treating minor wounds, itching, and other problems that arise with my own sensitive skin.

title: Lovely play yard, but portability needs improvement.
text:
Two of my biggest pieces of advice with this play yard: (1) read the directions, (2) keep the directions. Getting this entire set put together was liking doing a puzzle, and I definitely got a workout. It's going to take me a few more times of set-up/break-down to know how everything works.

Having said that, I find this play yard quite lovely. It's subtle colors make it ideal for either gender. The wheels on one side are a fabulous touch, as it makes it much easier to move, if necessary. The design is very sturdy - the clips for hanging the bassinet, changing table, and even the toy bar are well made and have a strong grip. I could take or leave the portable "accessories" pocket, but do appreciate the zipper design which really does allow you to leave it on the play yard, or take with you.

The *one* thing that caused me to remove a star is the travel bag, and overall weight of this unit. The bag is very flimsy, and I have zero confidence that it'll last long without a zipper breaking or getting a rip in the fabric. It seems very ambitious to say the bassinet, changing pad, accessory pocket and toy bar will ALL fit in the smaller auxiliary pouch on the bag - I had to shove that stuff to make it fit, and I think I broke the toy bar doing so. For those of us who don't have mad ninja packing skills, maybe some they could include directions on how to fold and nest everything to fit. Also, when you do have everything packed up, this unit is HEAVY to carry. Which, considering the flimsy-ness of the bag, makes me think the seams on the "handles" are gonna bust at some point. Since one of the biggest selling points of a play yard is the portability, having it be difficult to fit everything in, and so heavy to transport, detract from an otherwise really nice product.

title: Perfect (and useful!) gift for new parents.
text: There is so much to love about this product! First, that it's low-profile and so easy to transport from room to room, or in the trunk of your car, or even for storage. It's also fantastic to essentially have two products in one - a vibrating seat, or a swing. There are several lovely details here, too - the mesh sides are a great touch, the two cute little toys hanging overhead, and I especially appreciate the tether that keeps the unit locked while using as a seat (and the swatch of velcro to store the tether when you're using it as a swing). It's also super plush, and the colors are lovely. There are indeed different speeds for the swing, though the vibrations for the seat are simply an on/off function (no variation there). The music that plays is actually pretty subdued, too - no garish, high-pitched ice cream truck songs here. Smart choice to make them relaxing sounds (there's even some white-noise songbirds as one option), so the baby can rest. Assembly was quick and the directions were very straightforward. The only things I might knock a star off for: the process of folding and unfolding the unit for portability can be a little cumbersome. The pink buttons you push to unfold the unit aren't very smooth, and it's hard for just one person to push both at the same time (and swing the base around). I also think the buckle system seems a bit clunky, though it can easily be adjusted, or even taken off if desired. Overall, though, this is a really sweet system, and a perfect (and useful!) gift for new parents.
