My sister abhors touching diaper rash cream .... sprayable cream is such a relief!

However, this did not help yeast reash.

title: Can never have too many...
text:
Does what they are designed to do ...
Chew toy and toy leash. Can never have to many.
Ordered packages for 3 infant's as I will be sending small toys each payday.

title: Baby Oil Gel
text: I am giving the bottle a low rating, it is the worst design.  It is made to store the bottle with the cap side down.  The cap doesn't seem to click very securely and the other end is rounded so it doesn't sit very well on that end.  It's an oil so I'd rather be able to store it with the cap side up.  The Baby Oil Gel is good sinks into the skin in decent time. I think I will be looking for a different bottle to store it in.

title: Rainforest Mobile by Fisher Price
text: My grandson loves this mobile. The music is well done and the forest sounds are soothing.  We have not used the remote control as of yet, but it's got to be a handy feature when the child is older and you don't want to be seen.

title: So Glad We Got This!
text: This is fantastic! Sturdy, well made, easy to store and easy for my Granddaughter to use. So much better than using a little potty chair and wish we would have got this instead of a little potty chair.  So easy to fold up that my 26 month granddaughter can do it. You need to get it!

title: Fantastic Organizer!
text: This was a God send! Very sturdy, easy to put together and my Granddaughter can now find everything right away. She even puts things away in the right place. No more clutter!! Love it!

title: Love it!
text: Very realistic flushing sound. Well made and just the right height. Love that it has a place to put wipes. Fantastic product.

title: Cute
text: Cute for maybe socks or tiny gift basket but a lot smaller than I thought always check dimensions

title: Toy box
text: My daughter loves this great for a little girls 3-6

title: Compresses too easily
text: Became hard and uncomfortable almost immediately.  Sorry I bought them.

title: Cute and plush clothing clips for pacifiers, teethers, IDs, etc.
text:
There are two plush clips in this package; one each with a lion and elephant head. The loop end can be looped around a pacifier, teether, ID, or any small items with holes. The other ends securely clips onto clothing. These hold on well to clothing. All I had to do was lift up the clip lock in the front to open the clip and then snap it down to close it. Note that these clips do not stretch, so if someone pulls on this, it can rip clothing.

Even though these are for babies, they can be used for IDs and other things.

The current price of $8.99 ($9.99 minus 10%) comes to $4.50 per clip, which is pricey.

title: Way too simple baby milestone markers
text:
There are seven (7) very simplistic milestone stars in this package. They are double-sided and almost all of them just have the baby's age for the first year as follows:

- The cutest Diaposaurus has emerged

- Hello world

- 1-11 mos as in One Month, Two Months, etc.)

- My First Birthday  

 Also included are two cut sticks that can be slid together to make a milestone holder (see photo). Although these are used as milestone markers when taking pictures during a child's first year, they lack any special messages except for the first two above. 

In general, these are so basic. I personally prefer [[ASIN:B0B6JLQBMT these]] instead. For something a little more high-end, I recommend these  [[ASIN:B091XJK27X milestone blocks]].

The current price of $12.90, comes to $1.84 per milestone if counting the carry pouch and holder sticks as freebies. Supposedly, some profits go to charity but I personally dislike when products tout such a cause as it inserts another middle-man for a charity. The charity info is on the heartsign website.

title: Waxy scent; initially greasy but dries silky & is moisturizing; PRICEY
text: This looks like yellow Vaseline but spreads just a tad easier than that. It moisturizes and absorbs well and is initially greasy. However, after it absorbs, the skin feels silky. Although this is for babies, I use it on my problem areas such as elbows, heels, and hands and it works well for that. What I do not like is the waxy scent. Although this is unscented, I smell the ingredients and that scent is not nice. This is another reason I only use this on selective areas that need major hydration. The current price of $15.19 ($15.99 minus 5%) for 2 ounces comes to $7.60 per ounce, which is also very expensive. Despite this, this is very good, super hydrating balm.

title: An excellent & adorable anti-drop teether but there is glue around the connection to the rod
text:
There is one BPA-free silicone teether in this package. The silicone is super soft. I consider this an interesting looking koala that is also engaging. This is easy for the baby to grab and hold onto. It has no sharp edges. There are also nubs on the opposite side to soothe the gums. This is easy for the baby to grab and hold onto. I have given many of these types of teethers to my neighbor's and friend's families' babies and they all love them. In fact, these anti-drop type teethers are a favorite.

Note, however, the rod that the baby holds onto in the center is glued around the interior edge on both sides (see photo). Most teethers I've ordered previously have a rod that goes through a hole in the teether but no glue. I do suspect the glue is food safe, as I had a vendor (with a name similar to this one) contact me previously saying they use food safe glue. Also, the baby is unlikely to get this glue near their mouth. Nevertheless, even though I feel this teether is excellent, I recommend supervising when the baby is using this or any teether for that matter.

This is made in China and is rated for infants 3 months and older.. The current price of $8.99 is competitive. Overall, I consider this a great teether that is drop-resistant. The baby can definitely drop this if they let go but it is definitely not as likely to be dropped as others.

title: Looks, feels, and somewhat squeaks like a dog toy but for a baby
text:
Spud is a rubber teether that looks, feels, and somewhat squeaks like a dog toy, except it is being marketed for a baby as a teether. This is not as soft as silicone but it is definitely something a baby will love. It has no sharp edges or parts that can fall off and it is strong. As is typical, always supervise when the baby is using this. I got this for my boyfriend's neighbor who has an infant and he is going to love this. This is rated for 0+ months on the package but I personally would not give this to a baby less than 3 months due to the size and weight.

This is made in China but "conceived" (meaning imagined/designed) in the USA. It is also BPA as PV free as per the package details. The current price of $15.99 is a bit pricey but competitive for this since it is more like a strong dog toy. I have no qualms giving this to a baby that is at least a few months old.

title: Lid does not have an airtight seal but this is a versatile tray not only for baby food
text:
There is one BPA-free silicone tray in this set. There are seven cubicles in the tray. This is not only for baby food. It can be used for ice cubes, fruit cubes, cubes of homemade tomato sauce, cubes of pesto, jello, flan, etc. It can also be used for baking or to steam eggs and, of course, to make baby food or freeze breast milk.

However, what I do not like is that the top is not airtight. Even though there is a lip around the top (see photo), it will be easy for liquids to spill out of this. Therefore, I have to make sure it goes evenly in the freezer without tilting.

At the current price of $14.99, this is on the high side of competitively priced. It is definitely a nice tray as long as one realizes liquid will spill out if titled.

title: Cute soft silicone corner protectors but tiny ears could present an issue; sticks w/adhesive strips
text:
These are adorable edge protectors. They are soft silicone. There are four in total and they stick on with the tape that is affixed on three sides. I had to be careful removing the backing so as not to pull the adhesive off. There is just some furniture I would not want to put adhesive on, but there is no way around that unless using a removable tape. The only negative of these protectors is that the tiny silicone ears stick out. Although they are soft, there is a very small chance a child may scratch or poke their eye on the ears. Other than this, these work exceptionally well and are just adorable foxes.

The current price of $9.99 comes to $2.50 each. For a really good and much cheaper protector, I recommend [[ASIN:B0B3SK7RM8 these]]. In case the link does not display properly, look for Amazon Item #B0B3SK7RM8.

title: Cute slim teether made of soft silicone with gum massaging nubs; doesn't look like a fox
text:
There is one BPA-free, food-grade silicone teether in this package. The silicone is super soft. The color is soft mint and this is very cute and engaging. I would not call this a fox but it is adorable. This is easy for the baby to grab and hold onto. It has no sharp edges or parts that can fall off. This is a slim teether and is one solid piece. I also love that it has paw print nubs on the back which act as a gum massaging "tool." As is typical, always supervise when the baby is using this. This is rated for babies from 0 to 6 months.

This is made in China. The current price of $5.89 is competitively priced for this teether. It is indeed attractive, functional, and cute even though it doesn't look like an "elegant fox."

title: Sturdy stroller straps that makes it easy to hang bags; doesn’t smell like leather
text:
These stroller straps are simply made. The Velcro is strong and adheres well around my stroller's handles. The clips are easy to open and do not feel cheap like some carabiners.

These can be used to hang almost anything small on the stroller like a sand pail or another toy, a water bottle if there is a hook around the bottle to attach to, a diaper bag, grocery bag, etc. Do note that it is not easy to walk with things hanging on the stroller but if one pushes these to the side of the handles and the item is not too big, this provides for more storage on the go. These also don't have to be just used for strollers. They can be used on luggage, in a closet around a clothing rail, etc., etc.

The current price of $8.76 ($9.95 minus 12%) is reasonable for these. I would have rated these five stars but I am not convinced these are leather as it does not smell like leather.

title: Two tightly wound & slightly stretchy clothing clips for pacifiers, teethers, IDs, etc. but PRICEY
text:
There are two tightly wound, well-made, and slightly stretchy clips in this package. They each have a braided design and the loop end can be looped around a pacifier, teether, ID, or any small items with holes. The other ends securely clips onto clothing.

The current price of $9.49 ($9.99 minus 8%) comes to a very expensive $4.75 per clip, which is triple the price of most pacifier clips. Due to the astronomical price, I deducted one star even though I like these clips better than any I tried previously and I've tried a lot of pacifier clips.

title: Three tightly wound & slightly stretchy clothing clips for pacifiers, teethers, IDs, etc. but PRICEY
text:
There are three tightly wound, well-made, and slightly stretchy clips in this package. They each have a braided design and the loop end can be looped around a pacifier, teether, ID, or any small items with holes. The other ends securely clips onto clothing.

Although I usually deduct one star when the price is higher than typical, I did not do that for these clips because they are really well made and very nice. In fact, I like these better than any I tried previously and I've tried a lot of pacifier clips.

title: Absorbs quickly; moderate moisture barrier; soothing
text: This doesn't offer the thick moisture barrier I expect from a diaper rash cream but a moderate one. Originally, I rated this 3 stars but have since increased my rating to 4 stars after extensive use. The cream absorbs quickly and is soothing. The moisture barrier is more noticeable than I first observed. At the current price of $17.99 for 3.4 ounces, this is expensive cream. I like it but it is not the best I tried.

title: Excellent round corner protectors; sticks to the corners with the adhesive strips
text:
These are excellent round edge protectors. There are 12 in total. This sticks on with the tape that is affixed on three sides. I had to be careful removing the backing so as not to pull the adhesive off. What I do not like is that adhesive is required but since I love these so much, I did not deduct any points for that. There is just some furniture I would not want to put adhesive on and that is the only negative of these protectors but it seems to be the standard for all protectors. They work exceptionally well for me.

The current price of $6.99 comes to $.58 cents each.

title: Requires use of the adhesive provided; decent, low-profile protectors

I had to be careful removing the backing so as not to pull the adhesive off. What I do not like is that adhesive is required. There is just some furniture I would not want to put adhesive on and that is the only negative of these protectors. Otherwise, they work well.

The current price of $7.99 comes to $.33 cents each.

title: Very nice small hair clip bows; for girls or use as package toppers
text: These bows are cute. There are eight bows in four designs in two colors of white and pink. These are good to accessorize a girl's hair. They hold on to my hair well. They would actually hold some hair for a baby girl easily. They can also be used as package toppers (to decorate gifts or gift baskets) instead or to even decorate the tip of the Christmas tree branches. The current price of $9.99 comes to $1.25 per clip.

title: Slim teether with gum massaging nubs; babies will love this; use with supervision; PRICEY
text:
There is one BPA-free, food-grade silicone teether in this package. The silicone is super soft. The colors are rich and this is very cute and engaging. This is easy for the baby to grab and hold onto. It has no sharp edges or parts that can fall off. This is a slim teether and is one solid piece. I also love that it has nubs which act as a gum massaging "tool." As is typical, always supervise when the baby is using this. This is rated for babies from 0 to 6 months.

This is made in China. The current price of $9 is on the very high side of competitively priced. Nevertheless, this is indeed attractive, functional, and cute.

title: Good teethers that are less likely to be dropped; rod is reinforced with glue
text:
There are three BPA-free silicone teethers in this package. The silicone is super soft. I consider these cute and engaging. This is easy for the baby to grab and hold onto. It has no sharp edges or parts that can fall off. For the most part, this is perfect as a teether and is one solid piece. As is typical, always supervise when the baby is using this. This is rated for three months and above.

The only thing to be aware of is that the rods are reinforced with glue. I assume the glue is food safe. I had mentioned this on a similar teether and was told food safe glue was used. Nevertheless, the baby is unlikely to get their mouth on this part. I have given several drop-resistant teethers to my neighbor's baby and also a couple of other babies and they are a hit.

This is made in China. The current price of $13.86 is reasonable for this as that comes to $4.62 each. Overall, I consider this a great teether and the baby is less likely to drop this.

title: Soothes a colicky baby with mild heat (can be used cold); comes with a cute burp cloth
text:
This belt comes with a segmented flaxseed insert pad that can be heated in the microwave and helps soothe a baby with a tummy ache. I gave one of these belly huggers to a friend who has a newborn and she gets a lot of use out of it. I microwaved this pack for up to 30 seconds and it provided warm soothing heat. All I had to do was insert the pack into the folder pocket in the belt. The belt is Veclro and gets secured around a baby's waist.

Note that this can be used as a cold pack too by refrigerating the pack in the freezer (in a plastic bag) for one hour.

In summary, the pink owl is cute and is attached to the front of the pack via Velcro and is removable. Also included is an equally cute burp cloth. The belt is well-made and the current price of $15.99 is reasonable too. I've tried other packs that are no better than this that sell upwards of $10 more, which is just crazy.

title: Superb bassinet; height adjustable; rolls & locks; easy to assemble but NO Instructions
text:
At the current price of $149.99 ($179.99 minus $30) this bassinet is expensive but competitively priced. It is also a superb unit and very easy to assemble by following the Amazon video. There are absolutely no assembly instructions that come with this unit. The only instructions provided are how to secure the straps to the box spring and clip it into the bassinet so that it does not move if used next to the bed. It comes in several pieces, including bassinet, support rod, bottom tray with rods, and the hard bed pad insert. There are also two anchor belts that can be used if securing the bassinet to the box spring and the clips underneath. A warranty card is also included. The instruction video on Amazon is easy to follow, however. Just remember that if one is giving this as a gift, either the giver will have to assemble it or point the receiver to the Amazon video.

I just unfolded the unit, turned it over, and snapped in the rectangular support rod with the nubs facing toward the holes so that it would click in place - see photo. I repeated with the rods for the bottom tray. There are also two straps underneath that get secured around the center legs and some tiny strap loops to Velcro to the bars where the bassinet hangs. I then installed the hard bed insert and the unit was ready to go. The basket is adjustable and has seven height adjustments. Adjusting the height is easy but a bit tricky because the button on either side has to be pressed in while the lever on either side is pulled up on. Then I have to release the button then the lever to click everything in place. If I do not do it correctly, it wants to go back down to its lowest height. It is easy once one gets used to it.

The wheels roll but they are sluggish on a rug and smooth on a bare wooden floor. They also lock in place. The front side can be unzipped so that it faces the parent for easy access. All I had to do was pull the tabs on the bar, lift up, and then let it down easily. I had trouble reseating the bar because I did not pay attention to how I removed it. It is important to reseat it with the tab facing down so that it locks in place.

My cats love this bassinet, so it is great for pets too--especially if it is "plushed" up with a nice soft blanket. It does come with its own nice hard insert but that is not plush as is correct for a newborn.

In summary, this bassinet is excellent. It is sturdy, easy to assemble, easy to adjust, and has a sufficient access door. Bassinets are perfect for infants up to about six months old or up to when they reach 20 pounds and can roll over. Once they reach that stage, a crib should be used as it is unsafe to use after that. Of course, it is also perfect for pets and they would like both the bassinet and tray underneath. I do wish the pamphlet they provided came with the full assembly instructions and not just the instructions for securing the straps to a bed. Nevertheless, I did not mark this down for that because assembly is intuitive and easy.

title: An adorable teether that squirts water too; nubs are good for soothing gums but not sturdy
text:
There is one food-grade BPA-free silicone teether in this package. The silicone is super soft and the interior is hollow. This is not only cute but it is engaging as well. There are nubs on the octopus tentacles to soothe the gums. This is easy for the baby to grab and hold onto. It has no sharp edges or parts that can fall off. As is typical, always supervise when the baby is using this. This is rated for 3+ months on the package but the Amazon site says from 0 to 6 months.

Note that since this is hollow, a child with teeth (usually starting at 5-11 month) may bite through the teether. Also, this can be used in the bath to suck up water and water shoots out the bottom when squeezing the head, which provides for some entertainment. I do not feel that this will last if used as a teether since it is hollow. It is not strong and solid like other teethers on the market, like the "Never Drop" teethers that babies love.

This is made in China and is apparently dishwasher, microwave, and freezer safe although I personally would not put this in the dishwasher or microwave. The current price of $12.99 is a bit pricey for this in my opinion. I like this teether but am on the fence about its quality.

title: Spacious diaper bag; lightly padded changing matt included
text:
This is a versatile diaper bag that can double as a gym bag because it is so spacious. 

FEATURES
- The front of the bag has two small and one large zippered compartments. The small compartments have elastics on either side that can hold spoons, forks, and other similarly sized items.

- The central compartment has four "cooler style bottle sleeves,"  two standard sleeves with two pencil sleeves in between them, and two mesh sleeves on the side. There is also a padded diaper changing pad stored in the central compartment. This is so spacious it is like an overnight bag.

- The back of the bag has a large snap folder pocket.

- There is a regular water bottle pocket on both sides of the bag with one of the pockets that can act like a wipes dispenser. Unfortunately, the wipe dispenser hole is on the bottom of the bottle compartment and does not line up with my wipes container. This is a negative to me.

- There are two carry handles in the center and also a shoulder strap that does not have any padding.

- There is also one change purse hanging off the exterior of the bag.

In summary, this bag is a typical nylon bag that looks more like a gym or overnight bag but is certainly optimized as a diaper bag. The wipes hole is not placed correctly in the bottle compartment but other than this, it is certainly a functional bag. The current price of $30.39 ($31.99 minus 5%) is competitively priced for this.

title: I wouldn’t call this “never drop” but it’s an excellent & adorable teether
text:
There is one BPA-free food-grade silicone teether in this package. The silicone is super soft. This is not only cute but it is engaging as well. There are nubs on the ears and ends of the rod to soothe the gums. This is easy for the baby to grab and hold onto. It has no sharp edges or parts that can fall off easily. The rod can be pulled out of its holder but that is not easy to do. For the most part, this is perfect as a teether. As is typical, always supervise when the baby is using this. This is rated for 3 months and above.

This is made in China. The current price of $6.99 is competitive. Overall, I consider this a great teether but I would not say it is a "no drop" teether. The baby can definitely drop this if they let go but it is definitely not as likely to be dropped as other teethers. I would call this "drop resistant."

title: Superb portable high chair but no tray; can be repurposed for pets when baby grows up; assembly
text:
[[VIDEOID:e4642e2f18b6071bafd25c928db8836f]] This is an absolutely superb portable dining seat with a tray table. Minor assembly is required. Below are the parts included. All I had to do was feed the back rail (nodule side down) into the channel at the top of the chair. Then I snapped in the armrests--one to each side of the rail. The nodule snaps in place and holds the armrests to the chair. I also fed the base cardboard into the Velcro sleeve underneath the seat and snapped on the tray table to the armrests. In addition, I fastened the snaps and cloth on the high chair around the handles for a finished look. Assembly took less than 10 minutes.

PARTS
- 2 armrests
- 1 back rail that armrests clip into (must be feed through channel at top of chair)
- 1 seat with installed safety belt
- 1 covered base cardboard (must be fed into Velcro sleeve underneath seat)
- 1 tray
- 1 carry bag

Once the chair was assembled, I affixed it to my breakfast nook by unscrewing the bolts underneath the armrests and then tightening it to the surface. The chair is cantilevered exceptionally well and is sturdy enough to hold many pounds. The tray table can be used by laying the channels for the armrests over them and then forcefully pushing down until it snaps in place over the armrests. There is also a pocket on the back of the chair to store a small item like wipes or a pacifier or teether, etc.

When the baby outgrows this, it can be used for pets as you can see in my photo.

This is a wonderful gift for a new mom. This chair is made for babies that can sit up on their own. It also must be affixed to a sturdy surface and not a glass table, uneven surface, or a table that is too low.

I consider the current price of $63.99 competitively priced considering the exceptional quality and unique design of this unit. I also love that it collapses and is portable just by inserting it into the included carry bag.

title: Two excellent clothing clips for pacifiers, teethers, IDs, etc.; one not so excellent
text:
Two of these clips are excellent. The third one has a loose weave which could catch on a baby's fingers. They each have a nice knitted design and the loop end can be looped around a pacifier, teether, ID, or any small items with holes. The other ends securely clips onto clothing.

The one that has a loose weave I wouldn't use as a pacifier clip due to catching on a baby's fingers.

The current price of $14.24 ($14.99 minus 5%) comes to $4.75 per clip, which is reasonably priced.

title: Larger bibs w/sleeves & Velcro neck closure; provides good coverage
text:
There are two very attractive and very cute bibs in this package. The neck fastens via a Velcro closure. They secure easily via the Velcro and are easy to fasten and remove. The Velcro strip on the bottom supposedly fastens to a high-chair tray but I do not see how that is done unless there is a mat that will attach to the Velcro on the top of the tray. What I like about these is that they provide full coverage with the sleeves and they are for toddlers.

The current price of $13.99 comes to $6.50 per bib. These bibs are very nice and super attractive and the coverage is their best feature.

title: Faded looking waterproof Christmas bibs; crumb catcher doesn’t stay open; 1 bib no good
text:
There are four attractive Christmas bibs in this package. Each bib has a crumb catcher. Each bib is also waterproof due to the plastic covering the cloth. As a result, the Christmas design has a faded look because it can only be seen through the plastic. The neck fastens via one snap but there are two possible snap positions. They feel like they are made of waterproof shower curtain material and liquid does not seep through them. They secure easily via the snap and are easy to fasten and remove. Unfortunately, the crumb catcher does not stay open.

The current price of $5.99 comes to $1.50 per bib which is very reasonable. Since one of the three bibs is unusable due to the snap being missing, it actually comes to $2 per bib. This bad bib (which I threw out) coupled with the faded look and flush crumb catcher, has me rating these 2 stars.

title: No instructions; many sounds come on for a few seconds; needs 3 AA batteries; remote battery incl.
text:
[[VIDEOID:8227f04f2ac0a9c41e2c6cfc93bdd1c1]] This sound machine comes with a total of 108 sleep sounds (I did not count them), 2 nature sounds, 10 animal sounds, and there are also laugh and instrument sounds. It requires three AA batteries (NOT INCLUDED) and a CR2025 battery for the remote (INCLUDED). A Phillips screwdriver is needed to install the AA batteries.

There are no instructions provided and operation is really unclear. I actually had to consult the Amazon site. The tiny blue button (not pink as in Amazon photo) cycles through two natural sounds. The pink (not blue) musical note, cycles through 108 sleep sounds (note I did not try all of them). The blue (not pink) star button, cycles through 10 animal sounds. The remote provides a couple more sounds (the laugh sound and instrument). There is a timer of 10, 20, 30 (I assume) minutes that can be set via the remote. However, it is impossible to know what it is set at.

Operation is cumbersome as per my video. Many sounds also operate for only a few seconds.

I do not like this unit at all and the fact that it does not come with instructions that tells the user how to operate this or how long a sound will play (if it is going off), is a disservice to the customer. Also, parents will be going through a lot of batteries with this unit.

The current price of $17.99 is what machines like this go for but I am sorry I ordered this.

title: Gentle, cleansing, 5-ingredient baby soap; nice gift but way too $$$$
text:
This soap is 100% natural and handmade. It has five ingredients of saponified organic coconut oil, saponified organic olive oil, organic cocoa butter, organic castor oil, and purified water. It is vegan, organic, cruelty free, and non-GMO. The bar is only 2.5 ounces and even though it says it is unscented, it has a nice fresh scent to me--perhaps a natural scent.

I love the design on the bar. It also lathers moderately well and is cleansing and slightly moisturizing. However, at the current price of $9.99 this is only a bar to be purchased as a gift for a new mom as it is way too expensive in my opinion. If it were $5 or less, then I would have rated this 4 stars. If it were $4 or less, I would have rated it 5 stars.

title: Gentle manicure set for baby; needs 2 AAA batteries NOT included
text:
This is a gentle manicure set for a baby. There are two sanding circles for the various stages of 0-3, 3-6, 6-12, and 12+ months. The white pads are for nail polish and dead skin removal. There is a guide for the colored buffers that instruct the user which buffer is for what age. There are two sets of nail buffers in case one wears out. It also comes with a cloth carry pouch and a dust cover (see photos). This does not come with the two AAA batteries needed.

This gently files the nails depending on the tip selected.

The current price of $19.99 is slightly pricey as some sets like these sell for $10.

title: Bibs are soft, thick, easy to clean and somewhat easy to fasten
text: These are very nice silicone baby bibs. They are thick and have a crumb catcher. There are four adjustment holes on the back of the neck with four silicone buttons. The bibs are somewhat easy to fasten and remove. They are also easy to clean and the bib bottom stays open. The current price of $9.91 comes to $3.30 per bib which is competitively priced.

title: An excellent & adorable anti-drop teether
text:
There is one BPA-free silicone teether in this package. The silicone is super soft. This is not only cute but it is engaging as well. There are nubs on the opposite side to soothe the gums. This is easy for the baby to grab and hold onto. It has no sharp edges or parts that can fall off. For the most part, this is perfect as a teether and is one solid piece. As is typical, always supervise when the baby is using this. This is rated for a newborn and above.

This is made in China. The current price of $12.99 is pricey for this as a similar one can be purchased [[ASIN:B0B2K922CC here]]. Overall, I consider this a great teether that is drop-resistant. The baby can definitely drop this if they let go but it is definitely not as likely to be dropped as other teethers.

Normally I take off one star for the high price but I really like this teether that I did not do that this time.

title: Bibs are soft, thin, easy to clean and easy to fasten; snowflake design
text:
These are very nice silicone baby bibs. They are thin and have a crumb catcher. The bibs feel very jelly-like and soft.

There are four adjustment holes on the back of the neck with two silicone buttons. The bib is easy to fasten and remove. They are also easy to clean because the snowflake design is on the reverse side. The bib bottom stays open. The current price of $8.09 ($8.99 minus 10%) comes to $2.02 per bib which is very reasonable for these. Due to the snowflake design, these are perfect for winter.

title: Good reusable pads for “leak” or “soil” protection when needed; not only for dogs; sizing wrong
text:
I ordered these for my cat. I have an old and sometimes sick cat that keeps throwing up on everything (my bed, his bed, etc.). I used to put down blankets but liquids seeped through. However, with this liner, I can get better protection.

I took a picture of this on my king-size bed. There are three liners and they measure 32.5" x 35" at the longest points (less on the rounded ends) and not 34" x 36" as specified on the product insert. The reverse side is waterproof. I have not washed it yet, so time will tell how well this holds up in the washer. I will update my review if I discover issues.

The current price of $29.99 comes to $10 each pad. Not only is this for a dog kennel but it can be used for pets and even as an underlayer for humans underneath a sheet to protect a mattress.

title: Cooler bag pacifier holders that can be used as change purse or other carry bag
text:
There are two pacifier holders in this set as I ordered the Green Leaves + Leopard two pack. There is a cooler-style interior making these water resistant. There is also a clip on the outside to hook onto clothing, a stroller strap, etc. These can also double as change purses and hook off someone's purse. They are very versatile.

The current price of $12.25 ($12.89 minus 5%) comes to $6.12 per holder. This is more of a nice to have option but not a necessary accessory. One can purchase a clothing clip like [[ASIN:B0B883PJYR this]] instead to hold a pacifier. Of course, most pacifiers will remain in a baby's mouth.

title: Medium-weight lotion absorbs quickly & leaves nice hydration barrier on my skin - see UPDATE
text:
This lotion is very nice. It is medium-weight and absorbs quickly (really quickly) and leaves a nice hydration barrier on my skin. I love the results. The aroma reminds me of a faint hint of coconut.

The current price of $24.99 for 8.96 fluid ounces is expensive but competitive.

UPDATE Oct 20, 2022 - The pump to this lotion stops working at half a bottle. At this price it is a big negative. Also, I started to develop a rash from using this product. My skin has become itchy.

title: Simple but lovely baby milestone markers
text:
These milestone circles are lovely and nicely made. There are a total of six 10 "wooden place cards" blocks that include all the months, with the 12th month saying "my first birthday," and various achievements (like the first smile). They are double-sided so that month 4 is on the opposite side of month 3. They are used as milestone markers when taking pictures during a child's 1st Christmas, ages, etc. There are any number of combinations available. In general I love them and they are two-thirds cheaper than [[ASIN:B091XJK27X milestone blocks]].

The current price of $9.99, comes to $.50 cents per milestone or $1 per double-sided place card circle.

title: Nice, small, and individually wrapped muslin bibs in assorted colors
text: This is a really cute set of six bibs in six colors. They are made of muslin which is a thin cotton weave and they are soft. There is one snap on each bib with two snap options. The fact that they are individually wrapped makes these perfect as shower gifts. These are thin but functional. The current price of $16.99 comes to $2.83 each.

title: These are not the greatest quality but they will suffice as a swaddle wrap
text:
At the current price of $18.99 this comes to $9.50 each, which is acceptable. There are two somewhat plush swaddle wraps. Although the wraps are soft on the outside, the quality is a bit cheap. It has Velcro closure on the "wings" and a hood and legs. It is cute and suitable for an infant. I do not feel these will wash well.

One must be careful the baby does not overheat with this as this is not as thin as a muslin cloth. Also, learn to swaddle the baby correctly to ensure the baby stays safe. One should stop swaddling if the baby tries to roll over. There is some good information online and info that should be given at the hospital with a newborn.

If this felt like better quality, I would have rated them 5 stars. Also, the colored one does not look like the color pictured online. It is more green than blue.

title: Weight measurements almost comparable to my food scale; tray length in centimeters; 2 AAA bat incl
text:
NOTE: Amazon would not allow the posting of TWO PHOTOS that shows a comparison to this scale with my silver food scale. They assume the customer will not know which scale is being sold.

I have a food scale that I tested this with for accuracy and the weight registers within less than an ounce of my other scale. In the box is a one-piece scale with a long tray that is part of the scale and an instruction sheet. Two AAA batteries are included. This scale can be used for animals, babies, and as a food scale.

The tray has a measuring tape on it to get a baby's or pet's size. This scale is accurate with a miniscule margin of error. Note that the reading will NEVER be spot on unless there is absolutely no movement from a pet or baby; however, this has a hold button to prevent further fluctuations.

There is a TARE button to zero out the scale in case a container is used and I only want to weigh what's inside the container. There are also three units of measurement - kilogram, milliliter, ounces, or pounds and ounces.

The LED is a bit quirky sometimes. For instance, when I use the TARE feature, it doesn't always show that TARE is on. I just have to know it is. Other times it gets in a locked state and I have to "press-hold" to turn it off and then on again. If this wasn't so quirky, I would have rated this 5 stars.

In summary, I think this is a very good scale that is simple to operate and has all the features needed to weigh a small pet, baby, or food (even though it was not advertised as a food scale). Apparently it has a weight of 30kg (66.139 pounds) and measures up to two feet long (60 centimeters). The current price of $38.60 is competitively priced for this.

title: Really nice baby gift bundle; a bit pricey
text:
This is a really lovely baby gift bundle. It includes two BPA-free pacifiers, a soft bunny toy, what they call a sleeping bag but I would call it a sleep shirt, five pairs of cute socks, and a muslin swaddle.

I think any mother would be happy to get this. The current price of $59.99 is pricey but still competitive.

title: Cute and luxurious burp cloths
text:
These burp cloths are soft and absorbent and have fleece-like material on the side that side on the shoulder. This size offers good protection over the shoulders.

There are eight cloths for the current price of $16.99 which comes to  a competitively priced $2.12 per cloth. I really love the cute designs and these make a perfect baby shower gift.

title: Excellent infant teether with gum massaging nubs; drop resistant
text:
There is one BPA-free silicone teether in this package. The silicone is super soft. I consider this cute and engaging. This is easy for the baby to grab and hold onto. It has no sharp edges or parts that can fall off. This is perfect as a teether and is one solid piece. I also love that the ears have nubs which act as a gum massaging / tooth cleaning "tool." As is typical, always supervise when the baby is using this. This is rated for 0 to 12 months.

This is made in China. The current price of $6.29 ($6.99 minus 10%) is competitively priced for this. Overall, I consider this a great teether that is drop resistant and small enough for newborns. I had given one like this to my neighbor's infant and he absolutely loved it.

title: Excellent infant teether with gum massaging nubs; drop resistant
text:
There is one BPA-free silicone teether in this package. The silicone is super soft. I consider this cute and engaging. This is easy for the baby to grab and hold onto. It has no sharp edges or parts that can fall off. This is perfect as a teether and is one solid piece. I also love that the opposite side has nubs which act as a gum massaging / tooth cleaning "tool." As is typical, always supervise when the baby is using this. This is rated for 0 to 6 months.

This is made in China. The current price of $7.99 is competitively priced for this. It also comes in a nice giftable box. Overall, I consider this a great teether that is drop resistant and small enough for newborns. I had given one like this to my neighbor's infant and he absolutely loved it.

title: Thick, creamy, and hydrating leaving a barrier on the skin but takes long to absorb
text:
This baby body is thick and creamy. It is also hydrating and leaves a barrier on the skin. However, it takes long to absorb--like a few minutes--and that I do not like. It also feels a bit tacky until it absorbs.

The current price of $27.99 is pricey for 3.53 ounces but it is vegan, plant-based, and has no added fragrances. It does have a natural smell of the products used, however.

title: Bibs are soft, thick, easy to clean and somewhat easy to fasten
text:
These are very nice silicone baby bibs. They are thick and have a crumb catcher as well as two slits on the size where a paper towel or napkin can be held. The white bib already has those holes cut for the slits but the other two bibs require that a scissor be used to cut those holes if using an extra napkin.

There are five adjustment holes on the back of the neck with two silicone buttons. The bib is somewhat easy to fasten and remove. They are also easy to clean and the bib bottom stays open. The current price of $15.99 comes to $5.33 per bib which is about $2 more than most silicone bubs sell for. However, these are also thicker and heavier than most silicone bibs.

title: 12 super-soft baby washcloths; can be used as dusters too
text:
These baby washcloths are made of 100% bamboo per the Amazon site. They are super soft and thin and perfectly sized. I am concerned that the orange ones will bleed their color in the laundry, so I have to be careful with those.

Nevertheless, there are 12 cloths in 2 of each of 6 colors (orange, gray, green, white, blue, and pink). The current price of $6.35 comes to a reasonable $.53 cents each. For that price, these can be disposable. These also make good dust cloths as well as face rags or even dish rags.

title: Basic bibs made of a soft silicone; easy to clean & fasten; comes with matching baby spoons
text:
These are very nice silicone baby bibs. They are soft and pliable. There are four adjustment holes on the back of the neck with four silicone buttons. The bibs are easy to fasten and remove. They are also easy to clean and the bib bottom stays open during use. In addition to the two bibs, there is one matching silicone baby spoon for each bib. One thing I don't like is that the marbling on white bib makes it look dirty in spots.

The current price of $16.99 comes to $4.25 per item (2 bibs and 2 spoons) which is on the high side of competitively priced.

title: Cute cloth baby bibs; careful when washing as dark colors may bleed
text:
This is a really nice set of 10 colorful muslin bibs. Each bib has two possible adjustments with one snap fastener.

These are perfect for babies. They are tiny and mildly absorbent. I love that each of these bibs are individually wrapped.

Be careful to wash these with like colors. The darker colors like the red as the color may bleed.

The current price of 16.99 comes to $1.70 per bib.

title: Pocket must be flipped for use; bib contains some double-sided tape
text: There are 30 single-use disposable bibs in this package. In order to use the pocket on these bibs, it has to be flipped. There are also some double sided tape squares that can be used to affix this close to a baby's garments. The neck can be opened and taped for a close fit. These bibs work like they are supposed to but I feel this is better for travel than home use due to the expense and the fact that they are not as good as a silicone bib. The current price of $12.34 ($12.99 minus 5%) comes to $.41 cents per bib which is competitively priced.

title: I wouldn’t call this “never drop” but it’s an excellent teether with nubs
text:
There is one food-grade silicone teether in this package. The silicone is super soft but strong. I consider this cute and engaging. This is easy for the baby to grab and hold onto. It has no sharp edges or parts that can fall off. For the most part, this is perfect as a teether and can be considered one solid piece as the rod cannot easily be pulled out. I also love that it has nubs for suckling. As is typical, always supervise when the baby is using this.

This is made in China. The current price of $7.19 ($7.99 minus 10%) is competitively priced for this. Overall, I consider this a great teether but I would not say it is a "no drop" teether. The baby can definitely drop this if they let go although with this type of teether it is much more difficult to do that.

title: At the current price of $4.73 I am not surprised by the thin quality
text: At the current price of $4.73, this comes to $2.37 per "seat belt pillow." The material is very thin and the stuffing just lays inside a thin cotton film. When the Velcro is undone, it goes around the seat belt. The top part of the cushion provides light support. However, there is absolutely no cushion on the side that faces a child's shoulder. It just feels like a hard seatbelt on that side. For the price, this is worth the purchase but I doubt these will last long, especially if they are fastened and refastened. If this were more than $7 for the pair, I would rate this 3 stars.

title: Not terry cloth but a nice thick hooded towel with washcloth for toddlers
text: This is perfect for a toddler at bath time. It also has a hood and comes with a matching washcloth. This is definitely quality. Also, the "towel" is thick but it is not a terry cloth. The current price of $29.99 is on the high side of competitively priced for this. This is definitely a giftable item.

title: Watery lightweight lotion; absorbs quickly; no scent; not only for babies - SEE UPDATE
text:
This watery lotion is lightweight and rubs into the skin easily. It leaves my skin feeling soft. I got this for me as it is not only for a baby. I really like the results. The lotion starts a little tacky and then dries super smooth and silky.

The current price of $12.90 for 10.1 fluid ounces is competitively priced. Unfortunately, everything but the "baby lotion" name is written in Japanese on the package. Therefore, if one wanted to read the ingredients, they could not unless they could read the language.

UPDATE - I lowered my ranking from 4 to 2 stars because after using this for a while, I find it doesn't really moisturize that well. It is very watery and even though it absorbs quickly, the skin still feels dry. Therefore, I no longer like this lotion as I thought I did at the beginning.

title: Very nice sunscreen; rubs in thick & white but absorbs easily and it is scentless
text:
I really like this sunscreen even though it is for babies. It is thick and creamy and goes on a pasty white but is easy to spread and rub in. Once it is rubbed in, it absorbs easily and it leaves my skin feeling like it has a protective barrier on it and is moisturized. It also provides good coverage. The active ingredient is zinc oxide 24.5%.

The current price of $14.90 for 2.5 ounces is competitively priced.

title: Cute & loud rattle; always supervise during use
text:
This is a very cute rattle with a sluggish turning ball in the middle (the rattle part) and three movable pieces along the arm. The rattle is loud as this is handled. Note that there are four tiny beads inside the perforated turning ball. Those beads can present a choking hazard if this breaks for some reason--like by being stepped on by an adult. As always, supervise during the baby's use.

The current price of $9.09 ($12.99 minus 30%) is on the high side of competitively priced for this. Note that I wouldn't really call this a teether because it is all hart plastic except for the ears and the three hard silicone rings on the handle.

title: Lightweight cloth bibs with cute designs; easy to fasten; machine washable NO BLEACH
text: These are very nice cloth baby bibs in six lovely designs, including three designs that are perfect for the holidays. They are soft and provide decent coverage. There is one snap closure that is easy to fasten and unfasten but that makes these not adjustable. They can be machine washed but should not be bleached. The current price of $18.99 comes to $3.17 per bib which is competitively priced. I think these are adorable.

title: Goes on greasy like Vaseline but absorbs quickly & leaves hydration barrier; almost scentless
text: I am always moisturizing my dry skin and like to use baby products.  This goes on greasy like Vaseline but absorbs quickly & leaves a hydration barrier on my skin. It quenches dry skin. It is also almost scentless. The current price of $16.99 is also pricey for 1.76 ounces.

title: Portable sound machine w/timer & 12 soothing sounds; takes 3 AAA batteries
text:
[[VIDEOID:334994622f0ac340580f7feeaf762b07]] This sound machine comes with a total of 12 crisp sounds that sound more like lullabies with only one nature and one wave sound. This is battery operated but requires 3 AAA batteries (NOT included). It comes with the unit itself with an attached carry loop for hanging on a carriage and an instruction pamphlet.

Operation is simple as per my video. All the controls are located in the front with an ON/OFF button, volume up and down, and track forward and back. There is no light or headset jack. The timer does not offer continuous play but can go for 15, 30, and 60 minutes. The notes are crisp and clear but the limited sounds are just okay and sound mostly the same.

In summary, this is not worth the purchase due to the need for AAA batteries. Also, the current price of $18.74 ($24.99 minus 25%) is expensive for this unit. If looking for a portable rechargeable unit, I recommend either [[ASIN:B0B259KS9B this]], [[ASIN:B0B5H4TXZM this]], or [[ASIN:B09WJ1HC3N this]]. One of my favorite non-portable plug-in models with 34 sounds is [[ASIN:B09YRZ53JS this]].

title: Attractive bibs w/crumb catcher that feel like they are made of rain jacket material; snap closure
text:
There are two very attractive bibs in this package. Each bib has a crumb catcher and the back fastens via two plastic snaps. These are soft and pliable and feel like they are made of rain jacket material and liquid does not seep through them. They secure easily via the snaps and are easy to fasten and remove. Unfortunately, the crumb catcher does not stay open. Also, the neckline is not the same for both bibs. One bib has a neckline that comes lower than the other. That is not an issue but, it means the quality control is not consistent.

In addition to the bibs, a small pouch (a.k.a. wet bag) is included to carry the soiled bib. At the current price of $12.59 ($13.99 minus 10%) it comes to $6.30 per bib if I consider the wet bag a freebie. These bibs are very nice and super attractive, just do not rely on the crumb catcher staying open all the time.

title: Very nice large & padded diaper changing waterproof pad; a stretch to reach the top
text:
This is a very large and thickly padded diaper changing pad. The clutch can be opened with one hand by unfastening the clip but it is a bit tricky to unfasten the two Velcro pieces when unrolling. There is also a carry strap that can be hooked around a stroller.

Inside are a couple of mesh pockets, one of which has a zipper. On the front top of the bag is another zippered compartment. In addition, on the back side there is a pocket for wipes but that is difficult to access. The zipper has to be undone to move the pocket to the side and then two hands are needed to refasten. The pocketed section can also be detached from the main bag but that requires two hands to re-attach. Once that is detached, there are absolutely no pockets in the thick padded area.

The pad easily folds and unfolds. I do love the large size but that comes with a compromise. The compromise is that this is best used when I am standing perpendicular to the pad. If I stand at the bottom of the pad then it is harder to reach everything. Nevertheless, this is a decent diaper changing pad with two carry options--handle and stroller clips. The biggest negative is detaching wipes pocket. They should have used Velcro for that. Also, the changing area does not need the two Velcroed areas as that makes it tricky to fully open with one hand.

The current price of $17.99 is reasonably priced for this in my opinion.

title: Bibs are super cute; made of a soft silicone; easy to clean, fasten, & unfasten; PRICEY but good
text: These are very nice BPA-free soft silicone baby bibs. They are soft and pliable. There are four bibs and each one has four adjustment holes on the back of the neck with four silicone buttons. The bibs are easy to fasten and remove. They are also easy to clean and the bib bottom stays open. However, at the current price of $19.99 it comes to $5 per bib when most on the market sell for $3.50 or less. Nevertheless, these are very, very cute and because they are a tad larger than infant bids and super attractive, I did not deduct any points for the price.

title: Bibs are super cute; made of a soft silicone; easy to clean, fasten, & unfasten; PRICEY
text: These are very nice  BPA-free soft silicone baby bibs. They are soft and pliable. There are six adjustment holes on the back of the neck with two silicone buttons. The bibs are easy to fasten and remove. They are also easy to clean and the bib bottom stays open. However, at the current price of $9.99 it comes to $5 per bib when most on the market sell for $3.50 or less. Nevertheless, these are very, very cute.

title: Cute portable & rechargeable sound machine w/timer, nightlight, child lock, & 16 crisp sounds
text:
[[VIDEOID:6151a144a10bad2cfa69d34e21b971bd]] This sound machine comes with a total of 16 crisp sounds (i.e. white noise, fan, lullaby, and nature sounds, etc.). This is battery operated and rechargeable. It is packaged with a USB Type C cable but no A/C power adapter, the unit itself with an attached lanyard for carrying, and an instruction pamphlet.

The charging port is on the bottom. I charged this for about two hours the first time.

Operation is simple as per my video. All the controls are located on the front of the unit. The ON/OFF switch is on the bottom. Just "hold press" the ON button to start and lightly press to put in standby such as when I want the light on but no sound. There is a volume up and down button and a white noise/fan button on the left and a nature/lullaby button on the right. Press those buttons repeatedly to cycle through the eight sounds associated with each control. There is a 1hr, 2hr, and 4hr timer option. There is also a child lock feature which is engaged by pressing both volume buttons simultaneously for two seconds. It is disengaged the same way. The notes are crisp and clear and the unit is lightweight and highly portable.

In summary, this is a cute sound machine and is simple to operate. It is highly portable. The current price of $17.59 is competitively priced for this unit. I love the cute look of this and the fact that the antennae and wings of the unit are made of soft silicone.

title: Nice manicure set for baby & mom; needs 2 AA batteries NOT included
text:
This is a good manicure set for mom and baby at the various stages of his or her life. There is a guide for the colored buffers that instruct the user which buffer is for what age or for the adult. There are two sets of nail buffers in case one wears out. It also comes in a nice case and a nail clipper. This does not come with the two AA batteries needed.

This gently files the nails depending on the tip selected.

The current price of $9.39 ($9.99 minus 6%) is excellent for this because this same [[ASIN:B0B25LSH6B clipper]] is $30.

title: Adorable waterproof bib w/a crumb catcher & sleeve tops
text: This is a very cute waterproof baby bib with a crumb catcher. It has long extensions where the arms would go and that is why it is called long-sleeved but it is really not long sleeved. They are just the tops of sleeves that lay over the baby's arms. This bib is easy to attach via Velcro. The bib bottom stays open. The current price of $9.99 is pricey for this, however.

title: Basic bibs made of a soft silicone; easy to clean & fasten; comes w/one set of mismatched utensils
text: These are very nice silicone baby bibs. They are soft and pliable. There are four adjustment holes on the back of the neck with four silicone buttons. The bibs are easy to fasten and remove. They are also easy to clean and the bib bottom stays open during use. In addition to the two bibs, there is one set of mismatched utensils. What I mean by mismatched is that the fork is the color of one bib and the spoon the color of the other. The current price of $11.39 ($11.99 minus 5%) comes to $2.85 per item (2 bibs and 1 spoon and 1 fork).

title: Functional  manicure set for baby; needs 2 AAA batteries NOT included
text:
This is a lightweight and functional but basic manicure set for a baby at the various stages of his or her life. There is a guide for the colored buffers that instruct the user which buffer is for what age (see photo). There is only one set of nail buffers. Others on the market, like this [[ASIN:B0B25J2D4Z one]] come with two sets and a plastic storage case.

The buffers are very gentle and work well on delicate nails. There are two speeds both forward and in reverse.

The current price of $21.99 is slightly overpriced for this and my star rating is based on the product and this price.

title: Cute 2-piece pacifier holder
text: This is a two-piece pacifier holder set. All I need to do is thread the loop through the pacifier on either the panda or the clothing clip to hold the pacifier in place. The current price of $12.99 makes this $6.50 each holder.

title: Excellent pacifiers with storage & hollow one for self-feeding
text:
There are four regular pacifiers (two orange & two green) in this set with their own case. In addition, there is one "self-feeding" food-grade silicone pacifier with an extra tip. The self-feeding one is excellent as well because the tip is hollow with a "netted look" where cut up fruit can be inserted from the top once the cover that covers the opening is removed. It also comes with a cap for travel.

It is important to supervise when the baby is using this as it is with any other item.

The current price of $14.99 comes to $3 each pacifier if I count the extra self-feeding tip and all the plastic storage cases freebies.

title: Cute waving teether; rattle sound low
text: This is a very cute teether and waves back and forth when the baby holds it and moves. However, it barely rattles because there are hardly any beads inside the handle. The current price of $6.99 is competitively priced for this.

title: Four strong teethers made of soft silicone; love the tools; NO clothing clips
text:
There are four strong teethers made of soft silicone in this package. Most teethers of this kind, such as this [[ASIN:B09YQFGWCJ one]] comes with straps for attaching a tool to the baby's clothing. This set does not come with that.

I consider these teethers engaging. They are easy to hold on to and have no sharp edges and nothing that will fall off or come apart. However, they are a little heavier than most teethers, so supervision is required. I would hate for the baby to throw this and hit themselves or another child. For the most part, these are perfect teethers and each is one solid piece and super soft.

This is BPA free and it is also made in China. The current price of $8.35 comes to $2.09 per teether, which is reasonable even without the clothing clips.

title: Soft, easy to clean silicone bib but buttons a bit difficult to fasten due to large head
text:
This is a very nice silicone baby bib that is a bit different than others because it has a waist strap. There are five adjustment holes on the back of the neck with two silicone buttons. There are also six adjustment holes for the waist with 3 silicone buttons. In addition, there is one button in the center to secure when this is rolled up for storage.

The button head is large and that makes the buttons a bit difficult to secure. Also, as I fasten the buttons, I see white around the silicone that makes me feel these will eventually break off.

Nevertheless, this bib is easy to clean and the bib bottom stays open. However, at the current price of $11.69 ($12.99 minus 10%) it is also pricey. Most bibs (without a waistband) are priced at about $3.50 to $5 each.

title: An excellent teether but there is glue around the connection to the rod
text:
There is one BPA-free silicone teether in this package. The silicone is super soft. I consider this very cute and engaging. This is easy for the baby to grab and hold onto. It has no sharp edges. However, the rod that the baby holds onto in the center looks like it is glued around the edge (see photo). Most teethers I've ordered previously have a rod that goes through a hole in the teether but no glue. Therefore, although I feel this is excellent and perfect as a teether, always supervise when the baby is using this. This teether is rated for infants 6 months and older.

title: Portable battery operated sound machine w/ 13 crisp sounds; cute silicone bear cover – 3.5 stars
text:
[[VIDEOID:a57c9e378c72a419bd3a5005e85ffb95]] For the current price of $17.27 ($21.59 minus 20%), this pink bear sound machine comes with a total of 13 crisp sounds (i.e. white noise, lullabies, and nature sounds, etc.). This is battery operated and rechargeable. It is packaged with a micro-USB cable, the unit itself with an attached carry loop for hanging, and an instruction pamphlet.

This is a NO FRILLS unit. Operation is simple as per my video. The three controls are located on the top of the unit. All I have to do is "press-hold" the ON/OFF button on top until the unit comes on, then I lightly press it each time I want to change a sound. The + and - increase and decrease the volume. "Press-hold" the ON/OFF button to turn off.

The notes are crisp and clear and the limited sounds that it is programmed with I like very much. I particularly love the chirping birds. The charging light that is on the side of the bear face does not work during charging.

To thread the lanyard through the silicone top, the silicone has to be removed from the faceplate. Note that there is no light, no headphone jack, and no timer. I had tried their green dinosaur sound machine (same exact unit) and rated it 2.5 stars because the charging light did not work and I could not thread through the lanyard.

The price of this unit is commensurate with ones that have all or some of these bells and whistles. Other portable units I like are either this [[ASIN:B0B259KS9B unit]] that has 10 sounds or this [[ASIN:B09WJ1HC3N one]] that has 34 sounds. These two units are the same price. Note the one with 34 sounds is this brand.

text:

It is packaged with a micro--USB cable, a A/C power adapter, the unit itself with an attached carry loop for hanging on a carriage, a pram hook, an instruction pamphlet, stickers for the light of the unit, other stickers, and a little bedtime story pamphlet.

The charging port is the back side below all the operational buttons. The silicone plug has to be removed to see it. It took me overnight to charge this.

Operation is simple as per my video. All the controls are located on the back of the unit. The ON/OFF switch is on the bottom and then the unit will come at the point it was the last time it was on. If it doesn't come on, just "hold press" the sound button (2nd from top) or press the light in front to turn just the light on. There is a 15, 30, and 60 minute time option as well as an "auto-on" option if the baby cries.

What has me rating this 4 instead of 5 stars is that the controls are very hard to see. They can be seen easily on my video but not in person. Also, the face is something the purchaser has to create on the light. It comes with stickers to design the face desired. There are also only 7 sounds which is limiting. Other than this, this is a nice unit.

The notes are crisp and clear and the limited sounds this is programmed with I like very much. I particularly love the chirping birds.

In summary, this is a cute sound machine and is simple to operate. It is highly portable and can be hung. It also has an auto-on feature that initially didn't work for me but which started working later on--perhaps I was doing something wrong initially. The current price of $24.95 is competitively priced for this unit considering it comes with an A/C wall adapter and pram hook.

title: Requires screwed in installation unlike what product video says; READ ALL INSTRUCTIONS
text:
I ordered this because I wanted a door that DID NOT require a screw in installation. The video says it's not necessary but screws are provided and so are the instructions. A child can pull this out of a doorway if it is not screwed in. Therefore, the product page is very misleading and it is the reason I gave this 3 stars. I would have rated this 4 stars otherwise.

As of this writing, the current price is $89.99 for this gate is competitively priced. There are two extension pieces to increase the width of the door. Except for the screwed-in installation, most of the installation is easy. The four bolts just slide right into the ends and the white knob has to be unscrewed until the desired but equal length is achieved on both sides. The white knobs sit flush against the gate and the clear ones sit flush against the interior of the door frame. Of course if this is going to be used for a child or rambunctious dog, it is important to screw in the cups to the wall. Only once everything is tight in the doorway should the zip tie be cut. I could not tell if the door came together after installation until I cut the tie. It was extremely difficult to get it to close. The screw threads kept skipping as I was turning the knobs on the end to tighten. My recommendation is to make sure it is fully zip tied tight and shut with no gap before installing. Mine had a gap and installation did not correct that without a lot of fuss.

I will not be using this because of the recommendation to screw this to the frame. I don't want to screw a gate into my frame. Nevertheless, this will work well. The door opens both ways and the adjustable width is useful for most standard doorways. As long as this is installed correctly, this works very well. Note that puppies, kittens, and small dogs can easily fit through the slates on this gate.
