At the current price of $40 for four resealable packages of 30 wipes, that comes to $10 per package or almost $0.34 cents per wipe since there are a total of 120 wipes in the entire set. 

These wipes work well and are strong, but these are not worth the price. Unscented baby wipes are a lot cheaper and they do not have any odor.

INGREDIENTS: AQUA (which is water), ALOE BARBADENSIS LEAF JUICE, LONICERA CAPRIFOLIUM (Honeysuckle) FLOWER EXTRACT, LONICERA JAPONICA (Honeysuckle) FLOWER EXTRACT, GLUCONIC ACID, SODIUM BENZOATE, and LACTIC ACID.

They are supposed to be fragrance free but they are not to my nose. They are cruelty free and USA made.

title: Superb bassinet; height adjustable; rolls & locks; lightweight; cinch to assemble
text:
At the current price of $119.99 ($129.99 minus $10) this bassinet is superb. It comes in several pieces, including bassinet, bottom tray with rods, and extra support rod. There are also two anchor belts but I had no idea what to do with them. The instructions are easy to follow.

I just unfolded the unit, turned it over, and put in the support rod with the nubs facing up so that it would click in place - see photo. I repeated with the rods for the bottom tray and then hooked the elastic to the protrusions on the leg - see photos. There are also two straps underneath that get fed through the hole on the legs and then secured. I then installed the hard bed insert and the unit was ready to go. The basket is adjustable and reaches a total height of 33.5" but that is counting from tip to tip (meaning total bottom to top of rail). When it is at its highest, the bed is at 21" high to be flush with the bed--at least that is based on my measurement which may be off a hair. The Amazon site says it goes to 20" in height.

It is incredibly easy to adjust. The wheels roll but they are sluggish on a rug. They also lock in place. The front side can be unzipped so that it faces the parent for easy access. All I had to do was pull the tabs on the bar, lift up, and then let it down easily.

This also comes with a mesh pouch that can be hung on the bassinet for a bottle, teether, etc.

My cats love this bassinet, so it is great for pets too--especially if it is plushed up with a nice soft blanket. It does come with its own nice hard insert but that is not plush.

In summary, this bassinet is excellent. It is sturdy, easy to assemble, easy to adjust, and has a sufficient access door. Bassinets are perfect for infants up to about six months old or up to when they reach 20 pounds and can roll over. Once they reach that stage, a crib should be used as it is unsafe to use after that. Of course, it is also perfect for pets.

title: Lid does not have an airtight seal but this is a versatile tray not only for baby food
text:
There is one food-grade silicone tray in this set. There are nine cubicles in the tray. This is not only for baby food. It can be used for ice cubes, fruit cubes, cubes of homemade tomato sauce, cubes of pesto, jello, flan, etc. It can also be used for baking or to steam eggs and, of course, to make baby food.

I got this with the intention of using these for tomato sauce and pesto. However, what I do not like is that the top is not airtight. Even though there is a lip around the top (see photo), it will be easy for liquids to spill out of this. Therefore, I have to make sure it goes evenly in the freezer without tilting.

At the current price of $8.79, this is currently a great deal. I love the light green color which looks more like a seafoam green or aqua.

title: Excellent as a walking assistant sling; adjustable
text:
This is an excellent harness as a walk assist device. It is also adjustable. It is lightly padded and well-made. There is a removable bib in front and adjustments for the sling itself, as well as the crotch area and waist. In addition, there is a zipper in the crotch area so that it can be removed and used as a harness for when the child is able to stand and walk on his or her own and just needs some stability.

This is giftable if removed from its packaging and re-packaged. It also comes with some picture instructions. I ordered this for my neighbor's baby who will be walking soon.

The current price of $17.09 ($17.99 minus 5%) is competitively priced for this.

title: Excellent teethers that are less likely to be dropped but I wouldn't call them "never drop
text:
There are two food-grade silicone teethers in this package.The silicone is super soft. I consider these cute and engaging. This is easy for the baby to grab and hold onto. It has no sharp edges or parts that can fall off. For the most part, this is perfect as a teether and is one solid piece. As is typical, always supervise when the baby is using this. This is usually rated for 6 months and above.

This is made in China. The current price of $12.74 ($14.99 minus 15%) is reasonable for this as that comes to $6.37 each. Overall, I consider this a great teether and the baby is less likely to drop this. However, if these are being gifted, then I recommend buying [[ASIN:B0B1J9KJWK these]] as they come in a box.

title: Not long-sleeve & there’s color bleed on the plate image; cute silicone utensils
text:
This bib provides good coverage but it is NOT long-sleeve. Also, there is also color bleed on the plate image as can be seen in my photo.

The silicone utensils are useful and cute. They are also safe. There is a loop on either side of the plate to hold each utensil.

Overall, this is a decent bib but it is not long-sleeved, which is what I was looking for. Also, the current price of $22.49 is about $10 too much for this. For that price the product better be as advertised and there should be no color bleed.

title: Medium-sized woven basket large enough for two throws, laundry, or a cat, etc.
text:
This basket is squat and moderately wide and is big enough to hold two of my 60"x70" throws if tightly packed. It has a multitude of uses and can hold knitting, beach toys, lots of books, summer or winter clothes, etc. It is also good as a cat basket. My white cat immediately went into the basket the moment I removed it from the package and I did not coax him. The handles are great to hold and are strong. The handles sit above the basket.

Any creases in the basket will straighten out over time.

The current price of $27.99 is on the high side competitively priced for a basket of this size. It is the cat face design on the front that makes this basket extremely lovable.

title: Nice portable sound machine w/timer, mediocre nightlight, & 34 crisp sounds; a bit heavy
text:
[[VIDEOID:3ac4ae763a6147e20a3ae7fec2ca278d]] This sound machine comes with a total of 34 crisp sounds (i.e. white noise, fan, and nature sounds, etc.). This is battery operated and rechargeable. It is packaged with a Type C USB cable, the unit itself, a carry lanyard which has to be threaded through the loop in the unit, and an instruction pamphlet.

Operation is simple as per my video. All the controls are located on the top of the unit. There are three operational buttons for the sounds and there are a total of 34 sounds among them. There's a volume up and down button, a timer button, a light button and ON/OFF button. The charging port and headset jack are on the bottom side and the light is on the bottom of the unit and is sort of broken up. To operate, I just "press hold" the ON/OFF button, and then select the sound category I want by pressing the correct button. To hear more sounds in that category, I just press that category button again to cycle through the sounds. The notes are crisp and clear. I particularly love the sounds of nature.

In summary, this is a sleek, well-made, and simple to operate unit. It is portable but a bit heavy compared to other portable units I have tested. It has a headphone jack. The light is a plus but it is not as crisp as some other units I tried. No A/C adapter is included for the USB cable but most people will have one in their house. I particularly love that the sounds are crisp and the selection is vast (34 sounds) compared to other portable units. The current price of $21.59 ($26.99 minus 20%) is competitively priced for this unit.

title: Excellent teether and rattle in one with clothing clip
text:
There is one food-grade silicone teething wheel with a rattle in the center and a clip to hold this on the child's clothing. The silicone is super soft. I consider this fun and engaging. The wheel is also easy for the baby to grab and hold onto. It has no sharp edges or parts that can fall off.

I also love that it has a lanyard with a clip at the end that can be attached to the child's clothing. It is important to strongly pull the tiny clip release back to open the clip. As is typical, always supervise when the baby is using this. This rattle is a little heavy, so be careful the baby does not let this spring back on himself or herself.

This is made in China. The current price of $9.99 is on the high side of competitively priced for this. Several other teethers I consider excellent are [[ASIN:B09XGQ8YJ7 this]] and [[ASIN:B09W46VVFW this one]].

title: Bibs are super soft for silicone; easy to clean and somewhat easy to fasten; very attractive
text: These are very nice silicone baby bibs. I am surprised at how soft and pliable they are. There are six adjustment holes on the back of the neck with two silicone buttons. The bib is somewhat easy to fasten and remove. It is easy to clean and the bib bottom stays open. The current price of $15.99 ($16.99 minus 10%) is a bit pricey for this as it comes to $8 per bib, which is the only reason I removed one star. These bibs are gorgeous also--love the design.

title: Basic portable sound machine w/timer, nightlight, & 24 sounds
text:
[[VIDEOID:519cfda104114130bf8c75df3acb9a45]] This sound machine comes with a total of 24 sounds (i.e. 7 each of white noise, fan, and nature sounds and 3 lullabies). This is battery operated and rechargeable. It is packaged with a Type C USB cable, the unit itself, a carry strap, a loop for hanging on a carriage, an instruction pamphlet, and a cheat sheet.

Operation is simple as per my video. All the controls are located in front of the unit. There are three operational buttons for the sound, a volume up and down button, a pause button, a timer button, a light button and ON/OFF button. The charging port is on the side and the light is in the back of the unit. To operate, I just press the ON/OFF button, and then select the sound category I want by pressing the correct button. To hear more sounds in that category, I just press that category button again to cycle through the sounds.

The notes are crisp and clear. Although I do not care for every musical note or white noise, there are a lot that are nice to listen to such as chirping birds.

In summary, this is a sleek, well-made, and simple to operate unit. It is highly portable. It does not have a headphone jack like some other portable units. The light is a plus. No A/C adapter is included for the USB cable but most people will have one in their house. The current price of $19.99 is competitively priced for this unit.

title: Outrageously expensive small wipes; use fragrance-free baby wipes instead
text:
These messy mouth baby wipes are a little over 7.75 long" x 3.75 wide" which is small. They are slightly moist and are somewhat scentless (meaning no fragrance but they have a smell). They do work well and hold up to use without getting holes as long as one is not too rough. These are for a baby's face, mouth, and any items like teethers, bottles, toys, etc. that they put in their mouth. Below are the ingredients as written on the label.

INGREDIENTS: AQUA (which is water), GLYCERIN, SODIUM LEVULINATE, LEVULINATE ACID, POTASSIUM SORBATE, ALOE BARBADENSIS LEAF JUICE, CITRUS AURANTIUM AMARA PEEL EXTRACT, MALTODEXTRIN, SODIUM CITRATE, and CITRIC ACID.

They have no alcohol and are pH balanced.

These come in a resealable package with a flip top and adhesive flap underneath. There are 3 packages of 40 wipes for a total of 120 wipes.

In summary, these work for the purpose specified but the current price of $17.03 for 120 VERY SMALL wipes comes to an outrageously expensive $.14 cents each wipe or $5.68 per package. My recommendation is to use fragrance free baby wipes instead for these purposes as they are just as safe and a lot cheaper. The small size and very high price has me disliking these immensely.

title: Nice manicure set for baby & mom; needs 2 AA batteries NOT included
text:
This is a good manicure set for mom and baby at the various stages of his or her life. There is a guide for the colored buffers that instruct the user which buffer is for what age or for the adult. There are two sets of nail buffers in case one wears out. It also comes in a nice case. However, the $35 list price is overpriced for this, especially since this does not come with the two AA batteries needed. However, the current price of $21 ($35 minus 40%) is competitively priced for this and my star rating is based on the product and this price.

UPDATE - I liked this so much I ordered the pink one too. See photos.

title: Cream is moisturizing; takes a few minutes to absorb; has a subtle citrus aroma; pricey for a refill
text:
This appears to be a refill package and does not come with the case to put it in. The cream is hydrating and goes on smoothly. It does take a few minutes to absorb and has a nice citrus fragrance. I do wish they mentioned this was a refill in the title.

The current price of $26.82 ($29.80 minus 10%) is a bit pricey for this 330 ml plastic bag refill.

title: Soothing and absorbent body powder; love the rose fragrance
text:
This body powder is absorbent and soothing. It makes my skin feel silky. I love the rose fragrance.

The current price of $6.99 is on the high side of competitively priced.

title: Moisturizing just like Vaseline; nice fresh scent
text: This works just like Vaseline and is very softening. I really like the fresh scent. I use this on my hands and feet. The current price of $7.99 is pricey for this, however.

title: Suction on the small bowl is good but not on the large; I love that they have lids
text:
There are two bowls and two lids in this package. The suction should work on any non-porous surface. Unfortunately, the suction on the large bowl is not as good as the small bowl but it still adheres a little. The smaller bowl works as designed and the suction is good but is NOT as incredible as a [[ASIN:B09BJYB8Q3 previous set]] of these I ordered. An energetic baby can move these.

If there are any leftovers, this can be stored in the fridge with the supplied covers.

I consider this a good set that is very functional even if the suction is not perfect. Note that the lids on this set sit well on both bowls. I had another set where that was not the case.

The current price of $12.99 is reasonable for this ensemble.

title: Weight measurements comparable to my food scale; tray length in centimeters; 2 AAA batteries incl
text:
I have two food scales and I tested this for accuracy with a large bag of rice and the weight registers within a few ounces of my other scales. In the box is a two-piece long tray, the scale, and an instruction sheet. Two AAA batteries are included. Also included is a pocket tape measure. This scale can be used for animals, babies, and as a food scale.

Connecting the intersecting pieces of the tray is cumbersome. However, once the hooks are connected in the groove of the scale, everything is secure. The tray has a measuring tape on it to get a baby's or pet's size. This scale is accurate with a miniscule margin of error. Note that the reading will NEVER be spot on unless there is absolutely no movement from a pet or baby.

There is a TARE button to zero out the scale in case a container is used and I only want to weigh what's inside the container. There are also three units of measurement - kilogram, pounds, and ounces.

In summary, I think this is a very good scale that is simple to operate and has all the features needed to weigh a small pet, baby, or food (even though it was not advertised as a food scale). Apparently (per the Amazon site) it has a weight range of 50g (1.764 ounces) to 100kg (220.46 pounds) and measures up to two feet long. I do not understand the measurement scale on the tray. It goes up to 60 centimeters, which is almost two feet long. The current price of $39.98 is on the high side of competitively priced for this.

title: Superb portable high chair but no tray; can be repurposed for pets when baby grows up; assembly
text:
[[VIDEOID:1cfbf9dc364fab126ad926b0615ad048]] This is an absolutely superb portable dining seat. Minor assembly is required. Below are the parts included. All I had to do was feed in the back rail (nodule side down) into the channel at the top of the chair. Then I snapped in the armrests--one to each side of the rail. The nodule snaps in place and holds the armrests to the chair. I then snapped the fabric piece around each side of the arm rest to hold it in place. NOTE THAT this was something I forgot to do in my photos and video.  Assembly took less than 10 minutes.

PARTS
- 2 armrests
- 1 back rail that armrests clip into (must be fed through channel at top of chair)
- 1 seat with installed safety belt
- 1 carry bag
- 1 instruction pamphlet

Once the chair was assembled, I affixed it to my breakfast nook by unscrewing the bolts underneath the armrests and then tightening it to the surface. The chair is cantilevered exceptionally well and is sturdy enough to hold many pounds. There is also a pocket on the back of the chair to store a small item like wipes or a pacifier or teether, etc.

When the baby outgrows this, it can be used for pets as you can see in my photo.

This is a wonderful gift for a new mom. This chair is made for babies that can sit up on their own. It also must be affixed to a sturdy surface and not a glass table, uneven surface, or a table that is too low. I also love that it collapses and is portable just by inserting it into the included carry bag. 

The current price of $59.99 is high for this because others on the market come with the tray for about the same price or less. However, the price is commensurate with the exceptional quality and unique design of these type chairs. so I did not mark it down for no tray. If a tray is desired, then look into purchasing either one of the below chairs which are as exceptional as this is except this is minus a tray and is higher in price. In fact, this is the Toogel brand but costs more than the one they sell with a tray.

Amazon is not displaying the links correctly, so just cut and paste the product number and name into the Amazon search bar to find the others I recommended.

[[ASIN:B09R44PSK3 this]] (B09R44PSK3 Jozzve)

[[ASIN:B09JP1GGGN this]] (B09JP1GGGN Toogel)

UPDATE - My cat Ricky decided to climb in this chair--see photo. I'm sure Stephen will be next.

title: Good size toddler pillow with case; good for 2 years age and above
text:
This pillow arrives shrink wrapped in a thin wafer and expands quickly to full size. The pillow case is a ray of sunshine but should be washed before use.

The pillow is soft and generously sized. Due to risk of suffocation, only children 2 years and above should be given pillows. Before that age, pillows can result in death.

I feel the current price of $14.99 is competitively priced for a toddler pillow with pillow case.

title: Thin, non-slip placemats for toddlers; helps bowls/dishes stay more secure; a bit pricey
text:
There are two placemats in this package. They are thin and non-slip on non-porous surfaces since they are made of silicone. It teaches the child the place settings and shapes like circles, oval, etc. Obviously, once they learn this, it is less useful as an educational tool. Nevertheless, this helps keep any plates, forks, and other items from slipping off the table easily.

The current price of $15.99 is way too expensive for this, however.

title: Can act as both a diaper bag or regular backpack; NO changing pad is included
text:
This diaper bag looks beautiful and the material it is made out of feels strong like canvas. This bag is versatile because it can be used as a regular backpack or as a diaper bag.Note that except for the bottle and wipes pockets, this does not scream diaper bag. There is also NO changing pad enclosed like most diaper bags come with.

FEATURES
- The front of the bag has one zippered compartment below the handles.It also has a detachable keyring inside.

- There is also a front bottle compartment under the snap flap and can hold two bottles. There is also a mesh folder pocket inside that compartment and a central area for some small storage as well as two pencil type holders that can hold a spoon or something similar.

- The central compartment has one more non-cooler style bottle pocket. There are also two small zippered pockets large enough for some cash or a small phone. There are three small folder pockets (one of which is mesh) and three pencil/pen slots. In addition, there is a zippered compartment to store and connect a battery pack for charging one's phone. Access is outside the bag.

- The shoulder straps are well-padded and are very comfortable to use.

- There is another zippered pocket behind the shoulder straps on the back of the bag.

-There are two stroller straps on the top of the shoulder straps. They can be unclipped and hooked onto the stroller handle. I really love that they are attached and cannot be lost.

- On the outside sides of the bag are bottle pockets, one of which can substitute for a wipes pocket with a flap through which to withdraw the wipes.

- There is also a carry handle on the top of the bag if one does not want to use a shoulder strap and that has a gold fake leather closure to secure the handles together.

In summary, this bag is durable as the material feels like a strong canvas. I love the beautiful design. The only thing that looks a bit cheap is the gold trim. Other than this it looks like quality. All zippers work flawlessly. For the current price of $49.99, I feel this is competitively priced since it has a USB cable port included for use with a battery pack. Since they call this a diaper bag, I would have expected a diaper changing pad to be included but it is not. Nevertheless, I did not deduct points for this.

title: Not size specified (only 30” wide max); easy installation - READ ALL INSTRUCTIONS FIRST
text:
[[VIDEOID:88bb2f73f36748874d0aadf797d148d4]] As of this writing, the current price is $32.98 for this gate and is advertised in the title as an "Extra Wide Baby Gate Dog Gate Pressure Mount White Black Metal Child Pet Gate Indoor Safety Gates for Stairs,Doorways,Kitchen and Living Room… (9.44", White)." I guess I read it wrong and assumed it was up to 44"--I have no idea what 9.44" means. This gate is only good up to 30" wide.

The four bolts just slide right into the ends and the white knob has to be unscrewed until the desired but equal length is achieved on both sides. The white knobs sit flush against the gate and the clear ones sit flush against the interior of the door frame. Only once that is done should the zip tie be cut. Unfortunately, I could not fit this anywhere in my house due to the small size. However, this is a nice gate (with large spacing) if they only advertised the size correctly. Note that puppies, kittens, and small dogs can easily fit through the slates on this gate.

title: Weight measurements 12% lower than my food scale; tray length in centimeters; 2 AAA batteries incl
text:
I have two food scales and I tested this for accuracy with a supposedly 2lb 12 ounce unopened jar of ketchup and the weight registered within 5 to 6 ounces of my other scales (see photos).

In the box is a two-piece long tray, the scale, and an instruction sheet. Two AAA batteries are included. Also included is a pocket tape measure. This scale can be used for animals, babies, and as a food scale.

Connecting the intersecting pieces of the tray is cumbersome and the resulting full tray is unsteady on the ends. However, once the nubs are connected in the base, everything is secure. The tray has a measuring tape on it to get a baby's or pet's size. I weighed one of my adult cats and the weight shown was 8lbs 9 ounces and he is about 9lbs 5 ounces. With my cat and the ketchup there was a 5 to 6 ounce margin of error on the low side. I would figure on about a 12% difference. So far I have found no scale to measure spot on but this one is off the most.

There is a TARE button to zero out the scale in case a container is used and I only want to weigh what's inside the container. There are also four units of measurement - kilogram, pounds, pounds and ounces, and ounces.

In summary, I think this is an acceptable scale that is simple to operate and has all the features needed to weigh a small pet, baby, or food (even though it was not advertised as a food scale). Apparently it has a weight range of 50g (1.764 ounces) to 100kg (220.46 pounds) and measures up to two feet long. I do not understand the measurement scale on the tray. It goes up to 60 centimeters, which is almost two feet long. However, since it is about 12% off on the low side, you want to factor that in when weighing a baby or small pet. The current price of $48.99 is on the high side of competitively priced for this.

title: Has removable parts that can be swallowed – use with extreme supervision – 2.5 stars
text:
There are three silicone toothbrush heads in this package with a base body that comes in three pieces. The dinosaur base comes off, the head comes off, and the toothbrush tip on the other side of the head comes off. In total there are six pieces. Although this is a toothbrush for ages 3, 9, and 18 months with a dinosaur storage base, I do not like that the brush can be pulled from the brush handle with the possibility of swallowing it. A parent must use extreme supervision if using this especially since this unit is so engaging. This is just my opinion anyway.

This is made in China. The current price of $17.09 ($18.99 minus 10%) is also on the high side of competitively priced for this.

title: Slim teether with gum massaging nubs; use with supervision
text:
There is one food-grade silicone teether in this package. The silicone is super soft. I consider this cute and engaging. This is easy for the baby to grab and hold onto. It has no sharp edges or parts that can fall off. This is a slim teether and is one solid piece. It also comes with a carry bag. I also love that it has nubs which act as a gum massaging / tooth cleaning "tool." As is typical, always supervise when the baby is using this.

This is made in China. The current price of $6.99 is on the high side of competitively priced for such a slim teether. Overall, I consider this a good teether but I prefer [[ASIN:B09XGQ8YJ7 this]] or [[ASIN:B09W46VVFW this one]] better.

title: I would almost call this a “never-drop” teether; it’s excellent with gum massaging nubs
text:
There is one food-grade silicone teether in this package that looks like a helmet to me. The silicone is super soft. This is easy for the baby to grab and hold onto and I love that it has a collar on the bottom to prevent it from falling if the baby should let go of the internal rod. It has no sharp edges or parts that can fall off. This is perfect as a teether and is one solid piece. I also love that the handle ends have nubs which act as a gum massaging / tooth cleaning "tool." As is typical, always supervise when the baby is using this and also sterilize before use per the package directions. This is rated for three months and above.

This is made in China. The current price of $6.99 ($9.99 minus $3) is competitively priced for this. However, if it were $9.99, then I would consider this too expensive. Overall, this is a great teether but it is possible, although likely rare, that a baby will drop it.

title: Two smelly teethers with gum massaging nubs & two finger gum/toothbrushes
text:
There are two food-grade silicone teethers in this package along with two finger gum massagers / toothbrushes. The silicone is soft and the teethers are cute and engaging. The handle on the inside allows the child to slip their hand over the bar so that this is  unlikely to drop.This is easy for the baby to grab and hold onto. It has no sharp edges or parts that can fall off. For the most part, this is good as a teether. The handle in the center is a separate piece but it is hooked on well and unlikely to come off. There are some nubs on the opposite side which act as a gum massaging / tooth cleaning "tool." As is typical, always supervise when the baby is using this. This is rated for three months and above.

The finger massagers/toothbrushes are great. They are super soft and allow the parent to rub the child's gums.

The only thing I do not like about this is that the teethers smell. Of course, one needs to wash them before use. For that reason, I prefer [[ASIN:B09Y4G76GL this]] or [[ASIN:B09TRFQX8W this]] teether instead. They are more expensive but are stronger and one-piece. 

This is made in China. The current price of 9.99 comes to $5.50 per teether if I count the two finger massagers freebies.

title: Requires use of the stickers provided; decent protectors
text:
These are decent edge protectors. There are 12 in total along with some clear double-sided pre-cut adhesive tape. The flat edge gets the tape and is the part that goes over the top of the edge as shown in my desk photo. What I do not like is that adhesive is required. There is just some furniture I would not want to put adhesive on and that is the only negative of these protectors. Otherwise, they work well.

The current price of $6.89 comes to $.57 cents each.

title: Soothes a colicky baby; strap included for adult use; a bit pricey – 3.5 stars
text:
This belt with a herb pad that can be heated in the microwave, helps soothe a baby with a tummy ache. I gave one of these belly huggers to a friend who has a newborn and she gets a lot of use out of it. The pack should be microwaved for up to 10 seconds. It can also be used cold and should be stored in the freezer between uses to keep fresh.

Once the pack is heated, just slip it into the pocket in the center and wrap around the baby's waist. This is a very cute, well-made belt. The addition of the toy Teddy is cute but falls out easily. Also, there are some extra Velcro straps that come with this that turn this belt into an adult sized one. Unless one reads all areas of the box, it is hard to know what these straps are for.

The current price of $23.19 is pricey for this. I personally prefer this [[ASIN:B09TXTPS8D pack]] because it has clay beads instead of herbs which degrade over time.

title: Suction on this bowl is incredible & bowl has other uses besides just for baby
text:
This comes in three pieces--the bamboo bowl, a bottom suction rim that has to be "installed," and a bamboo/silicone spoon. The suction works on any non-porous surface and is incredible. Even an energetic baby would have trouble moving this as I had trouble getting this off my counter if I did not pull up the tab.

Besides using this for a baby, this is perfect for keeping a dish in place for an elderly person. Since the bottom suction rim is removable, the bowl can be used by itself as a small salad or porridge bowl for adults.

I consider this set absolutely excellent and one of the best I tried so far. Another favorite of mine for a baby is this [[ASIN:B09BJYB8Q3 one]].

The current price of $9.99 is also excellent for this set.

title: Adorable baby dumbbell teether and rattle in one; comes in at 5 ounces
text:
This is a beautiful "power" purple baby rattle/teether dumbbell. It is cute. It bends and the ends are the rattle. This has to be sterilized before first use either in boiling water for 2 minutes or in the top rack of the dishwasher. It also says by boiling water and a microwave oven but I wouldn't use that method. It is rated for babies 3 months and above but I suggest supervising during use. It is BPA free and free of phthalates, lead, and plastic per the box.

This is made of 100% food-grade silicone and is made in China.

Overall, this is a cute teether and rattle. It is also great for cute baby pictures posing with this dumbbell. The current price of $9.99 is competitively priced for this.

title: Plate suction is mediocre on non-porous surfaces and is not as good as it should be
text:
This is a nice silicone baby plate that is BPA-free and comes with two utensils, a floppy silicone skin for a top, and a bonus bib. The suction is only okay on my countertop, the side of my range, etc. It does not adhere as well as my favorite [[ASIN:B09DFMNC6T plate]]. It should adhere better to non-porous surfaces. Therefore, this plate can still be moved around once the limited suction comes undone.

I do love that this comes with a cover and utensils and the bib is a nice touch.

The current price of $16.99 is too expensive for this in my opinion, esp. since the plate barely stays put on a non-porous surface.

title: Pillow cover only; it stretched to fit my nursing pillow
text:
This nursing pillow cover is very attractive. It is made of a slinky but soft material that is stretchy. It feels like polyester fabric. It stretched to fit my standard size nursing pillow (see photos--my cat took over the pillow). The zipper is along the curved top and has to be flattened out after the pillow is inside. Overall, this is a very decorative cover but it is thin.

The current price of $10.32 ($12.99 minus 20%) is competitively priced.

title: I wouldn’t call this “never drop” but it’s an excellent teether with gum massaging nubs
text:
There is one food-grade silicone teether in this package. The silicone is super soft. I consider this cute and engaging. This is easy for the baby to grab and hold onto. It has no sharp edges or parts that can fall off. For the most part, this is perfect as a teether and is one solid piece. I also love that the opposite side has nubs which act as a gum massaging / tooth cleaning "tool." As is typical, always supervise when the baby is using this. This is rated for 5 months and above.

This is made in China. The current price of $6.64 ($6.99 minus 5%) is reasonably priced for this. Overall, I consider this a great teether but I would not say it is a "no drop" teether. The baby can definitely drop this if they let go.

title: Two very large and attractive swaddle blankets; they have multiple uses
text:
Muslin is a lightweight and breathable loose plain weave cloth usually made from cotton. These cloths are lightweight and large and are super soft. These are great as swaddle blankets for a newborn or as stroller covers, nursing covers, light blankets, or even shoulder wraps or as scarves for an adult. What I love the most about these are how lightweight, large, and soft they are and also their versatility.

The current price of $19.95 ($24.95 minus $5) for 2 comes to $9.98 per cloth which is competitively priced.

title: Requires use of the stickers provided; decent protectors
text:
These are decent edge protectors. There are 24 in total along with some clear double-sided pre-cut adhesive tape. The flat edge gets the tape and is the part that goes over the top of the edge as shown in my desk photo. What I do not like is that adhesive is required. There is just some furniture I would not want to put adhesive on and that is the only negative of these protectors. Otherwise, they work well.

The current price of $12.99 comes to $.54 cents each.

title: Two very large and mildly attractive swaddle blankets; they have multiple uses
text:
Muslin is a lightweight and breathable loose plain weave cloth usually made from cotton. These cloths are lightweight and large and are super soft. These are great as swaddle blankets for a newborn or as stroller covers, nursing covers, light blankets, or even shoulder wraps or as scarves for an adult. What I love the most about these are how lightweight, large, and soft they are and also their versatility. Unfortunately, I only find these two colors only mildly attractive unlike some of their other colors.

The current price of $19.95 ($24.95 minus $5) for 2 comes to $9.98 per cloth which is competitively priced.

text:

title: One very pretty swaddle blanket with cap and birth marker
text:
Muslin is a lightweight and breathable loose plain weave cloth usually made from cotton. This bear motif cloth is lightweight and large and is super soft. It also comes with a cap and a birth marker plaque.

This is great as a swaddle blanket for a newborn or as a stroller cover, a nursing cover, a light blanket, or even a shoulder wrap or scarf for an adult. What I love the most about this is how lightweight, large, and soft it is and also its versatility.

The current price of $24.95 is on the high side of competitively priced.

title: Only infinitesimally larger than regular poop bags; are easy to separate & open
text:
There are 5 rolls of 20 bags for a total of 100 bags in this set. These diaper bags are really not large enough to fit a loaded diaper. They are only a tiny bit larger than a regular poop bag.

The tape on the roll is a bit difficult to peel off but other than this, the bags are easy to separate from the roll and easy to open. I was able to scoop one litter pan and the bag held both the waste and litter without leaks or holes. These are strong for being biodegradable. However, since they are biodegradable, there's actually a 2-year shelf life for these bags even though it doesn't say that on the box.

The current price of $8.49 ($9.99 minus 15%) is almost $.09 cents per bag, which is on the high side of competitively priced. If the bags were 1.5 times larger, they would have received 5 stars from me. However, the current size is too small for a loaded nappy. As poop bags they are perfect and even fit in a dispenser.

title: Medium woven basket large enough for two throws, laundry, yarn, etc.
text:
I love rope baskets and have over six of them.

This basket is moderately tall and not that wide but is big enough to hold two of my 60"x70" throws if tightly packed (see photo with the red and then brown throws). It has a multitude of uses and can hold knitting, beach toys, lots of books, summer or winter clothes, etc. The handles are great to hold and are strong although since they are knitted into the basket.

Any creases in the basket will straighten out over time.

The current price of $21.44 is competitively priced for this.

title: Suction plates broke immediately before first use; this went right in the garbage
text: At the current price of $66.49 ($69.99 minus 5%) this should be built to last. However, I seated the suction plates and the suction plates broke when I needed to make a slight adjustment, rendering this seat absolutely useless (see photos) before first use. This went right in the garbage.

title: Suction on these bowls is incredible and I love that they have lids
text:
There are two bowls and two lids in this package. The suction works on any non-porous surface and is incredible. Even an energetic baby would have trouble moving these as I had trouble getting these off my counter.

If there are any leftovers, this can be stored in the fridge with the supplied covers.

I consider this an excellent set and one of the best I tried so far.

The current price of $13.99 is also excellent for this ensemble.

title: Plate is slightly heavy & suction just okay on non-porous surfaces; comes w/bib & 2 stiff utensils
text:
This is a cute silicone baby plate made of 100% food grade silicon and comes with a "cat" bib and two utensils. Unfortunately, the suction is just okay on my countertop, the side of my range, etc. It works on non-porous surfaces only. The problem is that the suction is in the center and it prevents the plate from being pulled sideways easily but it can be pulled up easily. There is still some adhesion but an energetic baby will be able to pull it off the counter. Also, this plate is only slightly heavy and not as good as a [[ASIN:B09DFMNC6T previous one]] I tried, which I love.

What I do love about this plate is that it has fidget bubbles all around the car which will be entertaining for the baby.

I do like the bib and it stays open when on. It is made of soft silicone.

I do not like the utensils, however. They are not soft silicone and the "fork" is a bit sharp for a baby.

The current price of $18.99 is on the high side of competitively priced for this plate with two utensils and a bit. I just wish it stuck better and had better utensils, otherwise, this is a very cute and functional set.

title: Cute little girl’s foam Easter caddy; very small and will fall over – 3.5 stars
text:
This Easter caddy is very small and has enough room for about four diaries (see my photo of two). It is made of a thick foam or felt material and has a nice padded bunny with a cottontail on the front. Since the bottom has been creased for a while, it does not stand up on its own. However, if books were placed in this for a while, I believe that would square the bottom.

In summary, this is a cute caddy for a little girl but only holds a small amount. The current price of $10.99 is pricey but still competitive.

title: Tiny little bows that can be used on baby or pet hair or as tiny gift package topper
text:
There are 40 multi-colored bows in this package and they are lovely. The clips snap open or closed, so I have to use my two hands to open or close these bows. They are perfect to accentuate a wisp of baby hair or put on a small pet after grooming. In addition, they can be used as tiny package toppers---like a topper for a small ring box.

The current price of $14.99 brings this to $.35 cents per bow which is just slightly pricey to me.

title: Simple & large shopping cart cover with instructions
text:
This is a large-sized cover that will fit larger shopping carts appropriately and loosely fit smaller ones too. The photos are of this on a ShopRite cart. What is extremely refreshing is that instructions are provided.

This cart cover is easy to install. I just put the patterned side up and flip over the material that goes around the handles and the back of the seat. There are two hook straps (one on each side) to secure the back in place to the thinner rungs of the cart (see photo).

There are holes for the baby's legs and there is no strap to secure the crotch area in the center area as on another cover I tried. However there are straps to secure the baby in place, which are adjustable and secure.

In the front, there is a window pocket to store incidentals such as ID, cash, or iPhone. There are also no extra straps. pockets, or loops for pacifiers or toys like some other cart covers have.

Overall, this is a great, loose and large shopping cart carriage cover. I suspect it will fit a highchair but I really think it will be too loose for that. I love that this is simple and easy to set up. I also love that there are picture instructions. The current price of $29.99 is on the high side of competitively priced for this. I actually like this cover the best of all that I tried due to its simplicity. This gets 4.4 stars round down to 4 stars from me.

title: I wouldn’t call this “never drop” but it’s an excellent teether
text:
There is one food-grade silicone teether in this package. The silicone is super soft. I consider this cute and engaging. This is easy for the baby to grab and hold onto. It has no sharp edges or parts that can fall off. For the most part, this is perfect as a teether and is one solid piece. As is typical, always supervise when the baby is using this. This is rated for 5 months and above.

This is made in China. The current price of $8.99 is competitive. Overall, I consider this a great teether but I would not say it is a "no drop" teether. The baby can definitely drop this if they let go.

title: Weight measurements comparable to my food scale; tray length in centimeters; 2 AAA batteries incl
text:
I have two food scales and I tested this for accuracy with a jar of Miracle Whip and the weight registers within .10 ounces of my other scales. In the box is a two-piece long tray, the scale, and an instruction sheet. Two AAA batteries are included. Also included is a pocket tape measure. This scale can be used for animals, babies, and as a food scale.

Connecting the intersecting pieces of the tray is cumbersome and the resulting full tray is unsteady. However, once the hooks are connected in the four grooves of the scale, everything is secure. The tray has a measuring tape on it to get a baby's or pet's size. I weighed one of my adult cats and the weight shown is actually within range of what he normally weighs. This means this scale is accurate with a miniscule margin of error. Note that the reading will NEVER be spot on unless there is absolutely no movement. One positive is that the weight measurement does not move easily when the pet moves, which is great.

There is a TARE button to zero out the scale in case a container is used and I only want to weigh what's inside the container. There are also three units of measurement - kilogram, pounds, and ounces.

In summary, I think this is a very good scale that is simple to operate and has all the features needed to weigh a small pet, baby, or food (even though it was not advertised as a food scale). Apparently it has a weight range of 50g (1.764 ounces) to 100kg (220.46 pounds) and measures up to two feet long. I do not understand the measurement scale on the tray. It goes up to 60 centimeters, which is almost two feet long. The current price of $30.39 ($31.99 minus 5%) is reasonably priced for this.

title: Four strong teethers made of soft silicone; love the tools; comes w/one clip
text:
There are four strong teethers made of soft silicone in this package with one plastic storage case and one strap for attaching a tool to the baby's clothing.

I consider these teethers engaging. They are easy to hold on to and have no sharp edges and nothing that will fall off or come apart. However, they are a little heavier than most teethers, so supervision is required. I would hate for the baby to throw this and hit themselves or another child. For the most part, these are perfect teethers and each is one solid piece and super soft.

This is BPA free and it is also made in China. The current price of $13.99 comes to a slightly pricey $3.50 each one. This [[ASIN:B09XR1KQPK teether set]] comes with six teethers for the current price of $11.99 which brings them to $2 each. The price is the only reason I took off one star; otherwise, these are 5-star teethers.

title: Use lots of supervision with this; I’m not convinced it’s safe – 2.5 stars
text: I am really on the fence about this teething ring. First of all, it is in two parts. There is an internal, what looks like bamboo, ring that helps it keep its shape. Of course, it can come apart. I believe it is too large to create a choking hazard for a small baby, but I personally do not like two part teethers. Second, the six protrusions on the outside do seem that they can be broken off with enough twisting (see photo) and present a choking hazard. My recommendation is to inspect the teether before each use and maintain constant supervision when it is in use. Perhaps this is best used as a dog toy with a teacup sized non-destructive dog who likes to carry things in their teeth.

title: Bibs are super soft for silicone; easy to clean and somewhat easy to fasten; very attractive
text: These are very nice silicone baby bibs. I am surprised at how soft and pliable they are. There are four adjustment holes on the back of the neck and the bib is somewhat easy to fasten and remove. It is easy to clean and the bib bottom stays open. The current price of $9.99 is a reasonable $5 per bib. These bibs are gorgeous also--love the design.

title: Superb portable high chair but no tray; can be repurposed for pets when baby grows up; assembly
text:
[[VIDEOID:3e61a86b2da73ef29a091651c2c7c077]] This is an absolutely superb portable dining seat. Minor assembly is required. Below are the parts included. All I had to do was feed in the back rail (nodule side down) into the channel at the top of the chair. Then I snapped in the armrests--one to each side of the rail. The nodule snaps in place and holds the armrests to the chair. I then snapped the fabric piece around each side of the arm rest to hold it in place. Assembly took less than 10 minutes.

PARTS
- 2 armrests
- 1 back rail that armrests clip into (must be feed through channel at top of chair)
- 1 seat with installed safety belt
- 1 carry bag
- 1 instruction pamphlet

Once the chair was assembled, I affixed it to my breakfast nook by unscrewing the bolts underneath the armrests and then tightening it to the surface. The chair is cantilevered exceptionally well and is sturdy enough to hold many pounds. There is also a pocket on the back of the chair to store a small item like wipes or a pacifier or teether, etc.

When the baby outgrows this, it can be used for pets as you can see in my photo.

This is a wonderful gift for a new mom. This chair is made for babies that can sit up on their own. It also must be affixed to a sturdy surface and not a glass table, uneven surface, or a table that is too low. I also love that it collapses and is portable just by inserting it into the included carry bag. 

The current price of $59.99 is high for this because others on the market come with the tray for about the same price or less. However, the price is commensurate with the exceptional quality and unique design of these type chairs. so I did not mark it down for no tray. If a tray is desired, the look into purchasing either one of the below chairs which are as exceptional as this is except this is minus a tray.

[[ASIN:B09R44PSK3 this]] (B09R44PSK3 Jozzve)

[[ASIN:B09JP1GGGN this]] (B09JP1GGGN Toogel)

title: BPA-Free airtight plastic storage for milk powder or other foodstuffs; dishwasher safe
text:
This is an airtight plastic storage container for milk powder / baby formula. The enclosed scoop holds about two teaspoons--it does have a tiny hole on the bottom of the scoop. The scoop can be seated on the inside cover as shown in my photo. I personally love the handle on this because it makes it good for traveling.

The little tiny "shelf" or scraper can be removed if desired. This is normally used to level the scoop. Note that this is BPA-free and dishwasher safe. I do not use the dishwasher, so I cannot vouch for that.

This works as designed and can be used to store more than baby formula, such as loose leaf teas, coffee (of course hole in scoop may be a problem), snacks of nuts or dried fruit, etc. Since there is a hole in the scoop, some formula will fall through and that is to be expected. The current price of $11.68 ($12.98 minus 10%) seems on the high side of competitively priced for this.

title: Softly padded play mat but I could not deflate it - 2.5 stars
text:
Even though this comes with a carry case, I do not consider this portable. After I unravelled it, I opened the valve and supposedly it is supposed to be self-inflating. However, I had to blow it up a bit with my mouth. It is nothing spectacular and only inflates a tiny bit enough to have some firmness to the mat. Unfortunately, I was unable to roll it back up to put it back in the bag. I just did not have the strength to deflate it. Therefore, I do not consider this portable.

The current price of $49.99 is overkill for this mat. Note that it does come with warnings to not leave this in the heat of a car, etc. Also the ends are pointy, so make sure the baby stays away from that. I would have preferred if they rounded them some.

title: Plate is slightly heavy & suction just okay on non-porous surfaces
text:
This is a cute silicone baby plate that is BPA-free and comes with two utensils. Unfortunately, the suction is just okay on my countertop, the side of my range, etc. It works on non-porous surfaces only. The problem is that the suction is only on the four corners (see photo) and they come loose immediately. However, there is still some adhesion but an energetic baby will be able to pull it off the counter. Also, this plate is only slightly heavy and not as good as a [[ASIN:B09DFMNC6T previous one]] I tried, which I love.

The current price of $11.99 is competitively priced for this plate with two utensils. I just wish it stuck better.

title: Young kids will absolutely love this; inflates & deflates in minutes
text:
Besides the electric pump with three nozzles and the instruction sheet, there is a base frame, base insert, and pillow. It took me a matter of less than 10 minutes to blow up all three items. Before I used the pump, I had to make sure I closed the first portion of each value and then used the appropriate nozzle size to inflate each item. Once it was inflated, then I closed the cover on the nozzle. Kids will absolutely love this. This is huge as it fits across the bottom of my king-sized bed as can be seen in the photo. Deflating the three items is a cinch and can be done in seconds by pulling the plugs.

There are only three negatives I see. First, the cord to the pump is very short and needs to be longer. I had to be so close to the outlet that it was hard to inflate this in the area I was in. Second, I am unable to get the plastic nozzles on each unit to sit flush with the product. For example, the pillow nozzle remained in the upright position. Third, the instruction pamphlet was useless. Other than this, this is a great blow-up bed. Note that there is a carry pouch that comes with the bed but it is hard to get everything into that pouch. The current price of $52.99 is competitively priced.

title: This will fit the Happy Premium Baby Lounger or the equivalent
text:
This cover is designed to fit an hourglass-shaped lounger like this [[ASIN:B08Z7KMFSH lounger]]. I actually ordered this for another baby [[ASIN:B09NC1SM7V lounger]] that I repurposed as a pet bed. That one is more square but this cover still fits it with only a slight sag at the ends. It will also fit a tightly standard pillow because the material is slinky and stretchy.

Baby loungers should never be used for babies due to risk of death; so I use loungers as pet beds. This cover provides me with extra protection for the lounger and can be washed. I would not put this cover in the dryer due to the slinky material. I do wish it felt more like cotton than spandex, however.

Note that this is a cover only and a lounger is NOT included. Also, this is designed specifically for an hourglass-shaped baby lounger but can be stretched to fit others, although it will not look as good.

The current price of $14.99 is reasonable for this.

title: Soothes a colicky baby; a bit pricey
text:
This belt with a clay bead pad that can be heated in the microwave, helps soothe a baby with a tummy ache. I gave one of these belly huggers to a friend who has a newborn and she gets a lot of use out of it. The pack should be microwaved for up to 30 seconds.

Once the pack is heated, just slip it into the pocket in the back and wrap around the baby's waist. This is a very cute, well-made belt. The current price of $24.90 is pricey for this. One positive about this one is that it has a clay bead pad instead of a gel pack. Gel packs tend to explode in the microwave if heated too rapidly. This [[ASIN:B09TXVDSBQ version]] has a gel pack, so from that perspective, I like this one better.

title: Soothes a colicky baby; a bit pricey
text:
This belt with a gel pad that can be heated in the microwave, helps soothe a baby with a tummy ache. I gave one of these belly huggers to a friend who has a newborn and she gets a lot of use out of it. However, one must be careful when heating the gel pack. The pack should be wrapped in a damp town and microwaved for 20 seconds on medium power. These gel packs will explode in the microwave if those directions are not followed. I had that happen to me.

Once the pack is heated, just slip it into the pocket in the back and wrap around the baby's waist. This is a very cute, well-made belt. The current price of $19.90 is slightly pricey for this.

title: Bibs are super soft for silicone; easy to clean but slightly tough to fasten
text: These are very nice silicone baby bibs.  I am surprised at how soft and pliable they are. There are six adjustment holes on the back of the neck and the bib is slightly tough to fasten but easy to remove. It is also easy to clean. Note that the cup in front sometimes closes unless the child is leaning forward.  The current price of $10.99 is excellent for this as it comes to $3.66 per bibs if I consider the two child locks enclosed freebies.

title: I wouldn’t call this “never drop” but it’s an excellent teether
text:
There is one food-grade silicone teether in this package. The silicone is super soft. I consider this cute and engaging. This is easy for the baby to grab and hold onto. It has no sharp edges or parts that can fall off. For the most part, this is perfect as a teether and is one solid piece. As is typical, always supervise when the baby is using this. This is rated for 5 months and above.

This is made in China. The current price of $8.99 ($9.99 minus $1) is competitive. Overall, I consider this a great teether but I would not say it is a "no drop" teether. The baby can definitely drop this if they let go.

title: Nice toddler’s backpack with leash & padded shoulders; a bit pricey
text: This is a nice dinosaur backpack. The zippers glide easily. There are two compartments, well-padded shoulder straps, a chest strap, and a leash that hooks to the backpack. If this was $18 or under it would have received 5 stars from me. However, at the current price of $22.99, this is about $5 too much.

title: Basic baby play gym with learning cards, mirrors, and hanging toys; not worth the price
text:
[[VIDEOID:cd10e95d2acbd8903e0dbb2bb1efcc2a]] This review is for the "LADIDA Baby Play Gym, 45'' Large Size Baby Activity Gym." Amazon is combining reviews with their other designs.

This gym comes in several parts. There is a slightly-padded base, three hanging toys, two rods with covers, and some learning cards. The rods are relatively easy to install but not easy to get the end to stay in the cover. There are loops on the base of the mat that the rods hook onto. I made the mistake of forgetting to pass the rod through the cloth loop on the top center of the other rod and had to redo the installation--so make sure to slide the cover through that loop before installing the first rod completely.

There are also two mirrors (one hanging and one in the pocket along the one side) which have to have the plastic removed. The toys can be hooked in different places off the rods.

I do wish the flip up wall on the one side had a flap of cloth with Velcro on either end so that I could secure the rods into the channel that is cut into those sides. This is a big negative to me.

In summary, this is a very basic set. There are only two negatives I see. First, the rods could be more secure if there was Velcro on the walled side to hold them into the cut out corners (see my video). Second, the price is about $41 too much. This should be priced at $39 or less. The list price of $79.99 is insane for this and is double what other baby gyms in this type of configuration sells for. The current price is actually $51.99 ($79.99 minus 35%), but that is still way too much.

title: Made of XPE foam; this mat is large, water resistant, & lightweight; case breaks immediately
text:
This mat is good on the floor or in a large playpen that will fit this size. It is lightweight and easy to fold and unfold. It also has a cheap carry case with it--the kind of case made out of those reusable shopping bags. In fact, the handles broke off of mine immediately. This is disappointing, especially if one wants to use the case to transport this.

The mat can be fully laid out as shown in my photos or folded in half. It is double-sided and either side can be used depending on which color combination one wants facing up. Only time will tell how well this will hold up to repeated folding and unfolding. This is great to bring to a park for a protective area to supervise the baby or even when a soft area of one's apartment is needed.

The current price of $54.99 is on the low side of competitively priced for this but given that the case is garbage, it is priced about right.

title: Lovely paw print design; well made diaper changing pad
text:
This is a long and well-padded diaper changing pad with a waterproof interior. The clutch can be opened with one hand by unfastening the clip. There is also a stroller clip on the side to hang this from the stroller handle.

Inside are a couple of pockets--a pocket for wipes and a mesh pocket with a center Velcro fastener. The pocketed section can also be detached from the main bag but that requires two hands to re-attach.

The pad is well-padded all around, even in the head area. It easily folds and unfolds. It is a bit bulky when folded.

I do love how long this is but that comes with a compromise, The compromise is that this is best used when I am standing perpendicular to the pad. If I stand at the bottom of the pad when it is vertical, then I find it hard to reach the pockets and the wipes because the pad is so large.

The current price of $13.99 is very reasonable for this in my opinion. It is an extremely functional, roomy, and well-made diaper changing pad. The paw print design is also a hit with me. So far this is the best diaper changing pad I had the pleasure to review.

title: Absolutely superb portable dining chair; can be repurposed for pets when baby grows up; assembly
text:
[[VIDEOID:3f1192486ac44a6697eac382ae143313]] This is an absolutely superb portable dining seat with a tray table. Minor assembly is required. Below are the parts included. All I had to do was feed in the back rail (nodule side down) into the channel at the top of the chair. I originally fed this in wrong because I didn't understand the instructions, so be sure it is facing down. Then I snapped in the armrests--one to each side of the rail. The nodule snaps in place and holds the armrests to the chair. Assembly took less than 10 minutes.

PARTS
- 2 armrests
- 1 back rail that armrests clip into (must be feed through channel at top of chair)
- 1 seat with installed safety belt
- 1 tray
- 1 carry bag
- 1 instruction pamphlet
- 1 warranty card

Once the chair was assembled, I affixed it to my breakfast nook by unscrewing the bolts underneath the armrests and then tightening it to the surface. The chair is cantilevered exceptionally well and is sturdy enough to hold many pounds. The tray table can be used by laying the channels for the armrests over them and then forcefully pushing down until it snaps in place over the armrests. There is also a pocket on the back of the chair to store a small item like wipes or a pacifier or teether, etc.

When the baby outgrows this, it can be used for pets as you can see in my photo.

This is a wonderful gift for a new mom. This chair is made for babies that can sit up on their own. It also must be affixed to a sturdy surface and not a glass table, uneven surface, or a table that is too low.

I consider the current price of $53.99 ($63.99 minus $10) reasonable considering the exceptional quality and unique design of this unit. I also love that it collapses and is portable just by inserting it into the included carry bag. I do wish the instructions were better, however.

title: Small, thin, lightly padded half-moon mat – I hate the creases
text:
This is a very small, thin, and lightly padded half-moon play mat for an infant or baby. I absolutely hate the creases but am hoping that comes out over time.

The mat is like outdoor carpet, so it is rugged. It's just okay to me and I feel the current price of $17.95 is about $5 too much for this.

title: Super soft hair brush that will only "comb" through peach fuzz
text:
This brush is made of goat hair. Since it is so super soft, it will only comb through very short hair--like the peach fuzz kind. It is easy to hold and is well made. Also, I noticed no bristle shedding.

The current price of $6.99 is competitively priced for this quality brush.

title: Four strong teethers made of soft silicone; love the tools; case arrived with broken latch
text:
There are four strong teethers made of soft silicone in this package with one plastic storage case. The case I received arrived with a broken latch. This a small hole in each tool so that a secure string can be attached but none were supplied.

I consider these teethers engaging. They are easy to hold on to and have no sharp edges and nothing that will fall off or come apart. However, they are a little heavier than most teethers, so supervision is required. I would hate for the baby to throw this and hit themselves or another child. For the most part, this is perfect as a teether and each is one solid piece and super soft.

This is BPA free per the Amazon site and it is also made in China. The current price of $9.98 is competitive as it comes to a reasonable $2.50 each one.

title: Very nice large diaper changing pad w/waterproof layer; a bit difficult to reach the top – 4.5 stars
text:
This is a very large diaper changing pad with a waterproof sheet that can be Velcroed to the pad. The clutch can be opened with one hand by unfastening the clip. There is also a stroller clip on the side to hang this from the stroller handle.

Inside are a couple of pockets, a pocket for wipes that can be partially unfastened and flipped out to the side. The pocketed section can also be detached from the main bag but that requires two hands to re-attach.

The pad is lightly padded and has a tiny padded bump where the head goes. It easily folds and unfolds. I actually leave the waterproof layer attached. When I do, it is a bit bulky when folded.

I do love the large side but that comes with a compromise, The compromise is that this is best used when I am standing perpendicular to the pad. If I stand at the bottom of the pad when it is vertical, then I find it hard to reach the pockets and the wipes because the pad is so large.

The current price of $19.93 is reasonably for this in my opinion. It is a very functional and roomy diaper changing pad.

title: Very nice medium-weight lotion; absorbs quickly; light scent; not only for babies
text:
This lotion is medium-weight and rubs into the skin easily. It leaves my skin feeling very soft. I got this for me as it is not only for a baby. I really like the results and the fact that the lotion is not tacky at all and dries super smooth and silky.

The current price of $12.34 ($12.99 minus 5%) is pricey for a 6.7-ounce tube. Other than the price, this is great. The ingredients contain dunaliella, olive oil, aloe vera, and shea butter.

title: A stool, potty training chair, & folding toilet seat and it’s portable
text:
I really love this portable potty for toddlers. It holds up to 50 pounds, per the box.

This is not only whimsical and fun looking but it is portable and has three functions. The legs can be opened up and the seat can be placed on the toilet. It can be used as a potty training chair with the supplied plastic liners (of which there are only a few). It can also be used as a stool.

The bottom tips of the "feet" have silicone on it to prevent slippage.

This is a great overall potty that is versatile and can easily be folded down when not in use. The current price of $23.99 is competitively priced. Once one gets use to opening the legs and then pushing down to lock them in place, it becomes one solid unit.

title: The lounger without the Velcro parts is okay; has some holes for small straps - 2.5 stars
text:
Normally I would say to avoid any type of lounger because infant sleep positioners that include a soft bolster on the sides should NEVER be used for a newborn or young baby due to a risk of Sudden Infant Death Syndrome (SIDS). Consumer Reports has done reviews on such products because deaths have been proven. Also, the FDA site lists the same warning. However, this is more like a flat liner than a lounger. In addition, the bolsters that Velcro on do not stick. They fall off immediately. This should not be used with the bolsters anyway.

There are seven strategically placed narrow holes for passing thin stroller straps through this. As long as the baby does not sleep in this unsupervised, it will offer extra cushioning for a stroller or car seat chair.

This can also be used to line a pet carrier even though it is an odd size.

Overall, it is just okay. It is thin and only lightly padded, which makes it a bit safer than the other baby loungers on the market. If this is what one is looking for, then it will do but to me it is a disappointment. Note that the bolsters are garbage. The current price of $19.99 is average.

title: Basic and foldable portable potty but not sure it will last many breakdowns
text:
I personally like the [[ASIN:B0964DYQ3W Neobum potty]] better but this one is decent too.

This is lightweight and portable and comes in four pieces not counting the potty liners (a.k.a. plastic bags) to collect the output. I just unfold this, clip in the rim, and then put it in a plastic bag. Once the plastic bag is fitted, then I put the seat on top. There is also a tiny splash guard that goes in front.

Collapsing this and pulling off the rim feels like it could break, so only time will tell if this will hold up.

Overall, this is a basic and simple potty seat with some liners. The current price of $17.99 is competitive.

title: Adorable baby dumbbell teether and rattle in one; comes in at 4.9 ounces
text:
This is a blue baby rattle/teether dumbbell. It is cute. It bends and the ends are the rattle. This has to be sterilized before first use either in boiling water for 2 minutes or in the top rack of the dishwasher. It is rated for babies 3 months and above but I suggest supervising during use. It is BPA free and free of phthalates, lead, and plastic per the box.

This is made of 100% food-grade silicone and is made in China. Note that they sell a pink version of this and that one weighs in at 4.8 ounces instead of 4.9 ounces for this blue one.

Overall, this is a cute teether and rattle. It is also great for cute baby pictures posing with this dumbbell. The current price of $12.99 is a bit steep for this, however.

title: Adorable baby dumbbell teether and rattle in one; comes in at 4.8 ounces
text:
This is a pink (not purple) baby rattle/teether dumbbell. It is cute. It bends and the ends are the rattle.  This has to be sterilized before first use either in boiling water for 2 minutes or in the top rack of the dishwasher. It is rated for babies 3 months and above but I suggest supervising during use. It is BPA free and free of phthalates, lead, and plastic per the box.

This is made of 100% food-grade silicone and is made in China. Note that they sell a blue version of this and that one weighs in at 4.9 ounces instead of 4.8 ounces for this pink one.

Overall, this is a cute teether and rattle. It is also great for cute baby pictures posing with this dumbbell. The current price of $12.99 is a bit steep for this. Also realize that the photo on the Amazon site makes this look purple but it is really pink.

title: Plate is heavy & suction excellent on non-porous surfaces as long as edges are not pulled up
text:
This is a great silicone baby plate that is BPA-free and comes with two utensils. The suction is excellent on my countertop, the side of my range, etc. It works on non-porous surfaces only. However, an energetic baby will be able to pull it off if the edges are lifted up. If the plate compartments are pulled it holds. I also love the heft of this plate as it helps it stay secure.

The current price of $11.04 ($12.99 minus 15%) is competitively priced for the plate with two utensils.

title: Bib is super soft silicone; easy to clean and easy to fasten; pocket doesn't stay open
text: This is a very nice, soft silicone baby bib. There are four adjustment levels on the back of the neck and the bib is easy to fasten and remove. It is also easy to clean. However, the bib pocket rarely stays open when worn unless the baby is leaning forward. The current price of $9.99 is competitively priced. If the pocket stayed open on this bib, I would have rated it 5 stars. In the photo, it is open only because the bib is leaning forward.

title: Six small and thin waterproof liners; one arrived dirty
text:
There are six small and thin waterproof liners in this package. They are good changing pad liners for babies. However, they are also good for kennel cages for small cats and dogs as they can be washed. They are also truly waterproof as I tested it with water and the underside never got wet.

Overall, I think these are perfect to offer small, reusable protection for babies or pets. The current price of $9.99 also comes to $1.67 per pad as there are six pads in this pack. The only negative is that one of the pads I got had a dirty smudge between the layers.

UPDATE: I washed the one with the dirty spot and it came out clean. These pads wash well. However, I air dry them.

title: Lid does not have an airtight seal but this is a versatile tiny tray not only for small baby snacks
text:
There is one tiny BPA-free silicone tray in this set with a drawstring bag. It also comes with five paper labels. I am not sure how they would be attached other than to be taped to the lid.

There are nine cubicles in the tray. This is not only for baby food or small baby snacks. It can be used for ice cubes, fruit cubes, cubes of homemade tomato sauce, cubes of pesto, jello bites, etc. It can also be used for baking or to steam eggs and, of course, to make baby food.

Note that this is very small. Also, even though the lid snugly fits inside the tray, the lid is not airtight. There are steam vents on the top. Therefore, I have to make sure it goes evenly in the freezer or oven without tilting.

At the current price of $18.99, this is on the very high side of competitively priced.

title: Great for wipes; not airtight for long wipe storage; top feels like it will break
text:
This fits baby wipes or antiseptic wipes that come in packages similar in size to baby wipes. They will not fit tissues because the box is smaller than a tissue box. This box is attractive and is made of sturdy plastic. It has a silicone seal around the area where the rim of the box meets the top but there is no such seal around the dispensing hole, so it is not airtight. What really annoys me is that the act of lifting the lid cover causes it to creak. I feel like one day the door is just going to fall off.

The lid only lays lightly on top without a silicone seal, so the wipes will dry out over time. This means that unless one is using the wipes they put in the box on a daily basis, they will have to be thrown out or rewet with water.

I find it best to remove the wipes from the packaging and then enclose them in this box. In fact, if the wipes are folded really small, I am able to get a lot in this container by stacking them side by side as shown in my photo.

Besides the weak door arms, the other negative is that the container stains easily and the stains DO NOT come off. I accidentally got grease on the gray container and even tried bleach to remove it and it just stayed (see photo).

In summary, the container fits baby or hand sanitizing wipes. It is attractive but is not airtight. The lid hinge is its weakest point both from keeping the wipes moist and because it appears like it will break easily. It is impossible to remove stains from the container. The current price of $18.99 ($19.99 minus 5%) for two containers is competitively priced and comes to $9.50 each.

title: Not really premium but the stroller straps work as designed
text:
These stroller straps are simply made so I would not call them premium. The Velcro is strong and adheres well around my stroller's handles. What I do not like is that the strap design has the hooks in the center, so I have to pass the strap through the buckle on the bottom to close it around the handle of the stroller. This is an odd design to me as most stroller straps have the clips at the end of the strap and only the Velcro loops around the handle.

The clips are easy to open and use. These can be used to hang almost anything small on the stroller like a sand pail or another toy, a water bottle if there is a hook around the bottle to attach to, a diaper bag, grocery bag, etc. Do note that it is not easy to walk with things hanging on the stroller but if one pushes these to the side of the handles and the item is not too big, this provides for more storage on the go. These also don't have to be just used for strollers. They can be used on luggage, in a closet around a clothing rail, etc., etc.

The current price of $7.99 is reasonable for two FAKE leather straps.

title: Lightweight plastic containers with locking & stackable lids; NOT microwaveable
text:
These containers are not only for a baby but they are great for small food servings for adults or the elderly, etc.

There are a total of 12 jars with 4 jars each of 3 different sizes of 2, 4, and 7 ounces. The jars have both ML and ounces (one on either side). I love the baby green/aqua color of the lid and how well they stack via the lid lock design. The can also be stuck together side by side by locking the male protrusion on the lid with the female protrusion on the lid next to it.

Even though this is designed for baby food, I feel these are great for other uses too. For instance, I can carry blueberries or other small fruits in one of these in a lunch box. These can be used for a serving of nuts or pudding, etc. These are good for food for the elderly as well. I feel these are portion controlled. I also love how they stack.

The only negative is that I really thought these were going to be glass because I was looking for glass jars and not plastic. I should have known it was plastic when the title says BPA free. The other negative is that these are not for the microwave.  I do not use a microwave, but some might expect to use these that way.

I really like these jars and they are not only for baby food. The current price of $17.99 is competitively priced and comes to $1.50 per jar. Note that it also comes with two serrated edge spoons with blue handles.

title: Compact knee / elbow pads that provide comfort during a bath; has many uses
text:
I tried several kneelers and this one is a tie for one of the smallest.

These elbow and knee pads are compact and good for those who have a small space. It comes with the non-skid kneeling pad and the elbow pad that lays over the tub and has pockets on either side for toys and suction cups to hold on to the tub. There are two mesh toy pockets that face the inside of the tub and two cloth pockets that face the outside to hold washcloths, shampo, soap, etc. There are also six suction cups, three on either side, that grip the tub.

This set feels like it is made of a neoprene like material that is easy to spot clean.

This is not only for washing children during bath time but can be used by people, like me, who have to wash out litter pans or pets in the tub and prefer a soft surface on which to lean. Since the knee pads are separate from the elbow pads, they can be used when kneeling is desired when working close to the floor, etc.

There are only two negatives I found with this set of pads. First, the handle to pick up the elbow pads faces the inside of the tub where the mesh pockets are.
