I would have preferred the handle to be located on the side of the cloth pockets so that the handle does not get wet. Second, the suction cups do not stick to the tub as easily as other kneelers I tried. However, to me these still work as long as the child does not pull on the pads.

The current price of $28.40 ($29.90 minus 5%) is on the lower side of competitively priced for this small set. In addition to the set, a small sponge and tiny silicon scrubber is included in addition to the carry case it comes in. There are other sets that are larger than this on the market that are priced about $3-$5 higher and they work just as well. I do love the neutral gray color as it goes with almost any decor.

title: This swaddle blanket is super plush and cozy
text: At the current price of $15.99 ($16.99 minus $1), I think this is a very reasonable buy. This swaddle blanket is super plush and exceedingly soft. It has Velcro closure on the "wings" and a hood and legs. It is cute, adorable, and perfect for a baby. However, be careful the baby does not overheat with this as this is not as thin as a muslin cloth. Also, learn to swaddle the baby correctly to ensure the baby stays safe. One should stop swaddling if the baby tries to roll over. There is some good information online and info that should be given at the hospital with a newborn.

title: Nothing special; feels and acts like Vaseline & smells worse too; just a tad less greasy
text:
For the current price of $16.95 this is outrageously expensive for two ounces of what feels and acts like petroleum jelly. It claims to be made without phthalates, beeswax, petroleum, lanolin, or dyes and it is non-GMO. However, since I do not care about any of that, to me this acts and feels like Vaseline but it smells worse. It is just a tad less greasy.

This is good balm and very hydrating but there is nothing special about it that would make me purchase this other than it is made with plant-based ingredients. To some, that might be very important and if it is, then this works well.

title: Four very large swaddle blankets; they have multiple uses
text:
Muslin is a lightweight and breathable loose plain weave cloth usually made from cotton. These cloths are lightweight and large and are super soft. These are great as swaddle blankets for a newborn or as stroller covers, a light blanket, or even a shoulder wrap or scarf for an adult. What I love the most about these are how lightweight, large, and soft they are and also their versatility.

The current price of $27.95 ($29.95 minus $2) for 4 comes to almost $7 per cloth which I feel is reasonable.

title: Can act as both a diaper bag or regular backpack; changing pad included
text:
This diaper bag looks beautiful but the material it is made out of feels very cheap but strong--almost like raincoat material. However, this bag is versatile because it can be used as a regular backpack or as a diaper bag with a small waterproof changing pad enclosed.

FEATURES
- The front of the bag has one small zippered compartment below the handles on top. I find it difficult to get my hands in that compartment but it is large enough to hold keys or a small phone.

- The front bottle compartment is "cooler style" and can hold two bottles. There is also a mesh folder pocket inside that compartment and a central area for some small storage. The envelope closure is via one Velcro strip.

- The central compartment has four more bottle pockets. There is one on each side and two in front and one of them is "cooler style." a folder pocket in back, two shorter bottle-sized folder pockets on the other side, along with a zippered pocket behind that. Also, inside are another two small zippered pockets large enough for some cash or a small phone. One pocket is located on the top and the other is located on the bottom of the back "door." There is also a strap with clip that can hold keys or a pacifier and it has a clip that can be detached for removal without having to unclip the keys or pacifier.

- Inside the central compartment is the thin waterproof diaper changing pad and another separate bottle bag that can be carried by itself or hung on a stroller.

- There is an exterior access door in the backpack shoulder strap area of the bag with access to the central compartment.

- The shoulder straps are well-padded and are very comfortable to use.

-There are two stroller straps on the top of the shoulder straps. They can be unclipped and hooked onto the stroller handle. I really love that they are attached and cannot be lost.

- On the outside sides of the bag are bottle pockets, one of which can substitute for a wipes pocket with a flap through which to withdraw the wipes.

- There is also a carry handle on the top of the bag if one does not want to use a shoulder strap and that has a pink fake leather closure to secure the handles together.

In summary, this bag is durable as the material feels like a strong waterproof fabric but that makes it feel cheap. I love the beautiful floral design. It looks like a regular backpack and works like one too but doubles as a diaper changing backpack. For the current price of $49.99 I would have expected a USB cable port to be included for use with a battery pack and one is not.

title: Zero assembly required; just loosen top bolts, open & configure -CRACKS EASILY - see UPDATE
text:
This review is for the Mloong Donut Playpen, which is Amazon Item Number B09NSCW1Z3. The reason I mention this is because reviews for several types of playpens are combined.

This playpen is great. What I particularly love is that no assembly is required. All I had to do was remove it from the box, loosen the caps on top, and then unfold into the configuration I desired--either a square or uneven configuration. The only thing I found difficult was unfolding some panels. There is a snap that is heard when pulling them forcefully apart. The bottom and top bolted sections turn and in order to get this to be even, those connections have to be straight. Other than this, this playpen is great and can be set up in less than 5 minutes. It is a bit heavy, however, and not something I want to carry around repeatedly.

I actually got this for the containment of foster home puppies (see photo) at a local organization I work with. They find this pen and others like these very useful.

This playpen is for babies 6 months or older. There is a door in front that opens (see photo) and a turning knob and toy on the other end (see photo).

This is well-made, easy to clean, and easy to use. If it did not require strength to straighten the panels, I would have rated this 5 stars. The current price of $159.99 is pricey but competitive.

UPDATE March 10, 2022 - The second time we went to use this we noticed a crack in the back of the molding. This is a big negative. As a result, I can no longer recommend this product. See the two photos with the crack.

title: Two simply rubber pacifiers handcrafted in Italy
text:
There are two infant pacifiers in this set. Both should be washed in warm soapy water and be allowed to dry out before use. They should also be replaced every 6 to 8 weeks. They are made of 100% natural rubber and are one piece. They are handcrafted in Italy. They also conform to the U.S. CPSC standards and EU safety standards.

These pacifiers are soft and are a good choice as an infant pacifier. They are for infants 12 months and up.

The current price of $16.99 comes to $8.50 each one.

title: Nice gift for a newborn baby; handles a bit thin
text:
There are two newborn pacifiers in this set. Both should be washed in hot soapy water for at least one minute. It is made of 100% premium grade silicone and is one piece. It is also BPA, phthalate, PVC, and latex free. It is also CPSIA tested which means it complies with the applicable standards and requirements of US Consumer Product Safety Improvement Act (CPSIA) of 2008.

These pacifiers are soft and are a good choice as an infant pacifier. I do wish, however, that the loop "handles" on the top were just a smidgen thicker--not for the baby but for the mom to grasp.

Note that these are manufactured by Adora Baby Gifts in Brooklyn, New York.

The current price of $11.69 ($12.99 minus 10%) comes to a reasonable $5.85 each one.

title: Pocket must be flipped for use; bib contains some double-sided tape
text: There are 20 single-use disposable bibs in this package. In order to use the pocket on these bibs, it has to be flipped. There are also some double sided tape squares that can be used to affix this close to a baby's garments. The neck can be opened and taped for a close fit. These bibs work like they are supposed to but I feel this is better for travel than home use due to the expense and the fact that they are not as good as a silicone bib. The current price of $9.49 ($9.99 minus 5%) comes to almost $.48 cents per bib.

title: Bib is super soft for silicone; easy to clean and easy to fasten; a bit pricey
text: This is a very nice silicone baby bib. I am surprised at how soft and pliable it is. There are six adjustment holes on the back of the neck and the bib is easy to fasten and remove. It is also easy to clean. The current price of $12.99, however, is a bit steep for this even though it is competitively priced. If this were no more than $10 it would have received 5 stars from me.

title: Nice set but two toys remind me of dog toys
text: I tried [[ASIN:B08XYR9HSM this set]] of Happy Bum baby products and loved it. This set is nice. In the tiny open cloth pouch, there is a 3.4 fl oz tube of baby lotion, 6.8 fl oz of baby wash, and 3.4 oz of diaper rash cream. There is also one blue nail clipper set  with scissors, file, plastic tweezer, and tiny nail clippers. In addition, two baby toys that look more like dog toys are included. There is one in blue and one in pink. I could have done without the toys. Nevertheless, this set is very nice and I love the smell of their lotions and wash. The current price of $16.55 ($20.69 minus 20%) is competitively priced for this; however, I still prefer their [[ASIN:B08XYR9HSM other set]] over this one.

title: Bib is super soft for silicone; easy to clean and easy to fasten; a bit pricey
text: This is a very nice silicone baby bib. I am surprised at how soft and pliable it is. There are four adjustment holes on the back of the neck and the bib is easy to fasten and remove. It is also easy to clean. The current price of $12.99, however, is a bit steep for this even though it is competitively priced. If this were no more than $10 it would have received 5 stars from me. Note that the actual color is a baby blue as shown in my first photo.

title: Tighter weave muslin cloth that is long, absorbent, and soft; perfect for baby & as a burp cloth
text:
Muslin is a lightweight and breathable loose plain weave cloth usually made from cotton. These cloths have a tighter weave than I expected but are muslin. They are soft and absorbent and perfect as burp cloths.
They measure 20 inches at its longest point in the center from tip to tip and 10 inches at its widest; so this size offers good protection over the shoulders.

There are six cloths for the current price of $8.99, which comes to  a competitively priced $1.50 per cloth. I actually like these better than some other burp cloths I tried previously.

title: Made of XPE foam; this mat is large, water resistant, and lightweight
text:
This mat is good on the floor or in a large playpen that will fit this size. It is lightweight and easy to fold and unfold. It also has a cheap carry case with it--the kind of case made out of those reusable shopping bags.

The mat can be fully laid out or folded in half as shown in my photo. Only time will tell how well this will hold up to repeated folding and unfolding. However, this is great to carry to a park for a protective area to supervise the baby or even when a soft area of one's apartment is needed.

The current price of $69.99 ($79.99 minus $10) is competitively priced for this.

title: Baby Oil made in Bulgaria with supposedly 100% “Edible” Ingredients; absorbs quickly
text:
This baby oil comes well packaged and is in a glass pump bottle. The oil is opaque (perhaps because it was delivered in a cold environment and I keep my house cold) and absorbs quickly, moisturizes, and does not have that oily feel most baby oils have. My skin felt silky after using it.

This is also made in Bulgaria. I do not think I ever had anything made in Bulgaria. The box says it is made of 100% edible ingredients. I have no clue if that is really true because I do not eat any of these types of oils. However, the ingredients are Sweet Almond Oil, Organic Grade Coconut Oil, Organic Grade Jojoba Golden Oil, Organic Grade Calendula Oil, Organic Grade Sunflower Oil, Organic Grade Avocado Oil, Vitamin E, and Natural Lavender Oil.

The current price of $12.99 is on the high side of competitively priced for a 3.38 fluid ounce bottle of specialty baby oil.

title: Takes elbow grease to put together but this is simple and nice; requires 2 AA batteries NOT included
text:
[[VIDEOID:8dee0cb540c1ff4b614b40c2b19f90fd]] I ordered this for a friend's son's baby. It comes in six pieces. I found the rods difficult to snap together as it takes a bit of elbow grease to secure them in their tracks. In fact, it depends on the desired height as to whether the center arm needs to be installed or not. Although there is no manual that says this, it appears it can be left off.

I decided to install everything. I also had to put in two AA batteries (NOT included) into the music box. A Phillips screwdriver is needed to install the batteries. The plush toys hang from the hook on the music box. The box plays 35 lullabies. There are only four controls on the unit -- ON/OFF, M for the rotation of the motor and play list, and the increase and decrease volume (which is also used to move to the next song). A long press of the M button starts and stops the rotation; a short press plays a single cycle and two presses sets the list cycle play mode.

At the current price of $18.99 ($19.99 minus 5%), this is a nice mobile. The instructions are lacking, so I do not consider this giftable unless one attaches a copy of the operation instruction card on the Amazon site. However, it is a nice, simple set that takes elbow grease to install but works perfectly when it is all put together.

title: Lid does not have an airtight seal but this is a versatile tiny tray not only for small baby snacks
text:
There is one tiny BPA-free silicone tray in this set with a drawstring bag. There are nine cubicles in the tray. This is not only for baby food or small baby snacks. It can be used for ice cubes, fruit cubes, cubes of homemade tomato sauce, cubes of pesto, jello bites, etc. It can also be used for baking or to steam eggs and, of course, to make baby food.

Note that this is very small. Also, even though the lid snugly fits inside the tray, the lid is not airtight. There are steam vents on the top. Therefore, I have to make sure it goes evenly in the freezer or oven without tilting.

At the current price of $17.43, this is on the high side of competitively priced.

title: Sticks firmly to the sink or tub; I would use a deflated bath pillow for the back if needed
text:
This is a simple baby bath chair. It has a steering handle that snaps in on top. The instructions recommend putting the baby in the seat first before securing the handle--which is non-working and stationary. There are five suction cups underneath, which stick securely to the sink or tub but do sometimes slip around. I found it difficult to remove once fully secure.

I would only put a baby that can sit up on its own in this. I would also use a partially inflated bath pillow for the back if more support is needed. I do like that the back is higher on this one than another bath chair I tried previously.

Besides the bath chair, there is a cute wind up toy that motors through the water once it is wound up. The toy is entertaining.

There is also a cardboard bath temperature gauge included. I did not try that because I prefer to use a monitor like [[ASIN:B099W8SX2L this]].

In summary, this is lightweight and portable and makes bathing fun and safer. I would definitely use a partially deflated bath pillow for more back support if needed. At $35.14 ($36.99 minus 5%) this is a bit pricey for what it is, however, that seems to be the going rate for bath seats like this.

title: Lid does not have an airtight seal but this is a versatile tray not only for baby food
text:
There is one BPA-free silicone tray in this set. There are 10 cubicles in the tray. This is not only for baby food. It can be used for ice cubes, fruit cubes, cubes of homemade tomato sauce, cubes of pesto, jello, flan, etc. It can also be used for baking or to steam eggs and, of course, to make baby food.

I got this with the intention of using these for tomato sauce and pesto. However, what I do not like is that the top is not airtight. Even though there is a lip around the top (see photo), it will be easy for liquids to spill out of this. Therefore, I have to make sure it goes evenly in the freezer without tilting.

At the current price of $14.96, this is on the high side of competitively priced.

title: Thin two-piece (removable insert) "sleeping bag" swaddle blanket
text:
This swaddle wrap comes in two pieces in the sense that the interior soft lining can be unsnapped and removed. Both sections are thin but together they make a nice swaddle blanket for a newborn. Note the sides do not have wings and fold over; instead this is more like a sleeping bag with a hoodie. I could have done without the tassel on the head, however.

The current price of $11.99 is competitively priced.

title: Two strong teethers made of soft silicone; love the tools; strap is hard to secure to hammer
text:
There are two strong teethers made of soft silicone in this package with two straps that have a clip end. The hole in the hammer is so small, that I had to use a thin dental instrument to poke the strap through so that I could secure it to the teether. It took about 5 minutes to do this. The wrench has a bigger hole, so I was able to thread the rope through easily.

The straps have a clip on the end that is disengaged by moving the plastic "hinge" as shown in my photo. To secure to an article of clothing, just feed the end of the cloth through the clip, flip the hinge back, and the tool is secure. This is used to ensure the silicone teether does not get lost.

I consider these teethers engaging. They are easy to hold on to and have no sharp edges. However, they are a little heavier than most teethers, so supervision is required. I would hate for the baby to throw this and hit themselves or another child. For the most part, this is perfect as a teether and is one solid piece.

This is BPA free per the Amazon site and it is also made in China. The current price of $11.99 is competitive as it comes to $6 each one.

title: Compact knee / elbow pads that provide comfort during a bath; has many uses
text:
I tried several kneelers and this one is the smallest.

These elbow and knee pads are compact and good for those who have a small space. It comes with the non-skid kneeling pad and the elbow pad that lays over the tub and has pockets on either side for toys and suction cups to hold on to the tub. There are two mesh toy pockets that face the inside of the tub and two cloth pockets that face the outside to hold washcloths, shampo, soap, etc. There are also six suction cups, three on either side, that grip the tub.

This set feels like it is made of a neoprene like material that is easy to spot clean.

This is not only for washing children during bath time but can be used by people, like me, who have to wash out litter pans or pets in the tub and prefer a soft surface on which to lean. Since the knee pads are separate from the elbow pads, they can be used when kneeling is desired when working close to the floor, etc.

The current price of $32.99 is competitively priced for this small set. There are other sets that are larger than this on the market that are priced similarly and work just as well. I do love the neutral gray color as it goes with almost any decor.

title: Good booster seat that can be secured to most standard chairs
text:
This is a good booster seat for children or even the elderly or infirm who need such a pad.

There is a strap for the back and for underneath the chair. These straps are adjustable and will fit most standard-sized chairs. The only negative I see is that there needs to be a grommet placed at the tip of either end of the strap because I almost had the buckles fall off when I adjusted it out too far. The cushion is firm enough for a toddler but still soft for comfort. An adult's weight flattens it more.

Overall, this is a great and lightweight booster. I also consider it portable so that it can be taken to a restaurant, etc. The current price of $23.99 is within reason.

title: Battery-operated sound machine w/timer & 16 sounds; highly portable
text:
[[VIDEOID:283666599e57962c113551ad3e73d2cc]] This sound machine comes with a total of 16 sounds. It is battery operated and is packaged with a USB cable, the unit itself, a circular clip, and an instruction pamphlet.

I charged this for about one hour before use. Operation is simple as per my video. Press the ON/OFF switch on the side. There are seven operational buttons on the face of the unit. The white noise button is where the four white noise and four fan sounds are located. The lullaby button is where the eight nature sounds are such as chirping birds, a train going over the tracks, thunderstorm, etc. The timer feature goes from 30, 60, and 90 minutes or can be turned off to play continuously. There is a pause button and a light button with two brightness levels.

The unit is really lightweight and highly portable. There is no headphone jack. The only major negative I see is that the ON/OFF button can be hit accidentally when the unit is being carried since there is no lock feature.

The current price of $19.43 ($21.59 minus 10%) is on the high side of competitively priced for a portable unit with only 16 sounds and no lock button.

title: Baskets are strong, sturdy, and attractive but small
text:
For the current price of $32.99 ($35.99 minus $3) there are three small cotton rope baskets with handles in this set. In addition, there are three tags, twine, and a marker to label the baskets if desired.

The baskets are very nice and are great for organizing. However, they are small and the price comes to $11 per basket which I consider about $3 too much per basket. The high price is the only reason I rated this 3 stars.

Note that they are wrinkled at first but they will shape up nicely as they are used.

title: Large soap; nice lemon flavor; good lather and cute
text: This is a nice duck soap on a rope. It has a lovely lemon fragrance and lathers and cleans well. It is a bit large for a baby and difficult to hold but it is certainly cute for small children or even young-at-heart adults. The current price of $13.29  ($13.99 minus 5%) is very pricey for this, however.

title: There's a trick to hanging this nicely designed child's growth scroll
text:
At the current price of $39.99, this is expensive but it is a lovely scroll and very attractive. It also has a hole for a marker on the top side where it hangs. However, in order for this to work, one has to read the instructions.

The idea is to pick one of the foot or centimeter marks on the scroll and line it up to the distance measured from the floor with a measuring tape. For instance, let's say I pick 5 feet from the floor. I should mark that position on my wall using a measuring tape. When done, I then line up the 5 foot mark on the scroll with that line. Both lines have to match when I hang the scroll. This way everything will be the correct distance from the floor when using the scroll to mark off a child's height.

This is a lovely scroll and it provides an independent record of a child's growth without having to mark up the house wall.

title: Disposable pads for "leak" or "soil" protection when needed not only for baby
text:
I ordered these for my cat. I have an old and sometimes sick cat that keeps throwing up on everything (my bed, his bed, etc.). I used to put down blankets and then do lots of laundry. However, with these liners, I can get better protection. I just throw this out after each incident and put down a new one.

These are like very thin large diapers and serve to reduce the heavy loads of laundry associated with using blankets. Also, since they prevent any leaks, which blankets do not, the items underneath the pad stay dry. They are also good as baby changing pads which is what they are marketed for; however, they are much more useful than that.

These are true to size (24"x17") and they are thin but they work. They do shift with movement, which is to be expected.

The current price of $19.99 for 25 pads comes to $.80 per pad. They are a bit pricey, especially since they are smaller and thinner than typical waterproof underpads or incontinence pads.

title: This is great stuff; moisturizes the face and neck very well
text: I got this for someone else's baby but I decided to keep it. There are two 1.6 ounce jars in this package. I used this on my face and neck and it is super hydrating. I love it better than my beauty products. It absorbs quickly too and smells clean. The current price of $10.39 ($15.99 minus 45%) comes to $5.20 per jar, which is reasonable.

title: Sticks firmly to the sink or tub; I would use a deflated bath pillow for the back
text:
This is a simple baby bath chair. It has a padded "floor" and a working steering wheel. There are four suction cups underneath which stick securely to the sink or tub but do sometimes slip around. I found it difficult to remove once fully secure.

I would only put a baby that can sit up on its own in this. I would also use a partially inflated bath pillow for the back if more support is needed.

It is important to lift up the padded mat to dry underneath when done with the bath.

In summary, this is lightweight and portable and makes bathing fun and safer. I would definitely use a partially deflated bath pillow for more back support. At $36.99 this is a bit pricey for what it is, however.

title: Large & exceptionally well-made child's playpen; 45-pc assembly easy but requires strength
text:
For the current price of $99 ($129 minus $30), this playpen is an exceptional buy. It took me 1hr 15 min to assemble and then disassemble the playpen. I really wanted to see if it was portable and, although it can be easily carried around, I do not consider this portable.

There are a total of 46 pieces (not counting the manual) and 45 of the pieces have to be assembled. The 46th piece is the supplied carry bag. There are 8 each of the small, medium, and large rods. There are 8 T couplers, 4 top corners, and 4 bottom corners with suction cups. There are 4 colorful pull-up straps and the playpen itself.

I watched the video on Amazon to get hints about the assembly but the manual provides a good idea as well. All I needed to know was which bars went where and I had no need to read the instructions. The 8 medium bars get installed in their channels on the short end of the playpen (meaning the width). The 8 large bars get installed on the long end of the playpen (meaning the length). The 8 short bars get installed vertically (meaning these are the bars that hold up the walls of the playpen). The suction cup corners are for the 4 corners that meet the floor. The 4 plain corners are for the top and the 8 T couplers are for the center connections.

Installation was simple but it did take strength and sometimes turning the couplers to get them to seat into the hole. The last bar should be installed where the zippered channel is and once it is installed, the channel can be zippered up.

There are 4 colorful pull-up straps and they just snapped over the top bar around any area of the playpen I desired. There is a mesh toy pocket on the outside of the pen for storage. There are also two zippered doors. The zippers glide open and closed easily as I tested them several times.

I broke down the playpen in reverse (zippered channel first). Uninstalling the pen was easier than installing it. However, the entire process of assembly and disassembly took me 1 hr 15 min. All items easily fit into the carry bag.

In summary, this pen is large as can be seen in my photos. It took up most of my boyfriend's parlor. The pen is well made and very sturdy once assembled. There are two entryways. The zoo motif is also very attractive. Overall, I love everything about this playpen. It is exceptionally safe and the edges are covered for protection. Both parents will be able to fit in the pen. I consider this pen an excellent buy and the baby I got this for will enjoy it for several years.

title: Cute but cumbersome to operate; only 6 notes & 3 vibrations; too pricey – 2.5 stars
text:
[[VIDEOID:5384902f6b4439e9555662017453c840]] This sound machine is supposed to combine the best of three worlds--a plush stuffed animal with 6 lullaby/white noise sounds and 3 vibrations, along with a teether that doubles as a way to secure the toy to a carriage handle or crib. Unfortunately, it fails in the sound machine department. Not only are there few sounds but it is so cumbersome to operate that it is a hassle to use.

Removing the sound machine is like delivering a baby from the stuffed toy. The Velcro from between the legs has to be removed and then a Phillips screwdriver needs to be used to get to the battery compartment to install the two AAA batteries that are included. It then has to be returned to the "womb" which is a very tight fit. It also has to be returned correctly so that the on/off switch faces down and the buttons face the back of the unit and line up with the embroidered buttons.

There is a 5, 10, and 30 minute timer depending on the position of the dial which has to be accessed via the "birth canal." 

In summary, the stuffed toy is cute and it can be secured to a stroller or railing by securing the feet in the teether. However, the music box part is so cumbersome that it is not worth the effort to use. Also, the current price of $33.99 is insane for this item, especially with its quirks. I personally prefer this [[ASIN:B096K7CKBL sound machine]] much better and it is cheaper too.

title: For small shopping carts only; no instructions
text:
This boy or girl shopping cart cover comes packaged in itself. All I had to do was unfold it out of its own package and install it on the cart. The photos are of the cover on a large BJs cart.

This is a small-sized cover that will fit only smaller shopping carts appropriately. It did not cover the full BJs seat and even the holes for the legs were not in perfect alignment. There are no instructions; however, it is relatively easy to figure out on one's own. There are straps to secure the back in place (see photo). Only what looks like a hoodie draps down over the back.

There are holes for the baby's legs and there is no strap to secure the crotch area in the center area as on another cover I tried. However there are straps to secure the baby in place, which are adjustable and secure. The sides have thin ties that can barely reach between the bars on the sides of the seat. I had to tie the sides to the cart to keep this from moving around but it was not a nice fit. The front folds over to fit over the shopping cart front.

In the front, there is a zippered pocket to store incidentals as well as some loops to hang a pacifier and toys. There is also a clear folder pocket for some cash or credit cards or a small flip phone.

Overall, this is a small carriage cover. I suspect it will fit a highchair just fine but the larger carts like BJs are too wide for this. There are really no usable instructions with the cover, so I do not consider this giftable. The current price of $21.99 is competitive. This gets 3 stars from me due to its small size.

title: Scentless and moisturizing without being overly greasy; leaves skin feeling silky but it’s pricey
text:
At the current price of $26, this is super expensive and is the only reason I deducted one star.

This baby oil is scentless and moisturizing without being overly greasy. It also absorbs quickly and leaves the skin feeling silky. Overally, this is a great body massage oil but it's very pricey.

title: Scentless and super hydrating; creates a nice barrier on the skin but pricey
text:
At the current price of $26, this is super expensive and is the only reason I deducted one star.

This lotion is of medium thickness and is scentless and super hydrating. It creates a nice barrier on the skin and absorbs in about one minute. Overally, this is a great lotion but it's very pricey.

title: Very basic mini baby bag; no room for a chaining matt unless folded
text:
This canvas bang is a versatile diaper bag but is very small, meaning there is no room for a waterproof changing pad. However, it can also be used as a regular backpack.

FEATURES
- The front of the bag has one small zippered compartment.

- The central compartment has one "cooler style bottle sleeve" which does not have a floor, so that it goes through--hence a sleeve. Also, there are two folder pockets on either side of the central compartment.

- The central compartment is spacious with room for several diapers and other incidentals. Due to the squat size of the bag, I do not feel a waterproof diaper pad can be carried in here unless it were rolled up or folded.

- The back of the bag has rings for the shoulder straps. Note that the shoulder straps are somewhat long and cannot be cinched too tight. Someone who is really skinny will have the bag fall down near their backside because of the long straps.

- There is a snap cloth that holds the handles together.

In summary, this bag is durable as the material feels like canvas. It looks like a regular backpack and works like one too but doubles as a diaper backpack. It is very small and perfect for a day's worth of diapers but not much else. The current price of $24 is competitively priced for this.

title: Sturdy stroller straps that makes it easy to hang bags
text:
These stroller straps are simply made and are made of vegan "leather." The Velcro is strong and adheres well around my stroller's handles. The clips are easy to open but they are the cheapest part of the ensemble.

These can be used to hang almost anything small on the stroller like a sand pail or another toy, a water bottle if there is a hook around the bottle to attach to, a diaper bag, grocery bag, etc. Do note that it is not easy to walk with things hanging on the stroller but if one pushes these to the side of the handles and the item is not too big, this provides for more storage on the go. These also don't have to be just used for strollers. They can be used on luggage, in a closet around a clothing rail, etc., etc.

The current price of $8.97 is reasonable for these and it is the only reason I bumped the rating from 4 to 5 stars. These are typical of most stroller straps but others cost in the $12.99 range. Since the price is right for the quality of these straps, I am rating this 5 stars. If the price were more, I would have rated this 4 stars.

title: Bottle & packaging is not well-thought out; lathers & cleans well; does not sting eyes – 2.5 stars
text:
This 8.5 fluid ounce bottle of soap comes wrapped in a cardboard wrapper. Inside the wrapper is a package of wild arugula seeds.  Unfortunately, once the wrapper is removed (which it has to be because it would get wet in the bath or shower), the bottle bottom is round. This means the bottle does not sit up and falls over. It is an absolutely horrible design. In order to dispense the soap, I have to hold it in my hand and pump the soap out.

The soap itself is nice but watery. I detect absolutely no scent to this soap at all . It lathers and cleans well but I will only get about 4 to 5 washes out of this entire bottle. A lot gets dispensed during use as it just shoots out of the pump.

I'll pass on this. Had the bottle design been better, this would have gotten 3.5 stars. In its current implementation, this is a hassle to use.

title: Nice silicone bowl set with teether; suctions to non-porous surface
text:
This is a nice three-piece silicone bowl set. It comes with a spoon, teether that serves to decorate the bowl, and the bowl itself with the suction plate. The suction works on any non-porous surface. Of course, a baby can still pull the bowl away from the surface but this makes it harder to do. The teether is also cute and can be thread on the bowl as a decoration. The spoon is easy to grip and very safe.

The bowl is a little bit misshapen, meaning not fully round. The current price of $11.04 ($12.99 minus 15%) is competitively priced.

title: Absolutely superb portable dining chair; can be repurposed for pets when baby grows up; assembly
text:
This is an absolutely superb portable dining seat with a tray table. Minor assembly is required. Below are the parts included. All I had to do was feed in the back rail (nodule side down) into the channel at the top of the chair. I originally fed this in wrong because I didn't understand the instructions, so be sure it is facing down. Then I snapped in the armrests--one to each side of the rail. The nodule snaps in place and holds the armrests to the chair. I also fed the base cardboard into the Velcro sleeve underneath the seat. Assembly took less than 10 minutes.

PARTS
- 2 armrests
- 1 back rail that armrests clip into (must be feed through channel at top of chair)
- 1 seat with installed safety belt
- 1 covered base cardboard (must be fed into Velcro sleeve underneath seat)
- 1 tray
- 1 carry bag

Once the chair was assembled, I affixed it to my breakfast nook by unscrewing the bolts underneath the armrests and then tightening it to the surface. The chair is cantilevered exceptionally well and is sturdy enough to hold many pounds. The tray table can be used by laying the channels for the armrests over them and then forcefully pushing down until it snaps in place over the armrests. There is also a pocket on the back of the chair to store a small item like wipes or a pacifier or teether, etc.

When the baby outgrows this, it can be used for pets as you can see in my photo.

This is a wonderful gift for a new mom. This chair is made for babies that can sit up on their own. It also must be affixed to a sturdy surface and not a glass table, uneven surface, or a table that is too low.

I consider the current price of $53.99 ($63.99 minus $10) reasonable considering the exceptional quality and unique design of this unit. I also love that it collapses and is portable just by inserting it into the included carry bag.

title: Excellent 3-in-1 Travel Slim Collapsible Potty; fits plastic shopping bags once liners are used up
text:
A small collapsible potty with a roll of eight liners comes in this box. The potty is well-made and very portable. There are buttons on the "base feet" that allow the potty to sit up like a regular training potty or be extended out to the sides so it can be used over a toilet seat for training. The ability to affix a potty liner or just a standard supermarket bag to the little silicone holes on the side, means one does not have to purchase additional potty liners as long as there are no holes in the bag.

The "feet" have silicone on it to prevent slippage.

This is a great overall potty that is versatile and can easily be folded down when not in use. The current price of $18.99 is reasonable as well.

title: Good safety device; setting time and timer takes some getting used to
text:
[[VIDEOID:ad58f3b779798565fbdc9f885c903f74]] This tests the temperature of a baby's bath water but can also be used as a room thermometer. It blinks green when the water is too cold (below 89.9F) or blinks red (see video) when the water is too hot (above 102F). It also tells the time and has a timer setting in case one wants to know the length of bathing time (counting up) or have a set bath time (counting down).

I did find setting the time and timers take a bit of getting used to and the instructions are needed. However, the temperature warnings work as designed.

There are two 1.5V LR44 button-type alkaline batteries included and already installed in the Hedgehog.

title: Plate suction excellent on countertops & non-porous surfaces as long as edges are not pulled up
text:
This is a cute silicone baby plate that is BPA-free and has two suction spots/buttons on top. The suction sticks well on my countertop, the side of my range, etc. It works on non-porous surfaces only. However, an energetic baby will be able to pull it off if the edges are lifted up. If the plate compartments are pulled it holds.

The current price of $8.67 is competitively priced.

title: Wipes are reasonably sized & moist for a baby's nose & face only; pkg size not marked
text:
These baby wipes are a little over 7" x 7" which is reasonably sized. They are sufficiently moist and are scentless. They also work well and hold up to use without getting holes as long as one is not too rough. These are for a baby's nose and face only. Below are the ingredients as written on the label.

INGREDIENTS: WATER, SODIUM CHLORIDE, GLYCERIN, PROPYLENE GLYCOL, ALOE BARBADENSIS LEAF JUICE, TOCOPHERYL ACETATE, POLYSORBATE 20, POLYAMINOPROPYL BIGUANIDE, DISODIUM EDTA, CHLORPHENESIN, SODIUM CITRATE, CETYLPYRIDINIUM CHLORIDE, 2-BROMO-2-NlTROPROPANE-1 , 3-DIOL.

no alcohol • no parabens no phthalates • no sulfates

Note that the wipes are folded small, so they have to be unfolded before use. I found them easy to unfold but it might be difficult if holding the baby in one arm while using the other to remove the wipes.

These come in a resealable package with a flip top and adhesive flap underneath. There are 12 packages of 30 wipes for a total of 360 wipes. Note that the individual packages are not marked for the number of wipes, which I do not like.

In summary, these wipes are good for the purpose specified but the current price of $23.03 ($28.79 minus 20%) for 360 wipes comes to $.6 cents each wipe which is reasonable for this.

title: Wipes are reasonably sized & moist for a baby's nose & face only; pkg size not marked; pricey
text:
These baby wipes are a little over 7" x 7" which is reasonably sized. They are sufficiently moist and are scentless. They also work well and hold up to use without getting holes as long as one is not too rough. These are for a baby's nose and face only. Below are the ingredients as written on the label.

INGREDIENTS: WATER, SODIUM CHLORIDE, GLYCERIN, PROPYLENE GLYCOL, ALOE BARBADENSIS LEAF JUICE, TOCOPHERYL ACETATE, POLYSORBATE 20, POLYAMINOPROPYL BIGUANIDE, DISODIUM EDTA, CHLORPHENESIN, SODIUM CITRATE, CETYLPYRIDINIUM CHLORIDE, 2-BROMO-2-NlTROPROPANE-1 , 3-DIOL.

no alcohol • no parabens no phthalates • no sulfates

In summary, these wipes are good for the purpose specified but the current price of $14.39 ($17.99 minus 20%) for 180 wipes comes to $.8 cents each wipe which is expensive for this.

title: This fits the top of the Happy Premium Baby Lounger that I repurposed as a pet bed
text:
I ordered this cover for this [[ASIN:B08Z7KMFSH lounger]]. This cover stretches acts like a fitted sheet that fits the top of the lounger perfectly. Since the lounger is thick, it does not go all the way down the sides. Baby loungers should never be used for babies due to risk of death; so I use the loungers as pet beds. Although this cover is a bassinet sheet, it provides me with extra protection on my lounger and can be washed.

The sheet is fitted and a bit stretchy and very, very nice. I also love the design and soft feel to it. This is definitely a quality sheet as long as the size is appropriate for what one wants to cover. If my lounger was not as thick, it would have even been a better fit.

title: Small disposable pads for "leak" or "soil" protection when needed
text:
These are not only changing pad liners for babies. I ordered these for my cat. I have an old and sometimes sick cat that keeps throwing up on everything (my bed, his bed, etc.). I used to put down blankets and then do lots of laundry. However, with these pads, I can get better protection. I just throw this out after each incident and put down a new one.

These are smaller than most incontinence liners but they still serve to reduce the heavy loads of laundry associated with using blankets instead of disposable underpads like these. Also, since they prevent any leaks, which blankets do not, the items underneath the pad stay dry.

The only thing to watch out for with disposable underpads is that they shift easily if the patient (human or animal) moves a lot. If that is an issue, then I recommend using a washable underpad such as YEARSTAR Underpads (Amazon Item # B08VW8ST8W). Yes it is more work but no underpad will work if it shifts to an area that does not provide the protection needed.

Since these are small, they are perfect as a changing pad liner. They are also great to line the inside of a small pet carrier in case a pet has an accident on the way to the vet or during travel.

The current price of $19.99 for 50 pads comes to $.40 per pad, which is reasonable even though these are small.

title: Excellent teethers made of soft silicone; cat feet might be bit off, however - 3.5 stars
text:
These two teethers are made of super soft silicone and they are super cute and engaging. These are easy to hold on to and have no sharp edges. For the most part, they are perfect as teethers. The only caution is that the gray cat has little tiny feet on the bottom that can be bit off; therefore, when using that be diligent in checking if the baby is trying to bite off the feet.

This is made in China. The current price of $13.99 is a competitively priced $7 each one.

title: These puff books have some entertainment value – 3.5 stars
text:
There are two soft crinkle books in this set--Crab and His Friends and Baby Woodpecker." One has a crab toy attached to it and the other a woodpecker. There's a Velcro loop on the top of each book so that it can be hooked onto a stroller handle or diaper bag. There is also a Velcro closure on the book itself.

There isn't really a story in these books but pages with different sayings like "how interesting the treehouse is" and "hello, anyone there." No baby I know will understand the words but the holes and flap and toys and crinkle of the books should keep a baby interested.

I would supervise when these are in use since I do feel the toys can be pulled apart by a child who is strong.

title: This shampoo lathers okay & cleans very well but it is very watery; doesn’t sting eyes
text: This shampoo is so watery that I already used one fifth of the bottle with my first use. I need a lot also to get a good lather. It does clean very well, however, and is almost detergent like in that regard. It also does not sting my eyes, which means this is perfect for a baby. If it were not so watery, this would have received 4 stars from me.

title: Good lather, doesn’t sting my eyes, fragrance is okay but it's pricey
text:
This baby body wash and shampoo produces a good lather and does not sting my eyes, so it is perfect for a baby. The aroma is not my favorite but it is not offensive either. I feel clean after using this.

At the current price of $24 for 10.1 ounces, this is pricey as well.

title: Sleekly designed unit but never stops boiling water unless I turn it off; in Celsius only
text:
[[VIDEOID:830f53dc66ec5f025b02a47428a2a760]] This is a sleekly designed unit and I expected it to work as stated but it does not. It comes with a base, the kettle, a lousy user guide, and one package of citric acid detergent for cleaning off scale. Note that this unit is only for water and not food (despite what one line in the manual says). Even though it is marketed for warming water for instant formula, it can be used to boil water for tea, oatmeal, pasta, etc.

POSITIVES
- It is a beautifully and sleekly designed unit.

- It holds over 40 ounces (1200ml) of water.

- It has three modes (keep warm, boil, and preset).

- It heats water to the requested temperature and will delay heating for a number of hours from 0 to 24 hours.

- It boils water with the touch of a button.

NEGATIVES
- If the boil mode is selected, it never stops boiling water in keep warm mode, even though the set temperature is much lower than boiling, unless I turn the unit off.

- The temperature is only in Celsius, so the user must convert it to Fahrenheit. For example, for tea brewing 79.444 C = 175 F; 85 C = 185 F; 90.556 C = 195 F; 93.333 C = 200 F, and 100 C = 212F.

- The manual is not very clear in certain areas. For example, no food should go in this unit, yet it says "food should not be heated for too long" on Page 4. There is no mention of what the E1 code is on the unit, etc.

- The unit has no auto shutoff, so it will stay on until the water dries out, which I consider very dangerous.

In summary, this unit is gorgeous and not only for heating up water for formula but also for boiling water for tea, oatmeal, etc. The temperature can be selected, but it is only in Celsius. Since I do not know Celsius, I have to translate the temperature into Fahrenheit. The biggest negative is that it never stops boiling water after the "keep warm" mode is selected once the water has boiled. Even though the present temperature is 40 degrees less than boiling, it will continue to boil the water indefinitely until the carafe runs dry. If this worked as designed and had an auto shutoff, then this would have received 5 stars from me at the current price of $39.99. I see everyone else has rated this 5 stars, so either I received a defective unit or the others have not discovered this issue yet.

title: Rated for babies 12 months+; cute utensils with soft silicone handles
text:
This fork and spoon utensil set is adorable and the handles are made of soft silicone with a cute car motif. They are also very attractive. The spoon is only slightly concave and the fork is more on the flat side. I am glad the tines are not too sharp.

This is rated for babies over one year. The handles are very easy to hold on to. Overall, this is a very nice set and the current price of $12.99 comes to $6.50 per utensil which is on the high side of competitively priced.

title: Performs and looks just like a regular lunch box cooler; love the cat motif
text:
This is a great little cooler and it is not just for breast milk or baby bottles. First of all, I love the cat motif design. Second, it has some nice features. The handle on top can be unbuckled and attached to a stroller handle or a luggage. Second, it has an adjustable shoulder carry strap, a small zippered pocket in front, and an internal mesh pocket on the cooler top.

The cooler is well insulated and keeps items cool for several hours. Although it says it has a six bottle capacity, I was able to fit two full tumblers with water, a large glass sauerkraut jar, and two small cans of seltzer. The zippers glide easily in their tracks.

Overall, I really like this cooler and the current price of $14.24 ($14.99 minus 5%) is competitive. This is good as a lunch cooler and not just for bottles.

title: Great for wipes; not airtight for long wipe storage; top feels like it will break
text:
I am a bit disappointed in this wipes container.

This fits baby wipes or antiseptic wipes that come in packages similar in size to baby wipes. They will not fit tissues because the box is smaller than a tissue box. This box is attractive and is made of sturdy plastic. It has a silicone seal around the area where the rim of the box meets the top but there is no such seal around the dispensing hole, so it is not airtight. What really annoys me is that the act of lifting the lid cover causes it to creak. I feel like one day the door is just going to fall off.

The lid only lays lightly on top without a silicone seal, so the wipes will dry out over time. This means that unless one is using the wipes they put in the box on a daily basis, they will have to be thrown out or rewet with water.

I find it best to remove the wipes from the packaging and then enclose them in this box.

In summary, the container fits baby or hand sanitizing wipes. It is attractive but is not airtight. The lid hinge is its weakest point both from keeping the wipes moist and because it appears like it will break easily. The current price of $11.39 ($11.99 minus 5%) is competitively priced for this.

title: Moisturizing just like Vaseline but I do not care for the “after smell” & packaging is odd
text: This works just like Vaseline and is very softening. What I do not like is the aroma as after I rub it in, it smells a bit like a burnt tire. Also, the pill bottle packaging is odd. It makes it difficult to get the entire product out of the jar. I would have preferred a small and squat jar to this one.

title: Block finish is imperfect which makes gifting hit or miss; otherwise wonderful - 3.5 stars
text:
These milestone blocks are lovely and relatively well-made. They come in a nice satchel and are attractive. Unfortunately, they put paper between the blocks during shipping that sticks to the finish and I could not get a lot of it off. Also, one of the numbers was not fully painted and another the finish was incomplete. In addition, they have a slight smell to them. Nevertheless, if they are aired out to cure, that should go away.

In general, these are lovely. There are a total of six blocks--4 small and 2 large. They are used as milestone blocks when taking pictures during a child's 1st Christmas, Easter, Thanksgiving, various birthday's, etc. There are any number of combinations available. In general I love them, I just wish the finish did not have flaws and stuck on paper from shipping that I have trouble removing as that makes them less giftable.

At the current price of $29.99, these should be perfect.

title: Cheap but useful bottle cleaning kit; silicone doesn’t clean as well as bristles - 2.5 stars
text:
This is a cheaply made silicone bottle brush cleaning set. It comes with a stand that does not really hold more than a few drops of water in the bottom tray before leaking. The brushes only secure one way in the stand and have drainage holes below. The arch underneath the stand allows me to easily pick this up and move it.

The large bottle brush and the nipple bottle brush are made of silicone. Silicone does not clean as well or hold soap as well as bristles do. Nevertheless, these gently work to cleanse as long as the bottle is not too dirty. It is not much better than sloshing water around inside. The long narrow brush is the better one as it has bristles. The problem with that one is that the bristles do not come to the tip so that also is marginally useful.

At the current price of $19.98 this is too expensive for this, in my opinion.

title: Loose weave cloth; absorbent and soft; perfect for baby but cut highly uneven
text:
Muslin is a lightweight and breathable loose plain weave cloth usually made from cotton. These cloths are actually as they should be with a light weave and soft feel. Due to its absorbency, it will sop up all those baby spills. However, they are unevenly made as can be seen in my photo of the yellow one. I stretched the one side as far as it would go and measured it and the bottom side was 14 inches wide and the top side was 12.5 inches wide.

Despite the poor cut, these can be used as a face towel, bath towel, or even a dish towel or dish drying rag. The quality (not the cut) is good and typical of what muslin cloth should be. Only time will tell how long these hold up in the wash.

There are 10 cloths (2 each of pink, blue, light pink, yellow, white, and green). The current price of $12.99 for 10 comes to $1.30 per cloth which is competitively priced.

title: Great for wipes; not airtight for long wipe storage
text:
This is only for baby wipes or antiseptic wipes that come in packages similar in size to baby wipes. They will not fit tissues because the box is smaller than a tissue box. This box is attractive and is made of sturdy plastic. It has a silicone seal around the area where the rim of the box meets the top but there is no such seal around the hole area, so it is not airtight. Although the lid closes tightly, without a silicone seal in that area, the wipes will dry out over time. This means that unless one is using the wipes they put in the box on a daily basis, they will dry out if used infrequently.

The box can be used to house the entire plastic wipe package but the lid might not seal correctly due to the bulk. I find it best to remove the wipes from the packaging and then enclose them in this box.

In summary, the containers are great for baby or hand sanitizing wipes. The container is an attractive pink and well made but is not airtight. I do love that the hole is larger than other wipes dispensers I tried previously because I can easily reach the wipes inside. The current price of $10.79 is competitively priced for this.

title: Sturdy stroller straps but it's FAKE LEATHER; easy to hang bags
text:
These stroller straps are simply made. The Velcro is strong and adheres well around my stroller's handles. The clips are easy to open but they are the cheapest part of the ensemble.

These can be used to hang almost anything small on the stroller like a sand pail or another toy, a water bottle if there is a hook around the bottle to attach to, a diaper bag, grocery bag, etc. Do note that it is not easy to walk with things hanging on the stroller but if one pushes these to the side of the handles and the item is not too big, this provides for more storage on the go. These also don't have to be just used for strollers. They can be used on luggage, in a closet around a clothing rail, etc., etc.

The current price of $12.99 is a little pricey for this. Also, they are not leather as specified on Amazon; it is FAKE leather.

title: Smells exactly like brewed Chamomile tea; gentle shampoo that lathers well & doesn’t sting my eyes
text: This shampoo smells exactly like brewed Chamomile tea. It is not exactly my favorite fragrance but it is not offensive either. It is gentle, lathers well, and does not sting my eyes, which is important to me when using this on a baby.

title: This fits the Happy Premium Baby Lounger that I repurposed as a pet bed
text:
I ordered this cover for this [[ASIN:B08Z7KMFSH lounger]]. This cover, that has sort of an hourglass shape for an hourglass-shaped lounger) stretches and fits it perfectly. Baby loungers should never be used for babies due to risk of death; so I use the loungers as pet beds. This cover provides me with extra protection on that lounger and can be washed. I would not put it in the dryer due to the slinky material. I do wish it felt more like cotton than spandex, however.

Note that this is a cover only and a lounger is NOT included. Also, this is not for a circular lounger but more for an hourglass-shaped one.

title: Use w/supervision; requires assembly; only for babies over 3 years old; assembly a bit dangerous
text:
This gym comes in several parts. There is a circular padded base, what looks like a neck pillow, and two rods with all the toys. The rods are dangerous to set up because they spring back into one's face and body unless they are held taught during assembly. There are loops on the mat that the hooks hook onto.

Besides the assembly, the other disappointment is that the toys keep falling off easily. In addition, the photo on the Amazon site shows an infant using this. However, there is a warning on the box that says this is for toddlers over 3 years and above due to a choking hazard. I doubt a 3 year old toddler would use this. 

This is a nice mat but I just do not feel this is useful for the age range specified and it is too dangerous for any child younger than three based on the warning.

The current price of $49.99 is also too expensive for this.
